strands.title: Geometry, Coordinates and Solid Figures
strands.description: Angle properties of parallel lines and transversals, interior angles of polygons, 3D polyhedron nets, and Cartesian coordinates in the first quadrant.

strands.title: Data Handling, Probability and Algebraic Thinking
strands.description: Data representation with pie charts and line graphs, measures of central tendency (mean, median, mode), simple chance, and forming and solving linear algebraic equations.

strands.title: Listening and Speaking
strands.description: Oral fluency, debate presentation, polite discourse, digital etiquette, stress and intonation, and public speaking in Kenyan contexts.

strands.title: Reading and Comprehension
strands.description: Intensive and extensive reading, inferential comprehension, context clue vocabulary, literary appreciation, and KPSEA passage analysis.

strands.title: Language Structures and Functions
strands.description: Present perfect continuous, conditional clauses (Type 1 & 2), active/passive voice, direct/reported speech, prepositions, and adverbs.

strands.title: Writing and Composition
strands.description: Expository and narrative compositions, formal letters, procedural notices, diary entries, and KPSEA composition structuring.

strands.title: Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza
strands.description: Ufasaha wa maamkizi, adabu za mazungumzo katika jamii, midahalo rasmi, usikilizaji makini wa taarifa na mawaidha, na utamkaji sahihi wa sauti tatanishi.

strands.title: Kusoma na Ufahamu
strands.description: Kusoma kwa kina na mapana, ufahamu wa makala ya masuala ibuka (sayansi, mazingira, afya), msamiati katika muktadha, na uchambuzi wa mashairi na hadithi za KPSEA.

strands.title: Sarufi na Matumizi ya Lugha
strands.description: Ngeli zote za nomino na upatanisho wa kisarufi, nyakati na hali, mnyambuliko wa vitenzi, vishazi na sentensi, kauli halisi na kauli taarifa, vitate na vinyume.

strands.title: Kuandika na Utunzi wa Insha
strands.description: Uandishi wa insha za masimulizi za KPSEA, insha za maelezo, barua rasmi na za kirafiki, hotuba, kumbukumbu za mikutano, na uakifishaji sahihi.

strands.title: Living Things and Environment
strands.description: Classification of vertebrates and invertebrates, plant reproductive systems, pollination adaptations, seed dispersal, and ecosystem interdependence.

strands.title: Human Body and Health
strands.description: The human circulatory and excretory systems, nutritional deficiency diseases, immunization, and community disease prevention.

strands.title: Matter and Energy
strands.description: Physical changes of state in matter, light propagation, reflection, refraction, sound transmission, and simple electrical circuits.

strands.title: Digital Technology and Mechanics
strands.description: Spreadsheet software, block-based coding, cyber safety, force interactions, and simple machines (levers, pulleys, inclined planes, friction).

strands.name: Conservation of Agricultural Resources
strands.description: Soil erosion control, vegetative barrier establishment, surface runoff harvesting, mulching, and sustainable moisture retention.

strands.name: Crop Production and Organic Practices
strands.description: Propagation and management of climbing crops, indigenous African leafy vegetables, organic nursery care, and multi-storey container gardening.

strands.name: Animal Production and Health Management
strands.description: Rearing small domestic animals (poultry, rabbits, guinea pigs), housing, organic feeds, and external and internal parasite management.

strands.name: Human Nutrition, Food Safety and Culinary Practices
strands.description: Family meal planning, seasonal food budgeting, traditional Kenyan food preparation, kitchen hygiene, and table etiquette.

strands.title: Natural and Built Environments of Eastern Africa
strands.name: Natural and Built Environments of Eastern Africa
strands.swahiliTitle: Mazingira Asilia na Yaliyojengwa ya Afrika Mashariki
strands.description: Map reading skills, position and size of Eastern African countries, major physical features, drainage systems, climatic regions, and environmental conservation.

strands.title: People, Population and Cultural Heritage
strands.name: People, Population and Cultural Heritage
strands.swahiliTitle: Watu, Idadi ya Watu na Urithi wa Kitamaduni
strands.description: Language groups of Eastern Africa, historical migration routes, population distribution and factors, age sets, clans, and preservation of cultural heritage.

strands.title: Resources and Economic Activities in Eastern Africa
strands.name: Resources and Economic Activities in Eastern Africa
strands.swahiliTitle: Rasilimali na Shughuli za Kiuchumi za Afrika Mashariki
strands.description: Cash crop farming, livestock production, mining, forestry, wildlife and tourism, fisheries, transport, communication, and regional trade (EAC).

strands.title: Governance, Citizenship and Regional Cooperation
strands.name: Governance, Citizenship and Regional Cooperation
strands.swahiliTitle: Uongozi, Uraia na Ushirikiano wa Kikanda
strands.description: Traditional leaders, colonial resistance, the struggle for independence, Kenyan constitutional democracy, electoral processes, and East African Community organs.

strands.title: Art and Craft
strands.name: Art and Craft
strands.description: Advanced drawing, two-point perspective, tonal modeling, painting, colour schemes, printmaking, clay ceramics, sculpture, puppetry, and indigenous African crafts.

strands.title: Music and Performing Arts
strands.name: Music and Performing Arts
strands.description: Staff notation, sol-fa pitching, compound time signatures, classification of traditional Eastern African musical instruments, folk songs, dance choreography, and stage etiquette.

strands.title: Physical Education and Sports
strands.name: Physical Education and Sports
strands.description: Track athletics (sprint mechanics, relay exchanges, middle distance pacing), field events (long jump, shot put), team ball games (football, netball, volleyball), gymnastics, water safety, and sports injury prevention.

strands.title: Creation and Environmental Stewardship
strands.description: Understanding human responsibility in God’s creation, conserving ecosystems and biodiversity, reducing environmental degradation, and stewarding personal God-given talents and digital technology with integrity.

strands.title: The Holy Bible and Moral Decisions
strands.swahiliTitle: Biblia Takatifu na Maamuzi ya Maadili
strands.description: Using the Bible as a moral compass in decision-making, history of Bible translation in Kenya, and emulating Old Testament heroes of faith, courage, and servant leadership.

strands.title: The Life, Ministry, and Teachings of Jesus Christ
strands.swahiliTitle: Maisha, Huduma na Mafundisho ya Yesu Kristo
strands.description: The Beatitudes and ethical standards of the Kingdom of God, parables of mercy, forgiveness, and stewardship, and the power of the Holy Spirit in the early church mission.

strands.title: Christian Living, Contemporary Challenges, and Nation Building
strands.swahiliTitle: Maisha ya Kikristo, Changamoto za Kisasa na Ujenzi wa Taifa
strands.description: Practicing Christian family values, standing up for social justice, resisting corruption, and championing national cohesion, peace, and inter-religious tolerance in Kenya.

strands.title: The Holy Qur’an and Hadith
strands.description: Recitation, memorization, Tajweed rules, and moral reflection on selected Surahs (Al-Zalzalah, Al-Adiyat, Al-Qadr, Al-Tin) and prophetic Hadith on truthfulness, guarding the tongue, and sincere advice.

strands.title: Sirah (Life of Prophet Muhammad SAW)
strands.description: The Year of Sorrow, journey to Ta’if, the miraculous night journey (Al-Isra wal-Mi’raj), the Pledges of Aqabah, the Hijrah to Madinah, the building of the Prophet’s Mosque, and the historic Constitution of Madinah.

strands.title: Pillars of Iman and Acts of Worship (Ibadah)
strands.description: Belief in the Day of Resurrection (Yawm al-Qiyamah) and Divine Decree (Qadar); performing Swalatul Musafir (Qasr and Jam’a) and Swalatul Janazah; understanding the rites, spiritual lessons, and universal brotherhood of Hajj.

strands.title: Islamic Ethics (Akhlaq), Muamalat & Nation Building
strands.swahiliTitle: Maadili ya Kiislamu, Muamalat na Ujenzi wa Taifa
strands.description: Islamic financial ethics (Halal vs. Riba, honest trade, resisting corruption and bribery), Islamic environmental stewardship, peaceful coexistence with neighbors of other faiths, and Christian-Muslim harmony in Kenya.

strands.title: Paramatma, Trimurti and the Universal Law of Karma
strands.swahiliTitle: Paramatma, Trimurti na Sheria ya Kiulimwengu ya Karma
strands.description: Understanding Paramatma’s supreme omnipresence, cosmic manifestations of the Trimurti (Brahma the Creator, Vishnu the Preserver, Shiva the Regenerator), the cosmic cycle of creation and dissolution, and the infallible Law of Karma (cause, effect, moral responsibility, Sanchita, Prarabdha, and Kriyamana) guiding the soul (Atman) toward spiritual liberation (Moksha).

strands.title: Sacred Scriptures, Epic Wisdom and Vedic Mantras
strands.swahiliTitle: Maandiko Matakatifu, Hekima ya Kina na Mantras za Kiveda
strands.description: Exploring profound teachings from the Bhagavad Gita (Lord Krishna’s counsel to Arjuna on Kurukshetra, Nishkama Karma / selfless action, and mental equanimity), moral lessons of duty and loyalty in the Ramayana, and chanting and reflecting on sacred Vedic mantras (Mahamrityunjaya, Pavamana / Asato Ma Sadgamaya, and Shanti Mantras) for peace and healing.

strands.title: Sadachar (Virtues), Niyamas, Yoga and Environmental Stewardship
strands.swahiliTitle: Sadachar (Maadili), Niyamas, Yoga na Utunzaji wa Mazingira
strands.description: Internalizing moral disciplines through the Five Niyamas (Shaucha, Santosha, Tapas, Svadhyaya, Ishvara Pranidhana), foundational practices of Ashtanga Yoga for mental focus and wellness (Asanas, Pranayama), and living the universal Vedic ethic of Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam (the world is one family) through reverent care of Mother Earth (Prakriti), sacred flora and fauna, and water bodies.

strands.title: Sacred Festivals, Sewa and Kenyan National Coexistence
strands.swahiliTitle: Sherehe Takatifu, Sewa na Uwepo wa Pamoja wa Kitaifa nchini Kenya
strands.description: Spiritual significance of sacred celebrations (Diwali, Annakut, Holi, Navratri), cultural transmission, practicing selfless community service (Sewa) as divine worship (Nara Sewa Narayana Sewa), fostering inter-religious dialogue, and contributing actively to Kenyan national cohesion, charitable health camps, and educational development.

subStrands.title: Multiplication & Rows
subStrands.description: Multiplication as repeated addition and equal grouping in agriculture and markets.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, problem solving, and numeracy application

subStrands.title: Fractions of a Whole (Chapatis & Fruit)
subStrands.description: Halves, quarters, eighths using physical models like chapatis and oranges.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spatial reasoning and fair resource sharing

subStrands.title: Kenyan Shillings & Market Change
subStrands.description: Coins (KES 1, 5, 10, 20) and notes (KES 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000) in everyday shopping.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Financial literacy and practical decision making

subStrands.title: Plant Germination & Conditions
subStrands.description: Factors necessary for seeds to sprout: water, warmth, air and fertile soil.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Scientific inquiry and environmental stewardship

subStrands.title: Kenyan Wildlife & National Parks
subStrands.description: Herbivores, carnivores and their habitats in Maasai Mara, Tsavo, and Lake Nakuru.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Environmental awareness and national pride

subStrands.title: Ngeli za Nomino (A-WA & KI-VI)
subStrands.description: Kutambua ngeli za viumbe hai na vitu visivyo na uhai katika sentensi.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Linguistic competence and cultural appreciation

subStrands.title: Subtraction within 1,000
subStrands.description: Subtracting up to 3-digit numbers with and without regrouping in authentic Kenyan markets, transport, and shamba contexts.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, problem solving, and financial literacy

subStrands.title: Simple Multiplication
subStrands.description: Multiplication as repeated addition, equal grouping, arrays, and multiplication tables of 2, 3, 4, 5, and 10 in Kenyan daily contexts.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, problem solving, and numeracy application

subStrands.title: Division (Equal Sharing & Grouping)
subStrands.description: Division as equal sharing and repeated subtraction, dividing 2-digit numbers by 2, 3, 4, 5, and 10 without remainder in Kenyan everyday settings.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, problem solving, and cooperation

subStrands.title: Fractions (Halves, Quarters & Eighths)
subStrands.description: Identifying, naming, and finding halves (1/2), quarters (1/4), and eighths (1/8) of whole shapes and groups in Kenyan settings.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, problem solving, and spatial reasoning

subStrands.title: Length (Non-Standard Units & The Metre)
subStrands.description: Measuring and estimating length using non-standard body units (handspan, strides) and the standard unit metre (m) in everyday surroundings.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, problem solving, and practical measurement

subStrands.title: Mass (Comparing Mass & The Kilogram)
subStrands.description: Comparing mass using balance scales and non-standard objects, and measuring with the standard unit kilogram (kg) in Kenyan markets.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, problem solving, and practical measurement

subStrands.title: Capacity (Comparing & The Litre)
subStrands.description: Comparing capacity using everyday containers and measuring liquid volume using the standard unit litre (l) in domestic and school settings.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, environmental conservation, and practical measurement

subStrands.title: Time (Clock Faces, Days & Months)
subStrands.description: Telling time to the hour and half-hour on analog clocks, days of the week, and months of the year in Kenya.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Self-efficacy, critical thinking, and time management

subStrands.title: Kenyan Currency & Shopping within KES 1,000
subStrands.description: Identifying Kenyan coins and notes up to KES 1,000, budgeting, shopping, and calculating change in market settings.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Financial literacy, critical thinking, and citizenship

subStrands.title: Lines (Straight & Curved Lines)
subStrands.description: Identifying, drawing, and modeling straight lines (vertical, horizontal, slanting) and curved lines in classroom and natural settings.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Creativity, imagination, and spatial orientation

subStrands.title: 2D Shapes & Geometric Patterns
subStrands.description: Identifying, sorting, and describing rectangles, circles, triangles, and ovals by their sides and corners, and creating repeating geometric patterns.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Creativity, imagination, critical thinking, and design

subStrands.title: Pronunciation, Consonant Blends & Polite Forms
subStrands.description: Pronouncing common consonant blends (bl, cl, fl, gl, pl, sl) accurately and using polite expressions (please, excuse me, thank you, sorry) in daily conversations.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, self-efficacy

subStrands.title: Oral Language & Narrative Retelling
subStrands.description: Listening attentively to Kenyan oral folk tales and short stories, answering who/what/where questions, and retelling events in chronological order.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, critical thinking, and citizenship

subStrands.title: Phonics, Digraphs & Sight Words
subStrands.description: Decoding consonant digraphs (ch, sh, th, wh), diphthongs (oi, oy), and reading Grade 3 high-frequency sight words automatically.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, digital literacy

subStrands.title: Guided Reading & Reading Comprehension
subStrands.description: Reading short narrative and informational Kenyan texts fluently and answering direct, vocabulary, and inferential comprehension questions.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, communication and collaboration, citizenship

subStrands.title: Nouns & Pronouns
subStrands.description: Mastering singular and plural nouns (including irregular plurals like children, teeth, feet) and personal and possessive pronouns.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, critical thinking

subStrands.title: Verbs & Tenses
subStrands.description: Action words, present continuous tense (-ing), simple present tense, and simple past tense (regular -ed and common irregular verbs).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, critical thinking

subStrands.title: Adjectives & Prepositions
subStrands.description: Descriptive words (color, size, shape, quality) and prepositions of position (in, on, under, behind, between, next to, across).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, imagination and creativity

subStrands.title: Conjunctions & Sentence Building
subStrands.description: Linking ideas with conjunctions (and, but, because) and formulating questions with inquiry words (who, what, where, when, why, how).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, critical thinking and problem solving

subStrands.title: Capitalization & Punctuation Mechanics
subStrands.description: Using capital letters for sentence beginnings, proper nouns (names, days, months, places, Kenya), pronoun "I", and applying full stops, question marks, and commas in lists.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, digital literacy

subStrands.title: Guided Creative Writing & Friendly Notes
subStrands.description: Composing cohesive 3-5 sentence descriptive paragraphs on everyday Kenyan experiences and writing short friendly thank-you notes.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, imagination and creativity

subStrands.title: Maamkizi na Mazungumzo ya Adabu
subStrands.description: Kusalimia kwa heshima kulingana na rika na nyakati za siku, na kutumia maneno ya heshima kama tafadhali, asante, samahani, na niwie radhi.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mawasiliano na ushirikiano, uraia na maadili mema

subStrands.title: Sauti Mseto, Vitendawili na Ushairi
subStrands.description: Kutamka sauti mseto (/ch/, /dh/, /gh/, /ng'/, /ny/, /th/), kutegua vitendawili vya kimazingira, na kughani mashairi mepesi ya watoto.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mawasiliano na ushirikiano, kufikiri kwa kina na kutatua matatizo

subStrands.title: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha na Msamiati
subStrands.description: Kusoma maneno ya silabi tatu na nne kwa sauti na ufasaha, na kukuza msamiati wa vifaa vya shuleni, nyumbani, na biashara ya sokoni.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mawasiliano na ushirikiano, kusoma na kuandika

subStrands.title: Ufahamu wa Kifungu
subStrands.description: Kusoma na kuelewa vifungu vifupi vya hadithi za kuvutia za Kenya (Safari ya Treni ya SGR na Siku ya Mavuno Shambani), na kujibu maswali ya ufahamu.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mawasiliano na ushirikiano, kufikiri kwa kina na kutatua matatizo

subStrands.title: Ngeli za Nomino (A-WA na KI-VI)
subStrands.description: Upatanisho wa kisarufi katika ngeli ya A-WA (viumbe hai na watu) na ngeli ya KI-VI (vitu visivyo na uhai) katika umoja na wingi.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mawasiliano na ushirikiano, kufikiri kwa kina

subStrands.title: Nyakati za Vitendo (-na-, -li-, -ta-)
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia viambishi vya nyakati: wakati uliopo (-na-), wakati uliopita (-li-), na wakati ujao (-ta-) katika mazungumzo na maandishi.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mawasiliano na ushirikiano, kufikiri kwa kina

subStrands.title: Vivumishi na Viashiria
subStrands.description: Kutumia vivumishi vya sifa (-zuri, -baya, -kubwa, -dogo, -tamu) na viashiria vya ukaribu na umbali (huyu/hawa, hiki/hivi, yule/wale, kile/vile).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mawasiliano na ushirikiano, kufikiri kwa kina na kutatua matatizo

subStrands.title: Vinyume vya Maneno na Vihusishi vya Mahali
subStrands.description: Kutambua vinyume vya maneno (simama/keti, cheka/lia, nene/konda, panda/shuka) na vihusishi vya mahali (ndani ya, juu ya, chini ya, kando ya, mbele ya, nyuma ya).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mawasiliano na ushirikiano, kufikiri kwa kina na kutatua matatizo

subStrands.title: Mwandiko na Alama za Uakifishaji
subStrands.description: Kutumia herufi kubwa kwa majina maalum, mwanzo wa sentensi, siku za juma na miezi, pamoja na alama za kitone (.), alama ya kuuliza (?), na mkato (,).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mawasiliano na ushirikiano, stadi za kidijitali na uandishi

subStrands.title: Utungaji wa Kifungu Kifupi na Ujumbe wa Kirafiki
subStrands.description: Kutunga insha fupi ya sentensi 3 hadi 5 yenye mtiririko mzuri wa mawazo kuhusu mada za kimazingira na kuandika ujumbe mfupi wa kirafiki wa shukrani.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mawasiliano na ushirikiano, ubunifu na uwazaji huru

subStrands.title: Weather and Sky Conditions
subStrands.description: Observing and recording daily weather conditions with symbols (sunny, rainy, windy, cloudy, calm), choosing suitable clothing, and understanding effects on farming and daily life.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking and problem solving, environmental literacy

subStrands.title: Water Sources, Uses, and Conservation
subStrands.description: Natural and man-made water sources, domestic uses, making water safe for drinking (boiling, filtering), and conserving water in schools and homes.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Environmental literacy, critical thinking and problem solving

subStrands.title: Soil Types and Uses
subStrands.description: Comparing clay, sand, and loam soils by texture, particle size, and drainage, and exploring practical uses in farming, pottery modeling, and construction.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking and problem solving, creativity and imagination

subStrands.title: Plants in Our Local Environment
subStrands.description: Identifying plant parts and their functions (roots, stem, leaves, flowers, fruits), caring for crops (watering, weeding, mulching), and safety with plants.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Environmental literacy, critical thinking and problem solving

subStrands.title: Animals in Our Local Environment
subStrands.description: Identifying domestic and wild animals, understanding their needs and shelters, appreciating animal products, caring responsibly for domestic livestock, and observing personal safety around dangerous or wild animals.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, citizenship, caring for living things, digital literacy

subStrands.title: Energy in the Environment: Light, Heat, and Sound
subStrands.description: Investigating sources of light and heat, exploring everyday uses in Kenya, practicing eye and burn safety, exploring sources of sound, distinguishing pleasant sounds from harmful noise, and observing ear safety.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, communication, personal safety, scientific inquiry

subStrands.title: Physical Features and Compass Directions
subStrands.description: Identifying major natural physical features (hills, valleys, plains, rivers, mountains), using the four cardinal compass points (North, South, East, West) for orientation, and mastering pedestrian road safety and traffic signs.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spatial orientation, citizenship, critical thinking, road safety

subStrands.title: Culture, Heritage, and National Celebrations
subStrands.description: Appreciating the rich cultural diversity of Kenya (traditional attire, songs, dances, indigenous foods, artifacts), respecting national symbols (Kenyan Flag, National Anthem, Coat of Arms), and honoring national holidays (Madaraka Day, Mashujaa Day, Jamhuri Day).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Citizenship, national cohesion, cultural awareness, respect for diversity

subStrands.title: Economic Activities and Markets in the Community
subStrands.description: Exploring income-generating activities in the local community (farming, retail trade, transport, fishing, carpentry), understanding buying and selling with Kenyan currency, differentiating needs from wants, and cultivating saving habits.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Financial literacy, entrepreneurship, critical thinking, citizenship

subStrands.title: Sanitation, Waste Management, and Personal Safety
subStrands.description: Sorting biodegradable and non-biodegradable waste, applying the 3Rs (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle), maintaining school and home sanitation, practicing proper hand hygiene, applying basic first aid for minor injuries, and observing personal safety.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Self-efficacy, environmental conservation, health literacy, problem solving

subStrands.title: Drawing and Coloring
subStrands.description: Exploring lines (straight, curved, wavy, zigzag), creating textures and patterns, drawing still-life objects from observation (fruits, calabashes, huts), and coloring neatly within boundaries.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Creativity and imagination, fine motor coordination, self-expression

subStrands.title: Painting and Mosaic / Collage
subStrands.description: Exploring primary colors (Red, Blue, Yellow), mixing secondary colors (Green, Orange, Purple), using paintbrushes and natural stamps, and creating mosaics/collages using paper cuttings, dry seeds, and fabric scraps.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Creativity, resourcefulness, color harmony, fine motor coordination

subStrands.title: Indigenous Crafts and Weaving
subStrands.description: Exploring traditional Kenyan weaving and plaiting with banana fibers, sisal twine, reeds, and paper strips, learning the over-and-under weaving structure, and practicing paper folding (origami).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Cultural heritage appreciation, manual dexterity, pattern recognition

subStrands.title: Modeling and Pottery
subStrands.description: Preparing clay by kneading and wedging, shaping hollow containers with the pinch pot and coil techniques, sculpting animal figurines, and adding incised decorative patterns.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Tactile perception, 3D spatial thinking, patience, craftsmanship

subStrands.title: Singing and Performance
subStrands.description: Practicing vocal warm-ups, performing patriotic anthems and soothing Kenyan lullabies, playing musical singing games, mastering diction, and exhibiting expressive stage confidence.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, self-expression, cultural appreciation, performing arts

subStrands.title: Rhythm, Tempo, and Kenyan Instruments
subStrands.description: Distinguishing steady beat from rhythm, exploring fast and slow tempo, recognizing pitch variations, and playing traditional instruments: drums (ngoma), kayamba, wind horns (abu), and stringed lyres (nyatiti).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Aural perception, motor coordination, cultural heritage, musicality

subStrands.title: Basic Locomotor and Non-Locomotor Movements
subStrands.description: Practicing locomotor traveling movements (running, skipping, hopping, galloping, dodging), non-locomotor stationary movements (stretching, twisting, balancing), gymnastics animal walks (crab walk, frog jump), and spatial awareness.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Body awareness, motor coordination, spatial navigation, physical fitness

subStrands.title: Ball Handling and Traditional Kenyan Games
subStrands.description: Developing ball handling fundamentals (two-handed catching, chest pass, instep kicking, foot dribbling), making improvised balls (bladder/sock balls), and playing traditional Kenyan games (kati, kibe, bano) with fair play.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Hand-eye coordination, sportsmanship, indigenous heritage, strategic thinking

subStrands.title: Physical Fitness, Health, and Water Safety
subStrands.description: Understanding dynamic warm-ups and cool-down routines, appreciating hydration and nutritious fuel for exercise, understanding rest and recovery, and observing essential safety around swimming pools, ponds, and swollen rivers.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Health literacy, risk management, self-care, water safety

subStrands.title: God’s Creation and My Body
subStrands.description: Discovering that God created each person uniquely in His image, appreciating the five body senses as special gifts, caring for our bodies, and stewarding God’s creation in nature.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Self-awareness, moral integrity, environmental stewardship

subStrands.title: The Bible as the Word of God
subStrands.description: Understanding the Holy Bible as God’s inspired guide, recognizing the Old Testament (39 books) and New Testament (27 books), handling the Bible with respect, the call of young Samuel, and David’s courageous faith in defeating Goliath.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Moral literacy, faith and courage, active listening, reverence

subStrands.title: The Birth and Baptism of Jesus
subStrands.description: Exploring the birth of Jesus Christ in Bethlehem, the angelic announcement to the shepherds, the visit of the Wise Men bearing gifts, the baptism of Jesus by John in River Jordan, and calling His first disciples.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spiritual growth, humility, devotion, fellowship

subStrands.title: Miracles and Teachings of Jesus
subStrands.description: Exploring the compassion and divine power of Jesus Christ: calming the storm on Lake Galilee, feeding the 5,000 with five loaves and two fish, and living out the Parable of the Good Samaritan.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Compassion, empathy, faith, social justice, critical thinking

subStrands.title: Forgiveness, Sharing, and Obedience
subStrands.description: Living in repentance and honesty through the story of Zacchaeus, practicing obedience to parents and teachers, sharing food and resources with orphans and the needy, and exercising daily forgiveness.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Integrity, social responsibility, empathy, conflict resolution

subStrands.title: Selected Surahs and the Holy Qur'an
subStrands.description: Reciting and understanding the themes of Surah Al-Fatihah (The Opening), Surah Al-Ikhlas (Purity of Faith), Surah Al-Falaq (The Daybreak), and Surah An-Nas (Mankind), and demonstrating proper etiquette when handling the Holy Qur'an.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spiritual grounding, recitation fluency, memorization, reverence

subStrands.title: Early Life and Character of Prophet Muhammad (SAW)
subStrands.description: Learning about the blessed birth of Prophet Muhammad (SAW) in Makkah, his parents Abdullah and Aminah, his foster mother Halimah As-Sa'diyyah, his grandfather Abdul Muttalib, his uncle Abu Talib, and his reputation for honesty as Al-Amin.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Role modeling, moral character, empathy, historical appreciation

subStrands.title: Islamic Etiquette and Daily Manners
subStrands.description: Practicing Islamic greetings of peace (Salam), dining manners (using the right hand, Bismillah, and Alhamdulillah), honoring parents (Birr al-Walidayn), and showing kindness and hospitality to neighbors.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Social cohesion, respect for elders, good citizenship, cultural etiquette

subStrands.title: Pillars of Islam, Wudhu, and Daily Salah
subStrands.description: Understanding the Five Pillars of Islam, performing step-by-step Wudhu (ritual ablution) in correct order, identifying the five obligatory daily prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha), their number of Rak'ahs, and timings.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Ritual discipline, hygiene, spiritual connection, time management

subStrands.title: Paramatma and Avatars
subStrands.description: Understanding Paramatma as the Supreme Being, the Trimurti (Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva), and the Avatars Rama and Krishna.

subStrands.title: Sacred Scriptures and Symbols
subStrands.description: Identifying holy Hindu scriptures including the Vedas, Ramayana, and Bhagavad Gita, and understanding sacred symbols like Aum, Swastika, and the Diya.

subStrands.title: Virtues, Sewa and Joyful Festivals
subStrands.description: Practicing essential Hindu virtues: Satya (truthfulness), Ahimsa (non-violence/kindness), Sewa (selfless community service), and celebrating joyful festivals like Diwali, Janmashtami, and Holi.

subStrands.title: Whole Numbers up to 10,000
subStrands.description: Place value and total value up to 10,000, reading and writing numbers in symbols and words, rounding off to nearest 10, and even and odd numbers.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Numeracy, analytical thinking, logical reasoning, and real-life resource counting

subStrands.title: Addition of Whole Numbers
subStrands.description: Adding 4-digit and 5-digit numbers without and with regrouping, and solving authentic addition word problems in Kenyan economic contexts.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Problem solving, critical thinking, financial and agricultural numeracy application

subStrands.title: Subtraction of Whole Numbers
subStrands.description: Subtracting 4-digit and 5-digit numbers without and with regrouping across zeros, and solving real-world subtraction problems in Kenyan economic settings.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Problem solving, critical thinking, inventory management, and resource stewardship

subStrands.title: Multiplication of 2-Digit Numbers
subStrands.description: Multiplying 2-digit numbers by 1-digit and 2-digit numbers, multiplying by multiples of 10, and solving real-world multiplication problems in Kenyan commerce and farming.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Problem solving, algorithmic thinking, financial numeracy, and agricultural business modeling

subStrands.title: Division of Whole Numbers
subStrands.description: Dividing 2-digit numbers by 1-digit numbers with and without remainders, relationship between multiplication and division, and practical sharing problems in Kenyan schools and shambas.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Problem solving, critical thinking, fair resource sharing, and mathematical reasoning

subStrands.title: Fractions: Proper, Equivalent & Comparing
subStrands.description: Identifying proper and improper fractions, finding equivalent fractions, comparing fractions with like and unlike denominators, and solving real-world sharing problems.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spatial reasoning, logical deduction, fair resource distribution, and proportional thinking

subStrands.title: Decimals: Introduction to Tenths
subStrands.description: Understanding tenths as fractions and decimals, decimal place value, reading, writing, comparing, and adding and subtracting tenths in Kenyan real-life measurements.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Scientific measurement, numerical precision, logical comparison, and data recording

subStrands.title: Length: Metres and Centimetres
subStrands.description: Measuring length using standard units (metres and centimetres), converting between m and cm, and adding, subtracting, and solving real-world length problems.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Practical measurement, spatial reasoning, construction numeracy, and accuracy

subStrands.title: Mass: Kilograms and Grams
subStrands.description: Measuring mass in kilograms (kg) and grams (g), converting between kg and g, understanding fractions of a kilogram, and solving addition and subtraction mass problems in Kenyan markets and farms.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Practical measurement, market numeracy, resource trade estimation, and precision

subStrands.title: Capacity: Litres and Millilitres
subStrands.description: Measuring liquid capacity in litres (l) and millilitres (ml), converting between l and ml, understanding fractions of a litre, and solving real-world capacity problems in Kenyan homes and agriculture.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Practical estimation, volume measurement, resource conservation, and scientific calculation

subStrands.title: Time: Reading Clocks and Time Intervals
subStrands.description: Reading analogue and digital clocks to the minute, converting between hours, minutes, and seconds, and calculating time intervals in everyday Kenyan life.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Punctuality, schedule management, daily planning, and temporal reasoning

subStrands.title: Kenyan Money: Budgeting, Change & Profit
subStrands.description: Recognizing Kenyan currency up to KES 1,000, preparing budgets, calculating change from transactions, and computing simple profit and loss in local markets.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Financial literacy, entrepreneurial thinking, budgeting prudence, and ethical commerce

subStrands.title: Area: Counting Unit Squares
subStrands.description: Understanding area as flat surface coverage, counting full and half unit squares on grids, calculating area of rectangles and squares, and solving area problems for garden beds, floors, and mats.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spatial visualization, agricultural planning, geometric calculation, and construction numeracy

subStrands.title: Volume: Counting Unit Cubes
subStrands.description: Understanding volume as 3D space occupancy, counting 1 cm³ unit cubes, and calculating volume of cubes and cuboids using Length × Width × Height.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spatial reasoning, 3D visualization, packaging numeracy, and engineering foundation

subStrands.title: Lines and Angles
subStrands.description: Identifying straight, curved, horizontal, vertical, parallel, and perpendicular lines, and recognizing right angles in Kenyan structures and environment.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Geometric visualization, architectural awareness, pattern recognition, and precision drawing

subStrands.title: 2D and 3D Shapes
subStrands.description: Identify, classify, and describe properties of two-dimensional shapes (triangles, squares, rectangles, circles) and three-dimensional objects (cubes, cuboids, cylinders, spheres, cones) in the Kenyan environment.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spatial reasoning, 2D and 3D geometric visualization, architectural appreciation

subStrands.title: Data Handling and Presentation
subStrands.description: Collecting real-life data, organizing using tally marks, preparing frequency tables, and creating and interpreting pictographs with scales.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Data analysis, statistical reasoning, organizational skills, critical thinking, and decision making

subStrands.title: You and Your School
subStrands.description: Recognizing common and proper nouns, using articles 'a', 'an', and 'the' accurately, practicing polite classroom introductions, and observing school regulations.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, self-efficacy, linguistic accuracy, and civic responsibility

subStrands.title: Family and Home
subStrands.description: Describing family relationships, using possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, our, their), mastering simple present tense for daily household routines, and appreciating shared family responsibilities.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication, self-awareness, empathy, cooperation, and core family values

subStrands.title: Etiquette and Good Manners
subStrands.description: Using polite expressions (please, thank you, excuse me, sorry, you are welcome), modal verbs for courteous requests (may, can, could), respectful telephone etiquette, and showing respect to peers and elders.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Communication and collaboration, citizenship, self-efficacy, moral integrity, and social etiquette

subStrands.title: Nutrition and Healthy Eating
subStrands.description: Differentiating countable and uncountable food nouns, applying quantifiers (many, much, a few, a little, some, any), and understanding balanced diet vocabulary in Kenyan homes.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Health education, scientific awareness, critical thinking, linguistic accuracy, and healthy lifestyle choices

subStrands.title: Wild Animals and Conservation
subStrands.description: Comparing animals using regular and irregular comparative and superlative adjectives, understanding wildlife conservation, and valuing Kenyan national parks and game reserves.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Environmental awareness, critical thinking, linguistic precision, empathy for living things, and civic responsibility

subStrands.title: Technology and Communication
subStrands.description: Using the past simple tense for regular (-ed/-d) and irregular verbs, exploring communication gadgets (smartphones, radio, TV, computers), and practicing safe digital citizenship.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Digital literacy, linguistic competence, critical thinking, internet safety, and self-regulation

subStrands.title: Road Safety and Travel
subStrands.description: Using prepositions of place and direction (across, along, over, into, through, opposite, between), understanding traffic rules, and practicing safe pedestrian and passenger habits in Kenya.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Citizenship, personal safety, critical thinking, spatial awareness, and community responsibility

subStrands.title: The Environment and Cleanliness
subStrands.description: Using the present continuous tense (is/are/am + verb-ing) for ongoing actions, using imperative sentences for environmental rules, and promoting clean communities and tree planting.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Environmental stewardship, linguistic accuracy, teamwork, civic responsibility, and healthy hygiene practices

subStrands.title: Occupations and Talents
subStrands.description: Using adverbs of manner (neatly, quickly, carefully, skillfully, well, hard), exploring various Kenyan careers and professions, and appreciating the dignity of labor and talent development.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Career awareness, self-efficacy, linguistic accuracy, creativity, and dignity of labor

subStrands.title: Children's Rights and Responsibilities
subStrands.description: Using conjunctions (and, but, because, so) to connect ideas, understanding constitutional children's rights and responsibilities, and composing friendly letters and guided paragraphs.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Citizenship, communication, civic participation, critical thinking, moral integrity, and social responsibility

subStrands.title: Usafi wa Mwili na Mavazi
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia msamiati wa usafi wa kibinafsi, viwakilishi nafsi (mimi, wewe, yeye, sisi, ninyi, wao), na upatanisho wa kisarufi katika ngeli ya A-WA.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Uwezo wa kuwasiliana, stadi za maisha, kujitambua, na kudumisha afya bora

subStrands.title: Familia Yetu
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia msamiati wa mahusiano katika familia ya kinasaba na ya kupanuka, pamoja na vivumishi viashiria (vionyeshi) na heshima ya kifamilia.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Uwezo wa kuwasiliana, stadi za kijamii na uhusiano mwema, uraia, na heshima katika jamii

subStrands.title: Shule Yetu
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia msamiati wa mazingira ya shule, vifaa vya masomo, majukumu ya viongozi wa shule, pamoja na kanuni za umoja na wingi katika ngeli mbalimbali.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Uwezo wa kuwasiliana, kujifunza kujifunza, uongozi, na utunzaji wa mali ya umma shuleni

subStrands.title: Mavazi na Vyakula vya Asili
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia msamiati wa mavazi ya kitamaduni na kisasa, vyakula asilia vya jamii mbalimbali nchini Kenya, pamoja na upatanisho wa kisarufi katika ngeli ya KI-VI.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Uzalendo, kuthamini tamaduni za Kenya, mawasiliano, na ulaji wa vyakula vyenye lishe

subStrands.title: Afya na Lishe Bora
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia msamiati wa afya, mlo kamili, magonjwa na kinga, pamoja na matumizi sahihi ya vitenzi na nyakati: wakati uliopo (-na-), uliopita (-li-), na ujao (-ta-).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Uwezo wa kuwasiliana, stadi za maisha, kujitambua, na kukuza mtindo wa maisha wenye afya na lishe bora

subStrands.title: Sokoni na Biashara
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia msamiati wa shughuli za kibiashara sokoni, matumizi ya pesa za Kenya, mizani na vipimo, pamoja na upatanisho sahihi wa ngeli ya LI-YA.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Uwezo wa kuwasiliana, stadi za kifedha na biashara, utatuzi wa matatizo, na uaminifu

subStrands.title: Wanyamapori na Utalii
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia msamiati wa wanyamapori, hifadhi za kitaifa, faida za utalii nchini Kenya na utunzaji wa wanyama, pamoja na vivumishi vya sifa na upatanisho wake wa kisarufi.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Uzalendo, uhifadhi wa mazingira na wanyamapori, mawasiliano, na stadi za utafiti

subStrands.title: Mazingira Yetu na Upandaji Miti
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia msamiati wa uhifadhi wa mazingira, upandaji miti, kitalu cha miche, kuzuia mmomonyoko wa udongo, pamoja na kauli ya kutenda na kutendwa katika vitenzi.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Uhifadhi wa mazingira, uzalendo, uwajibikaji kijamii, na utatuzi wa changamoto za ukame na mabadiliko ya hali ya anga

subStrands.title: Usafiri na Usalama Barabarani
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia msamiati wa vyombo vya usafiri nchini Kenya, sheria za usalama barabarani, na vihusishi vya mahali na mwelekeo katika sentensi sahihi.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Uwezo wa kuwasiliana, stadi za maisha, kujitambua na kujilinda, uraia, na utii wa sheria

subStrands.title: Haki za Watoto na Ushirikiano
subStrands.description: Kutambua na kutumia msamiati wa haki na wajibu wa mtoto nchini Kenya, matumizi ya viunganishi vya kisarufi (lakini, kwa sababu, ingawa, kwa hivyo), na muundo wa uandishi wa barua ya kirafiki.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Uraia, mawasiliano na ushirikiano, utatuzi wa migogoro, na uelewa wa Katiba ya Kenya na haki za binadamu

subStrands.title: Living Things: Plants & Fungi
subStrands.description: Identify and classify plants into flowering and non-flowering, examine fungi such as mushrooms and mould, and practice safety precautions when handling unfamiliar plants and fungi.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Scientific inquiry, critical thinking, environmental conservation, and safety consciousness

subStrands.title: Living Things: Animals
subStrands.description: Classify animals into vertebrates (mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish) and invertebrates (insects, spiders, worms, snails), observe external body coverings, and practice safety around stinging animals.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Scientific classification, observation skills, empathy for living creatures, and safety awareness

subStrands.title: Human Body: Teeth & Dental Hygiene
subStrands.description: Identify the four types of human teeth, describe their functions, understand shedding and replacement of milk teeth, and practice effective dental hygiene.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Self-awareness, personal hygiene, scientific inquiry, and healthy lifestyle choices

subStrands.title: Human Body: Digestive System
subStrands.description: Identify the main organs of the human digestive system, describe their functions in the digestion and absorption of nutrients, and adopt healthy dietary habits that support digestive health.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Scientific inquiry, self-awareness, critical thinking, and promoting personal health and nutrition

subStrands.title: Environment & Health: Pollution
subStrands.description: Identify types of environmental pollution (air, water, soil, noise), investigate their sources and harmful effects on living things, and adopt pollution control practices including the 3Rs (Reduce, Reuse, Recycle).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Environmental stewardship, scientific inquiry, community responsibility, and problem-solving

subStrands.title: Environment & Health: Water & Conservation
subStrands.description: Examine the vital uses and natural sources of water, design water conservation strategies, and construct simple sand-charcoal filters to purify drinking water.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Scientific problem-solving, environmental conservation, innovation, and critical thinking

subStrands.title: Digital Technology: Devices & Components
subStrands.description: Identify and categorize common digital devices, explore the main hardware components of a computer system (input, processing, output, and storage), and demonstrate safe care and handling of technology tools.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Digital literacy, critical thinking, technological innovation, and self-efficacy

subStrands.title: Digital Technology: Online Safety & Interaction
subStrands.description: Navigate digital applications (word processing, drawing, camera), develop typing and mouse skills, and master internet safety principles including protecting passwords, identifying cyberbullying, and practicing digital ergonomics.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Digital literacy, cyber hygiene, self-protection, communication, and ethical decision-making

subStrands.title: States of Matter: Solids, Liquids & Gases
subStrands.description: Identify and classify common substances into solids, liquids, and gases based on observable properties; investigate changes of state including melting, freezing, evaporation, and condensation through heat transfer; and apply these concepts to everyday Kenyan practical situations.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Scientific inquiry, critical thinking, observation, practical experimentation, and environmental application

subStrands.title: Force & Simple Machines
subStrands.description: Explore forces in the immediate environment including pushes, pulls, friction, and gravity; investigate how forces change the motion, speed, direction, and shape of objects; construct and use simple machines such as levers, inclined planes, and wheelbarrows to make work easier while maintaining strict tool safety.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, problem solving, scientific investigation, manipulation of simple machines, safety consciousness, and practical collaboration

subStrands.title: Soil Conservation & Organic Compost
subStrands.description: Investigate soil composition in agricultural soils, identify causes and prevention of soil erosion in shambas, and prepare organic compost manure using kitchen and farm waste to restore soil fertility.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Environmental conservation, sustainable farming, critical thinking, practical farmwork, and resource recycling

subStrands.title: Water Conservation in the Shamba
subStrands.description: Explore methods of conserving water in crop farming including drip irrigation using perforated plastic bottles, mulching to reduce evaporation, shaded nursery canopies, rainwater harvesting from roofs, and timing watering routines.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Environmental conservation, water stewardship, problem-solving, innovation, and practical gardening

subStrands.title: Nursery Beds & Seedling Preparation
subStrands.description: Prepare fine-tilth nursery beds, sow tiny vegetable seeds (sukuma wiki, spinach, cabbage, tomatoes, onions), practice watering, weeding, thinning, shading, and hardening off seedlings prior to transplanting.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Agricultural practical competence, critical observation, patience, self-reliance, and sustainable horticulture

subStrands.title: Crop Care & Vegetable Production
subStrands.description: Transplant hardened seedlings from nursery to main seedbed; practice correct plant spacing, watering, weeding, mulching, earthing up, natural pest scouting, and harvesting indigenous vegetables (sukuma wiki, spinach, terere, managu).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Practical farming skills, environmental observation, patience, agro-ecological management, and nutrition awareness

subStrands.title: Innovative Gardening & Container Gardening
subStrands.description: Design and manage innovative vertical and container micro-gardens—including sack gardens, used tyres, hanging plastic bottles, and wooden crates—enabling households with small or urban spaces to produce fresh vegetables.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Creativity, environmental conservation, waste recycling, practical problem-solving, and urban food security

subStrands.title: Domestic Animals: Types, Uses & Handling
subStrands.description: Identify common domestic animals in Kenyan homesteads (cattle, sheep, goats, poultry, rabbits, donkeys, pigs); explore their economic and domestic uses (milk, meat, eggs, wool, draught power, farmyard manure); and practice gentle, humane handling.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Animal empathy, responsible stewardship, agricultural resourcefulness, safety consciousness, and economic appreciation

subStrands.title: Animal Care: Feeding, Housing & Health
subStrands.description: Investigate basic requirements of domestic animals: balanced feeding (pasture, forage, hay, concentrates, water), hygienic animal housing (sheds, coops, hutches), sanitation, parasite control (ticks, fleas), and routine health checks.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Animal welfare, environmental sanitation, responsibility, practical construction awareness, and veterinary hygiene

subStrands.title: Food Nutrients & Balanced Diet
subStrands.description: Classify foods into energy-giving, body-building, and protective nutrient groups; design balanced family meals using authentic Kenyan foods; and understand the role of water, roughage, and nutrition in preventing deficiency diseases.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Health consciousness, nutritional decision-making, critical thinking, empathy, and cultural appreciation of traditional Kenyan foods

subStrands.title: Hygienic Food Handling & Simple Cooking Methods
subStrands.description: Demonstrate strict kitchen and personal hygiene (handwashing, washing vegetables before chopping, clean aprons, clean work surfaces); practice healthy cooking methods (boiling, steaming, baking in embers) that preserve vital food nutrients; and adhere to kitchen fire and knife safety rules.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Food safety, personal hygiene, self-reliance, practical culinary competence, and kitchen accident prevention

subStrands.title: Food Storage, Preservation & Waste Reduction
subStrands.description: Investigate causes of food spoilage (bacteria, moulds, moisture, weevils); demonstrate traditional and modern preservation methods (sun-drying grains and vegetables, smoking fish, airtight hermetic PICS bags, cooling); explore hygienic granary storage; and practice reducing household food waste.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Food security consciousness, environmental sustainability, resourcefulness, critical evaluation, and waste reduction

subStrands.title: Cardinal Points & Maps of the County
subStrands.description: Identify the 4 cardinal points (North, South, East, West) and 4 intermediate points (NE, SE, NW, SW); use the rising and setting sun and compasses to tell direction; identify elements of a map (title, frame, key/legend, compass rose, scale); and draw simple sketch maps of the school and county.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spatial awareness, map reading, observation, critical thinking, and geographical inquiry

subStrands.title: Physical Features in the County
subStrands.description: Identify relief features (mountains, hills, plains, valleys) and drainage features (rivers, lakes, swamps, oceans) in Kenyan counties; explain their economic and ecological importance; understand how they influence human settlements and activities; and practice environmental conservation of land and water bodies.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Geographical inquiry, environmental conservation, critical observation, spatial analysis, and resource stewardship

subStrands.title: Weather and Climate in the County
subStrands.description: Examine elements of weather (rainfall, temperature, wind, sunshine, cloud cover); operate and interpret weather recording instruments (rain gauge, thermometer, wind vane, windsock); distinguish between daily weather and long-term climate; analyze Kenyan rainfall seasons (long rains and short rains); and assess the impact of weather conditions on agriculture, shelter, and daily living.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Scientific observation, meteorological inquiry, data interpretation, critical thinking, and climate awareness

subStrands.title: Historic Origins & Communities of Kenya
subStrands.description: Identify the main language families in Kenya (Bantu, Nilotes, Cushites); examine their areas of origin and historical migration routes; analyze reasons for migration into Kenya; identify where communities settled across the 47 counties; and celebrate unity in diversity.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Historical inquiry, cultural appreciation, critical analysis, empathy, and national cohesion

subStrands.title: Cultural Heritage & Traditional Artifacts
subStrands.description: Explore the meaning and components of culture (customary foods, attire, folk songs, traditional dwellings, rites of passage); classify indigenous artifacts (cooking utensils, hunting tools, defense weapons, musical instruments, beadwork ornaments); and understand methods of preserving our cultural heritage through elders, cultural centres (Bomas of Kenya), and the National Museums of Kenya.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Cultural appreciation, creativity, historical inquiry, critical evaluation, and national pride

subStrands.title: Economic Activities: Agriculture & Farming
subStrands.description: Differentiate subsistence crop farming from commercial cash crop farming; identify primary food crops and cash crops grown across Kenya's climatic zones; examine dairy and beef cattle, poultry, and camel livestock systems; analyze agriculture's vital contribution to county food security and GDP; and evaluate solutions to farming challenges like drought and pests.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Economic inquiry, agricultural awareness, critical thinking, problem-solving, and entrepreneurial mindset

subStrands.title: Trade, Markets & Enterprise
subStrands.description: Explore the evolution of trade from barter exchange to modern monetary transactions using Kenyan Shillings and mobile money (M-Pesa); identify categories of trading centres (rural open-air markets, roadside kiosks, wholesale centres, supermarkets); evaluate how trade generates wealth and county tax revenue; and practice fundamental financial literacy (budgeting, saving, consumer rights, and business ethics).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Financial literacy, entrepreneurial thinking, mathematical reasoning, critical judgment, and civic awareness

subStrands.title: Transport & Communication in Kenya
subStrands.description: Examine road, railway (Madaraka Express / SGR), water (Likoni Ferry, Lake Victoria dhows), and air transport networks; master pedestrian road safety signs, zebra crossings, and traffic lights; trace the progression of communication from traditional horns, smoke, and drums to cellular smartphones, community radio, and the internet; and appreciate how transport and connectivity propel the national economy.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Safety consciousness, technological literacy, critical observation, geographical orientation, and civic responsibility

subStrands.title: County Leadership & Governance
subStrands.description: Examine the two arms of County Government under the Constitution of Kenya 2010 (County Executive led by Governor and County Assembly led by Speaker); analyze responsibilities of Members of County Assembly (MCAs) and County Executive Committee (CEC) members; differentiate devolved county government from national administration (County Commissioner, Chiefs); identify benchmarks of exemplary ethical leadership; and participate in school democracy.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Civic competence, leadership qualities, critical governance analysis, decision-making, and public participation

subStrands.title: Citizenship, National Symbols & Child Rights
subStrands.description: Understand the concept of citizenship and pathways to acquiring Kenyan citizenship (by birth or registration); decode Kenya's sacred National Symbols (the National Flag and its four colors, the National Anthem stanzas, the Coat of Arms, and Public Seal); articulate the constitutional rights of Kenyan children (education, healthcare, shelter, safety from neglect and child labour); fulfill child responsibilities at home and school; and embody national patriotism.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Citizenship awareness, constitutional literacy, human rights advocacy, patriotism, and moral responsibility

subStrands.title: Drawing, Shading & Still Life
subStrands.description: Master elements of art in drawing (line, shape, form, texture, tonal value); execute pencil shading techniques including cross-hatching, stippling, smudging, and circular shading; arrange and draw still life compositions of authentic Kenyan objects (calabashes, clay cooking pots, mangoes, bananas); and illustrate light source, highlights, mid-tones, and cast shadows to produce three-dimensional realism.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Creativity and imagination, visual-spatial reasoning, aesthetic appreciation, fine motor coordination, and critical evaluation

subStrands.title: Painting, Color Mixing & Collage / Mosaic
subStrands.description: Explore color theory (primary, secondary, and tertiary colors); mix colors systematically on a palette; differentiate warm colors from cool colors; apply brushwork techniques using poster colors and natural pigments; and produce imaginative collage and mosaic artworks utilizing discarded paper scraps, eggshells, seeds, and fabric cut-outs.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Creativity and imagination, visual inquiry, environmental stewardship, motor dexterity, and cultural expression

subStrands.title: Clay Modeling, Pottery & Sculpting
subStrands.description: Harvest and process natural clay from local riverbanks (slaking, kneading, and wedging to eliminate trapped air bubbles); practice hand-building techniques including pinch pots, coil building, and slab construction; sculpt expressive three-dimensional figures of Kenyan domestic animals and wildlife; decorate surfaces through incising, stamping, and pebble burnishing; and follow safe slow shade-drying and firing methods.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Creativity and imagination, fine motor control, tactile sensitivity, cultural appreciation, and patience

subStrands.title: Indigenous Crafts: Weaving, Leatherwork & Beadwork
subStrands.description: Explore Kenya's rich cultural crafts; master plain weave interlacing (warp and weft threads) on cardboard and wooden frame looms using sisal, banana fibres, and reeds; weave traditional baskets (kiondo) and floor mats (mkeka); thread authentic indigenous beadwork (bracelets and neck collars) decoding color symbolism (Maasai, Samburu, Turkana); practice leather punching and thonging; and appreciate the commercial livelihood of Kenyan cottage handicrafts.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Creativity and innovation, cultural heritage appreciation, fine motor dexterity, entrepreneurial thinking, and patience

subStrands.title: Rhythm, Pitch & Singing Kenyan Folk Songs
subStrands.description: Explore the building blocks of music (pitch, rhythm, tempo, dynamics); practice pitch matching and hand signs using sol-fa syllables (doh, ray, me, fah, soh); maintain proper vocal hygiene and diaphragmatic breath support; categorize songs by social function (lullabies, heroic warrior chants, work songs, patriotic hymns); perform authentic Kenyan folk songs in call-and-response style; and exhibit stage etiquette.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Musical expression, auditory discrimination, cultural appreciation, collaboration, and self-confidence

subStrands.title: Traditional Musical Instruments & Folk Dance Performance
subStrands.description: Classify traditional Kenyan musical instruments into membranophones (drums like Isukuti and Chapuo), chordophones (string instruments like Nyatiti, Wandindi, and Obokano), aerophones (wind instruments like Coro and Bung'o), and idiophones (self-sounding percussion like Kayamba and Njuga); demonstrate instrument care and tuning; choreograph indigenous folk dances (Chakacha, Isukuti, Kilumi, Kamabeka); execute dynamic spatial dance formations (circle, line, serpentine); and assemble authentic traditional costumes, headgear, and body ornaments.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Cultural appreciation, bodily-kinesthetic expression, musicality, collaboration, and national identity

subStrands.title: Athletics: Track, Field & Relay Running
subStrands.description: Master sprint running techniques (crouch start commands: 'On your marks', 'Set', whistle/gun; forward lean, high knee drive, vigorous arm swings); practice 4 x 100m relay running and seamless baton handovers (upsweep and downsweep passes within the 20-metre changeover zone); learn middle-distance aerobic pacing inspired by Kenyan athletic legends (Eliud Kipchoge, Faith Kipyegon); practice standing long jump and soft-ball throw; and observe sports safety (warm-ups, cooling down, hydration, and fair play).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Physical agility, cardiovascular endurance, speed, spatial awareness, teamwork, and fair play

subStrands.title: Ball Games & Team Sports (Football, Netball, Volleyball)
subStrands.description: Develop ball handling and game execution in Kenya's primary team sports: Football (dribbling using inside and outside of feet, instep passing, trapping, goalkeeping, throw-ins, offside and fouls); Netball (chest pass, bounce pass, overhead shoulder pass, footwork rule, pivoting, goal shooting); Volleyball (underhand serve, forearm bump pass, overhead setting, court positioning); indigenous target and evasion ball games (Kati); and foster team communication and fair play.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Eye-hand-foot coordination, strategic teamwork, motor agility, decision-making, and emotional resilience

subStrands.title: Gymnastics, Rope Skipping & Water / Swimming Safety
subStrands.description: Execute educational gymnastics movements (static one-point and two-point balances, forward rolls on padded mats, pencil rolls, bunny hops over low obstacles); develop cardiovascular endurance and timing through individual and paired rope skipping routines; master lifesaving water safety rules around Kenyan rivers, lakes, dams, and swimming pools; learn flutter kicks and arm actions; and practice dry-land rescue techniques (reach or throw, never go in).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Bodily-kinesthetic coordination, water safety consciousness, cardiovascular stamina, spatial discipline, and self-preservation

subStrands.title: My Purpose, God-Given Talents & Emotional Well-Being
subStrands.description: Appreciating human uniqueness as created in the image of God; identifying God-given gifts, abilities, and talents; using talents responsibly to serve family, school, and community; expressing and managing strong emotions (anger, fear, jealousy, sadness) through prayer, self-control, and biblical guidance.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Self-awareness, emotional intelligence, moral integrity, citizenship, empathy, and interpersonal communication

subStrands.title: Caring for God’s Creation & Environmental Stewardship
subStrands.description: Recognizing God as the Creator of the natural world; understanding human responsibility to care for plants, domestic animals, wildlife, soil, and water bodies; engaging in practical conservation activities such as planting indigenous trees, avoiding plastic litter, conserving water, and protecting Kenya's rich wildlife heritage.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Environmental stewardship, social responsibility, critical thinking, problem solving, citizenship, and practical leadership

subStrands.title: Divisions, Structure & Reverence for the Holy Bible
subStrands.description: Understanding the Holy Bible as the inspired word of God; mastering its two main testaments: Old Testament (39 books) and New Testament (27 books, totaling 66 books); identifying major literary groups of books (Law/Pentateuch, Historical books, Poetic books, Prophetic books, the 4 Gospels, Epistles, Revelation); handling and preserving the printed Bible with reverence; using chapter and verse references to locate scriptures.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Moral literacy, communication, critical thinking, active listening, respect for sacred texts, and digital-textual literacy

subStrands.title: Heroes of Faith: Moses, Ruth, and David
subStrands.description: Studying key Old Testament faith models and their courageous obedience to God: Moses’ early life in Egypt, his encounter with God at the burning bush in Exodus 3, and his obedience in leading the Israelites; Ruth’s loyalty, selfless love, and devotion to Naomi (Ruth 1:16); young David’s faith, courage against the Philistine giant Goliath (1 Samuel 17), and his repentance when he made mistakes.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Moral courage, loyalty, integrity, resilience, leadership, and emotional resilience

subStrands.title: Life, Ministry, and Teachings of Jesus Christ
subStrands.description: Exploring the birth and boyhood of Jesus; His baptism by John in the River Jordan; His calling of the disciples; compassionate miracles (calming the storm on Lake Galilee, healing the paralyzed man lowered through the roof, feeding the 5,000); understanding His Kingdom parables (The Sower, The Good Samaritan, The Lost Sheep); practicing the Golden Rule and Christ-like compassion.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Compassion, empathy, active listening, moral reasoning, social responsibility, critical thinking, and peace building

subStrands.title: Selected Surahs (Al-Fil, Quraysh, Al-Ma'un, Al-Kawthar) & Mushaf Reverence
subStrands.description: Reciting, memorizing, and understanding the core themes and moral teachings of Surah Al-Fil (The Elephant and Abraha's army), Surah Quraysh (security, sustenance, and gratitude to Allah), Surah Al-Ma'un (condemnation of hypocrisy, neglecting orphans, and refusing small neighborly assistance), and Surah Al-Kawthar (Allah's abundant favor and devotion); understanding proper etiquette (Adab) in handling and reciting the Holy Qur'an with Taharah (purity).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Moral literacy, communication, active listening, respect for sacred scripture, empathy, and social responsibility

subStrands.title: Youth of the Prophet (SAW), Al-Amin & Marriage to Khadijah (RA)
subStrands.description: Studying the noble childhood and youth of Prophet Muhammad (SAW): early foster life in the desert with Halimah As-Sa'diyyah; his grandfather Abdul Muttalib and uncle Abu Talib caring for him; the commercial trade trip to Syria and meeting monk Bahira; earning the revered titles of As-Sadiq (The Truthful) and Al-Amin (The Trustworthy); successful trade expedition to Syria managing the merchandise of Sayyidatna Khadijah (RA) assisted by Maysarah; and marriage to noble lady Khadijah (RA).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Integrity, financial honesty, moral character, respect for elders, loyalty, and peaceful dispute resolution

subStrands.title: Hadith and Moral Conduct: Truthfulness, Cleanliness (Taharah) & Respect for Parents
subStrands.description: Understanding Hadith on truthfulness (Sidq leads to righteousness and Paradise; lying leads to wickedness and Hellfire); controlling speech and avoiding backbiting (Ghibah) and name-calling; personal and environmental cleanliness (Taharah is half of faith - Sunan an-Nasa'i); honoring and obeying parents (Birr al-Walidayn) according to Surah Al-Isra (17:23-24); practicing polite Islamic greetings (Salam) and manners when eating and drinking.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Moral integrity, self-discipline, hygiene, empathy, interpersonal communication, respect for diversity, and filial piety

subStrands.title: Pillars of Iman and Daily Worship: Wudhu, Salah Steps & Jam'ah
subStrands.description: Mastering the Six Pillars of Iman (Belief in Allah, Angels, Books, Messengers, Day of Judgment, and Divine Decree/Qadar); conditions and nullifiers of Wudhu (passing wind, answering call of nature, deep sleep); the five daily obligatory prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) and their Rak'ah counts; proper physical postures of Salah (Takbirat al-Ihram, Qiyam, Ruku', Sujud, Jalsah, Tashahhud, Taslim); the importance and virtues of congregational prayer (Salat al-Jama'ah) in the mosque.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spiritual development, self-discipline, time management, communal cohesion, body awareness, and civic harmony

subStrands.title: Paramatma and the Divine Avatars
subStrands.description: Understanding Paramatma as the supreme divine reality; exploring the cosmic Trimurti (Brahma the Creator, Vishnu the Preserver, and Shiva the Transformer); discovering the purpose of Avatars in upholding Dharma (righteousness); studying key narratives of Matsya (the Fish Avatar), Kurma (the Tortoise Avatar), Lord Rama (epic Ramayana), and Lord Krishna.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spiritual awareness, moral reasoning, respect for sacred traditions, critical thinking, cultural appreciation, and environmental harmony

subStrands.title: Sacred Scriptures and Symbols
subStrands.description: Exploring the foundational Hindu scriptures: the Four Vedas (Rigveda, Samaveda, Yajurveda, Atharvaveda), the Upanishads, the epics (Ramayana and Mahabharata), and the divine song Bhagavad Gita; learning sacred symbols: Aum (the primordial cosmic vibration), Swastika (symbol of auspiciousness and cosmic harmony), Deepak/Diya (the earthen lamp dispelling ignorance), and the Lotus (Padma—symbol of purity).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Textual literacy, aesthetic appreciation, spiritual mindfulness, symbolic reasoning, and cultural heritage

subStrands.title: Sadachar (Virtues), Sewa & Joyful Festivals
subStrands.description: Practicing noble virtues (Sadachar): Satya (Truthfulness), Ahimsa (Non-violence in thought, word, and deed), Daya (Compassion for all living beings), and Sewa (Selfless service to humanity, animals, and nature); celebrating major Hindu festivals with unity and joy: Diwali / Deepavali (the Festival of Lights), Holi (the joyful festival of colors and forgiveness), and Raksha Bandhan (celebrating the sacred bond between brothers and sisters).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Moral integrity, empathy, non-violence, civic engagement, cultural appreciation, and family solidarity

subStrands.title: Whole Numbers: Place Value, Rounding & Roman Numerals
subStrands.description: Counting, reading, and writing numbers up to 1,000,000 in symbols and words; identifying place value and total value of digits in numbers up to 1,000,000; rounding off large numbers to the nearest tens, hundreds, thousands, and ten thousands; reading and writing Roman numerals up to C (100) using addition and subtraction principles (I, V, X, L, C).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mathematical reasoning, numeracy, digital literacy, critical thinking, and problem solving

subStrands.title: Addition and Subtraction of Whole Numbers up to 6 Digits
subStrands.description: Performing addition of up to 6-digit numbers with and without regrouping; performing subtraction of up to 6-digit numbers with and without regrouping; solving multi-step word problems involving real-life Kenyan situations such as coffee cooperative revenues, school textbook distribution, road construction budgets, and tree planting campaigns; estimating sums and differences using rounding off.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Financial literacy, critical thinking, problem solving, computational accuracy, and communication

subStrands.title: Multiplication and Division of Whole Numbers
subStrands.description: Multiplying up to 3-digit numbers by 2-digit numbers using standard long multiplication and distributive methods; dividing up to 4-digit numbers by 2-digit numbers with and without remainders; interpreting quotients and remainders in everyday Kenyan situations (packaging avocado crates, distributing seedlings, calculating bus seats); estimating products and quotients.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Computational agility, critical thinking, problem solving, financial calculation, and logical reasoning

subStrands.title: Divisibility Tests, Factors, Multiples, GCD & LCM
subStrands.description: Applying divisibility tests for 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, and 10; identifying prime and composite numbers up to 100; finding prime factors of numbers using factor trees; calculating the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) / Highest Common Factor (HCF); calculating the Least Common Multiple (LCM); solving practical word problems involving sharing into equal groups and synchronizing repeating cycles (e.g. traffic lights, church bells, farming intervals).
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Critical thinking, pattern recognition, mathematical inquiry, problem solving, and analytical reasoning

subStrands.title: Fractions: Operations and Problem Solving
subStrands.description: Understanding proper, improper fractions and mixed numbers; converting between improper fractions and mixed numbers; equivalent fractions and simplification; comparing and ordering fractions; addition and subtraction of fractions with like and unlike denominators and mixed numbers; multiplying whole numbers and fractions by fractions; solving real-world Kenyan word problems involving land partitions, dairy cooperatives, and food recipe measurements.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Mathematical reasoning, proportional thinking, critical problem solving, computational accuracy, and resource sharing

subStrands.title: Decimals and Percentages
subStrands.description: Identifying decimal place values up to thousandths; reading, writing, and comparing decimal numbers; converting fractions to decimals and decimals to fractions; adding and subtracting decimals up to 3 decimal places; multiplying decimals by whole numbers and powers of 10; understanding percentages as hundredths; converting between percentages, fractions, and decimals; calculating discounts, SACCO deposits, and percentages in authentic Kenyan daily life.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Financial literacy, numeracy, analytical reasoning, estimation, and practical problem solving

subStrands.title: Length, Perimeter, and Area
subStrands.description: Converting units of length (mm, cm, m, km); measuring and calculating perimeter of regular polygons, triangles, rectangles, and composite shapes; calculating area of squares and rectangles using standard formulas (A = l × w); estimating area using grid squares; solving authentic Kenyan practical problems involving shamba fencing, sports fields (such as Nyayo or Kasarani), and floor tile installation.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Spatial reasoning, measurement accuracy, environmental planning, estimation, and problem solving

subStrands.title: Volume, Capacity, and Mass
subStrands.description: Calculating volume of cubes and cuboids using unit cubes and formula (V = l × w × h); converting units of capacity (litres, millilitres) and linking capacity to volume (1 litre = 1,000 cm³); converting units of mass (grams, kilograms, tonnes); solving practical Kenyan scenarios involving dairy processing, domestic rainwater harvesting tanks, tea harvest weighing, and commercial transport loads.
subStrands.cbeCompetency: Scientific measurement, quantitative analysis, resource conservation, and agricultural numeracy

subStrands.title: Time, Travel, and Financial Literacy
subStrands.description: Converting between 12-hour and 24-hour clock systems; calculating time intervals and travel durations; interpreting transport timetables (SGR Madaraka Express, matatus, domestic flights); calculating buying price, selling price, profit, and loss in Kenyan Shillings (KES); preparing simple family budgets and understanding SACCO savings.
