questions.socraticHint: Should you give strangers on the internet your physical location?

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses the irregular past tense correctly:

options.text: Amina spoke to her grandmother in Kisumu last Sunday.
Amina speaked to her grandmother in Kisumu last Sunday.
Amina was speak to her grandmother in Kisumu last Sunday.
Amina spoked to her grandmother in Kisumu last Sunday.

questions.correctAnswer: Amina spoke to her grandmother in Kisumu last Sunday.
questions.explanation: 'Spoke' is the correct past tense of 'speak'.
questions.socraticHint: What is the past form of 'speak': 'speaked' or 'spoke'?

questions.prompt: Arrange these actions in the chronological order of sending an email message:
orderingItems: The recipient read the email yesterday
questions.correctAnswer: Compose the email draft, Click the send button, The recipient read the email yesterday
questions.explanation: Drafting precedes sending, which precedes the recipient reading the message.
questions.socraticHint: First write the message, then send it, and then it is read.

questions.prompt: Which verb form completes the sentence: 'Yesterday, the headteacher ____ to the school assembly about cyber safety.'?

questions.prompt: Wanjiku ____ her school digital tablet carefully inside her padded backpack.
questions.explanation: 'Kept' is the irregular past tense of 'keep'.
questions.socraticHint: What is the past form of 'keep': 'kept' or 'keeped'?

questions.prompt: Baraka uses a tablet to complete 30 minutes of math practice on Jifuno every afternoon. His mother is pleased because Baraka is:

options.text: Refusing to do his household chores
Using technology responsibly for education and self-improvement
Playing violent video games all night

questions.correctAnswer: Using technology responsibly for education and self-improvement
questions.explanation: Using digital tools with moderation for academic practice exemplifies responsible digital citizenship.
questions.socraticHint: What is the positive, productive way to use digital learning apps?

questions.prompt: How many 50-shilling notes make 200 shillings?

questions.socraticHint: Count by fifties: 50, 100, 150...

questions.explanation: 'Across' means moving from one side of a road or surface to the other side.

questions.explanation: 'Across' means going from one side to the other. 'Along' means following beside the length of the road.
questions.socraticHint: Does 'along' mean walking in a line beside the road, or crossing over it?

matchingPairs.rightText: from one side of the road to the other
following beside the edge of the road
passing inside a tunnel or gate

questions.prompt: In Kenya's Great Rift Valley, the Standard Gauge Railway (SGR) train enters a dark mountain passage and comes out on the other side. Which sentence correctly describes this motion?

options.text: The train travelled over the tunnel.
The train travelled across the tunnel.
The train travelled into the tunnel and stayed stuck.
The train travelled through the tunnel.

questions.correctAnswer: The train travelled through the tunnel.

questions.prompt: True or False: In the sentence 'The duka is opposite the health dispensary', 'opposite' means the two buildings face each other from across the street.

Look right, look left, and look right again
Walk smartly across when the road is clear
questions.correctAnswer: Stop at the curb of the zebra crossing, Look right, look left, and look right again, Walk smartly across when the road is clear

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses the preposition 'along' correctly:

options.text: Children should walk through the pavement, away from speeding vehicles.
Children should walk along the pavement, away from speeding vehicles.
Children should walk into the pavement, away from speeding vehicles.
Children should walk over the pavement, away from speeding vehicles.

questions.correctAnswer: Children should walk along the pavement, away from speeding vehicles.
questions.explanation: Walking 'along the pavement' means walking in the direction following the sidewalk path.

questions.socraticHint: What action does a red traffic light demand?

questions.socraticHint: Is it safer to see vehicles coming toward you or have them approach from behind your back?

questions.socraticHint: What hard protective gear do motorcycle riders wear on their heads?

questions.prompt: What does the AMBER (yellow) light at a traffic signal instruct drivers to do?

questions.correctAnswer: Get ready to stop or prepare to move with caution
questions.explanation: Amber warns drivers to prepare to stop if safe, or get ready to proceed with caution.

questions.prompt: Match each traffic light color to its official traffic meaning:

questions.explanation: Red = stop; Amber = ready/caution; Green = go; Zebra stripes = pedestrian right of way.
questions.socraticHint: Match each color and road symbol to its official safety meaning.

questions.prompt: Kamau boards an express bus from Nakuru to Eldoret. Before the driver starts moving, what vital safety action must Kamau take?

options.text: Open the window and lean outside
Stand up in the middle of the bus aisle
Fasten his seatbelt securely across his chest

questions.correctAnswer: Fasten his seatbelt securely across his chest
questions.explanation: Buckling seatbelts is a critical passenger safety habit that prevents injury during sudden braking or collisions.
questions.socraticHint: What safety strap keeps you safe in your vehicle seat?

questions.prompt: True or False: It is completely safe and permitted for children to play football near the edges of a busy road.
questions.explanation: Playing near roadways is extremely dangerous because a rolling ball or running child can be struck by fast-moving traffic.
questions.socraticHint: Should children play ball games beside speeding cars?

questions.prompt: Why are designated pedestrian street crossings called 'zebra crossings'?

options.text: Because the painted black and white stripes look like zebra patterns
Because zebras frequently cross roads there
Because the paint is made from wild animals
Because drivers only slow down for animals

questions.correctAnswer: Because the painted black and white stripes look like zebra patterns
questions.explanation: The alternating white and black bands painted on the tarmac resemble the stripe pattern of a zebra.
questions.socraticHint: What animal has alternating black and white stripes?

questions.prompt: Arrange the traffic light sequence in order before stopped vehicles move forward:
questions.explanation: Traffic signals change from red (stop) to amber (prepare) to green (proceed).
questions.socraticHint: Start with stop, then prepare, then go.

questions.prompt: Which passenger behavior in a matatu is extremely dangerous and strictly illegal under Kenyan traffic law?

options.text: Paying the exact bus fare to the conductor
Leaning out of the window or hanging precariously on the vehicle door
Sitting quietly in your designated seat

questions.correctAnswer: Leaning out of the window or hanging precariously on the vehicle door
questions.explanation: Hanging on matatu doors or leaning outside leads to fatal accidents and is strictly outlawed by the National Transport and Safety Authority (NTSA).

questions.prompt: Boda-boda riders and passengers wear bright reflective ____ so that drivers can see them clearly at night.

questions.socraticHint: What bright reflective garment is worn over clothes by motorcycle riders?

options.text: Tell the unknown driver where your family keeps valuable belongings
Ask the stranger to buy you snacks
Politely decline the ride from strangers and keep walking safely with your schoolmates

questions.correctAnswer: Politely decline the ride from strangers and keep walking safely with your schoolmates
questions.explanation: Child safety rules dictate never accepting rides from strangers. Always stay in groups and inform parents or teachers.
questions.socraticHint: What is the golden safety rule about accepting lifts or gifts from unknown strangers?

questions.prompt: How many 50-shilling notes make 200 shillings?

questions.prompt: Which verb form completes the sentence: 'Right now, Amina ____ the flowerbeds in the school garden.'?

questions.explanation: For short verbs ending with a single vowel and consonant, double the final consonant before adding '-ing': dig -> digging.

questions.prompt: Match each subject to its correct present continuous verb phrase:

Dispose of litter in the green dustbin.
Where did you put the litter?

questions.correctAnswer: Dispose of litter in the green dustbin.
questions.explanation: Imperative sentences give a command or instruction starting with a base action verb ('Dispose').
questions.socraticHint: Which sentence starts with an action command telling someone what to do?

questions.prompt: True or False: Negative imperative sentences used for safety guidelines start with 'Do not' or 'Don't' (such as 'Do not throw plastics into the river').
questions.explanation: Negative imperatives instruct people to avoid doing something using 'Do not' or 'Don't'.
questions.socraticHint: Do negative commands begin with 'Do not'?

questions.prompt: ____ not dump plastic polythene bags into the farm soil.
questions.explanation: 'Do not' forms the standard negative imperative command.
questions.socraticHint: What word completes the negative command: '... not dump'?

questions.prompt: Choose the correct imperative sentence instructing pupils to conserve water:

options.text: The water tap was running yesterday.
Who turned off the water tap?
Turn off the water tap firmly after washing your hands.
You are turning off the water tap firmly.

questions.correctAnswer: Turn off the water tap firmly after washing your hands.
questions.explanation: 'Turn off...' is a direct imperative instruction telling the listener what action to take.
questions.socraticHint: Look for the sentence that begins directly with the base action verb 'Turn off'.

questions.prompt: Match each environmental sign to its meaning:

matchingPairs.rightText: Do not step on young lawn grass
Put waste into this trash container
Plant trees to protect our climate

questions.correctAnswer: Keep Off the Grass: Do not step on young lawn grass | Dispose Litter Here: Put waste into this trash container | Plant a Tree, Save Life: Plant trees to protect our climate | Do Not Waste Water: Close taps tightly after use
questions.explanation: Environmental notices communicate clear public guidelines to protect nature and conserve resources.
questions.socraticHint: Match each sign to the action or rule it requires.

questions.prompt: During a community clean-up in Machakos, the local chief tells the youth: '____ unblock the drainage trenches so rainwater does not flood our homes.' Which word begins this imperative instruction?
questions.explanation: Imperative sentences begin with the base infinitive form of the verb: 'Help'.
questions.socraticHint: Imperatives always use the base form of the verb without -ing or -ed.

questions.prompt: True or False: Organic waste like banana peels and potato cuttings can be placed into a compost pit to decompose into fertile organic manure.
questions.explanation: Biodegradable organic waste breaks down naturally into nutrient-rich compost manure for the school shamba.
questions.socraticHint: Can food scraps turn into natural fertilizer for plants?

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses the negative imperative form to protect young trees?

options.text: Do not cut down young indigenous trees.
No cutting down young trees you.

questions.correctAnswer: Do not cut down young indigenous trees.
questions.explanation: 'Do not' followed by the base verb 'cut down' is the correct negative imperative structure.
questions.socraticHint: Which option uses 'Do not' + base verb 'cut down'?

questions.prompt: Arrange the steps of creating organic compost manure in the correct sequence:
orderingItems: Dig a pit in the garden corner
Add vegetable waste, leaves, and soil layers
Cover and let decompose into organic manure
questions.correctAnswer: Dig a pit in the garden corner, Add vegetable waste, leaves, and soil layers, Cover and let decompose into organic manure
questions.explanation: First excavate the pit, then deposit organic materials, and finally seal to allow decomposition.
questions.socraticHint: Do you dig the pit before or after adding the food scraps?

questions.prompt: Which waste management practice is healthiest and safest for our school environment?

options.text: Leaving broken glass on the playing field
Sorting recyclables and putting organic scraps into a compost pit
Burning plastic bags and breathing the toxic black smoke
Throwing sweet wrappers into the flowerbed

questions.correctAnswer: Sorting recyclables and putting organic scraps into a compost pit
questions.explanation: Separating waste for recycling and composting preserves clean air and soil while preventing pollution.
questions.socraticHint: Which option recycles and makes natural manure safely without burning toxic smoke?

questions.prompt: ____ your hands thoroughly with clean water and soap after cleaning the school compound.
questions.explanation: The command begins with the base verb 'Wash'.
questions.socraticHint: Choose the base imperative verb form telling someone to clean their hands.

questions.prompt: In the inspiring tradition of Professor Wangari Maathai, Grade 4 pupils plant 50 indigenous trees around their school. What vital ecological benefit do these trees provide?

options.text: Trees make fertile soil turn into sand
Trees purify the air, prevent soil erosion, and attract rainfall

questions.correctAnswer: Trees purify the air, prevent soil erosion, and attract rainfall
questions.explanation: Trees absorb carbon dioxide, release oxygen, bind soil roots against erosion, and contribute to rainfall cycles.
questions.socraticHint: Why did Wangari Maathai dedicate her life to planting trees across Kenya?

questions.prompt: How many 50-shilling notes make 200 shillings?
questions.explanation: 4 × 50 = 200 shillings.
questions.socraticHint: Count by fifties: 50, 100, 150...
questions.kenyanCulturalContext: Fifty shilling notes feature Kenyan wildlife.

questions.prompt: What is the adverb of manner formed from the adjective 'careful'?
questions.explanation: Add '-ly' to 'careful' to form the adverb of manner 'carefully'.
questions.socraticHint: What suffix (-ly) turns adjectives into adverbs of manner?

questions.prompt: True or False: An adverb of manner describes HOW an action is performed, usually answering the question 'How?'.
questions.explanation: Adverbs of manner describe the way or manner in which an action happens.
questions.socraticHint: Does an adverb of manner answer the question 'How did they do it?'

questions.prompt: The surgeon at Kenyatta National Hospital operated ____ on the patient.
questions.explanation: 'Skillfully' describes how the surgeon performed the operation.
questions.socraticHint: Choose the adverb of manner ending in -ly.

questions.prompt: Which is the correct irregular adverb of manner for the adjective 'good'?
questions.explanation: 'Good' is an irregular adjective; its adverb form is 'well' (e.g. 'She speaks English well').
questions.socraticHint: Think of the phrase: 'He plays football very...'. We never say 'goodly'!

questions.prompt: Match each adjective to its corresponding adverb of manner:
questions.correctAnswer: Patient: patiently | Quick: quickly | Happy: happily | Neat: neatly
questions.explanation: Patient -> patiently; Quick -> quickly; Happy -> happily (y to i); Neat -> neatly.
questions.socraticHint: Match each base adjective to its -ly adverb form.

questions.prompt: A jua kali welder in Gikomba puts on protective eye goggles and works with great precision on an iron gate. Which sentence correctly describes how he works?

options.text: He welds the metal with no care.
He welds the metal carefully and safely.

questions.correctAnswer: He welds the metal carefully and safely.
questions.explanation: 'Carefully' and 'safely' are adverbs modifying the action verb 'welds'.
questions.socraticHint: Which sentence uses adverbs ending in -ly to describe how he welds?

questions.prompt: True or False: In the sentence 'Eliud Kipchoge runs very fast', 'fast' is an irregular adverb that does not take an '-ly' ending.
questions.explanation: 'Fast' remains unchanged as both an adjective and an adverb; 'fastly' does not exist in standard English.
questions.socraticHint: Do we say 'runs fast' or 'runs fastly'?

questions.prompt: How is the adverb of manner formed from the adjective 'easy'?
questions.explanation: When an adjective ends in consonant + 'y', change 'y' to 'i' and add '-ly': easy -> easily.
questions.socraticHint: Change the 'y' to 'i' before adding '-ly'.

questions.prompt: Arrange these phrases into a grammatically correct sentence:
questions.correctAnswer: The school choir, sang the national anthem, harmoniously and proudly.
questions.explanation: Subject + verb phrase + adverbs of manner at the end.
questions.socraticHint: Start with who sang, what they sang, and how they sang.

questions.prompt: Identify the adverb of manner in this sentence: 'The tea picker plucked the tender green leaves quickly before the morning mist cleared.'
questions.explanation: 'Quickly' describes the manner in which the picker plucked the leaves.
questions.socraticHint: Which word tells 'how' the leaves were plucked?

questions.prompt: The carpenter measured the cedar timber ____ with a tape measure before cutting.
questions.explanation: 'Accurately' is the adverb of manner modifying the verb 'measured'.
questions.socraticHint: Choose the adverb form ending with -ly.

questions.prompt: During an English spelling competition in Kakamega, Amina spelled every single word without a mistake. Mwalimu praised her: 'Amina spelled all the words ____.'
questions.explanation: 'Correctly' describes the manner in which Amina spelled the words.
questions.socraticHint: What adverb tells how Amina spelled the words?

questions.prompt: A trained professional who treats sick people and prescribes healing medicine in a hospital is a ____.
questions.explanation: A medical doctor examines patients, diagnoses illnesses, and prescribes treatments.
questions.socraticHint: Who treats patients and writes medical prescriptions?

questions.prompt: True or False: Jua kali artisans play a vital role in Kenya's economy by manufacturing metal cooking jikos, farm gates, and wheelbarrows.
questions.explanation: Kenya's jua kali artisans produce essential tools, utensils, and construction hardware supporting families and industries.
questions.socraticHint: Do informal sector artisans make useful household items like metal jikos and gates?

questions.prompt: A skilled professional whose occupation is flying passenger airplanes between Nairobi and Mombasa is a ____.
questions.explanation: An aviator who operates the controls of an aircraft is a pilot.
questions.socraticHint: What is the job title of an aircraft navigator?

questions.prompt: Which professional designs and oversees the building of modern highways, bridges, and dams across Kenya?
questions.explanation: Civil engineers design and construct major infrastructure like bridges, roads, and dams.
questions.socraticHint: Who applies scientific knowledge to design bridges and roads?

questions.prompt: Match each occupation to its primary workplace tool:
questions.correctAnswer: Carpenter: Timber plane and saw | Tailor: Sewing machine and tape measure | Farmer: Jembe and tractor | Teacher: Blackboard and lesson plans
questions.explanation: Carpenters work with wood planes, tailors use sewing machines, farmers use jembes, and teachers use lesson plans.
questions.socraticHint: Match each profession to the tools they use every working day.

questions.prompt: Ferdinand Omanyala trains at the Kasarani stadium track every day, sprint training for the 100-meter dash. What is his special talent and profession?
questions.explanation: Omanyala is Africa's fastest 100m sprinter and a celebrated professional Kenyan athlete.
questions.socraticHint: What sport does a 100-meter stadium track athlete practice?

questions.prompt: True or False: All honest and lawful occupations deserve dignity and respect because every worker contributes to building our community.
questions.explanation: Dignity of labor means valuing every honest job, from street sweepers and farmers to doctors and engineers.
questions.socraticHint: Does every honest job deserve respect regardless of status?

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing a dedicated teacher's work:

options.text: The teacher explains difficult math problems patiently to her pupils.
The teacher explains difficult math problems impatient.
The teacher explain difficult math problems patiently.
The teacher was explain math problems patient.

questions.correctAnswer: The teacher explains difficult math problems patiently to her pupils.
questions.explanation: 'Explains' (singular present verb) and 'patiently' (adverb of manner) form a grammatically correct sentence.
questions.socraticHint: Look for the sentence with matching subject-verb agreement and the adverb 'patiently'.

questions.prompt: Arrange the stages of tailoring a school uniform in chronological order:
orderingItems: The tailor takes accurate body measurements
The tailor cuts the fabric cloth carefully
The tailor stitches the pieces neatly on a sewing machine
questions.correctAnswer: The tailor takes accurate body measurements, The tailor cuts the fabric cloth carefully, The tailor stitches the pieces neatly on a sewing machine
questions.explanation: First measure, then cut the fabric, then sew the garment together.
questions.socraticHint: Do you measure the pupil before cutting the fabric or after?

questions.prompt: A person whose occupation is catching tilapia and Nile perch in Lake Victoria to feed the community is a ____.
questions.explanation: A fisher (or fisherman) catches fish from natural water bodies.
questions.socraticHint: What do we call someone who catches fish for a living?

questions.prompt: Kenyan world-champion athletes train ____ every day in the high altitude of Iten.
questions.explanation: 'Hard' is an irregular adverb meaning with great effort. ('Hardly' means scarcely or almost not).
questions.socraticHint: Do athletes train 'hard' or 'hardly'?

questions.prompt: During career day at school, Jane explains she wants to be a veterinary doctor to treat farm animals, while Kevin wants to be an agricultural software engineer. What core CBC competency are these pupils displaying?
questions.explanation: Having clear career goals and recognizing personal strengths exemplifies the CBC core competency of self-efficacy.
questions.socraticHint: What positive competency involves setting goals and believing in your own talents?

questions.prompt: How many 50-shilling notes make 200 shillings?
questions.explanation: 4 × 50 = 200 shillings.
questions.socraticHint: Count by fifties: 50, 100, 150...
questions.kenyanCulturalContext: Fifty shilling notes feature Kenyan wildlife.

questions.prompt: Which conjunction gives the reason in the sentence: 'Otieno visited the dispensary ____ he had a high fever.'?
questions.explanation: 'Because' introduces the cause or reason why Otieno went to the clinic.
questions.socraticHint: Which conjunction introduces an explanation or reason for an action?

questions.prompt: True or False: We use the conjunction 'but' when joining two ideas that contrast or differ from each other.
questions.explanation: 'But' connects contrasting or unexpected statements (e.g. 'He was tired, but he kept walking').
questions.socraticHint: Does 'but' show a contrast between two thoughts?

questions.prompt: Every child in Kenya has the right to free primary education ____ good medical care.
questions.explanation: 'And' connects two similar positive rights.
questions.socraticHint: Which conjunction adds two similar good things together?

questions.prompt: Choose the correct conjunction showing a result: 'It was raining heavily in Kericho, ____ the pupils stayed inside their classrooms.'
questions.explanation: 'So' connects a cause to its natural result or consequence.
questions.socraticHint: What word shows the result of the heavy rain?

questions.prompt: Match each conjunction to its grammatical purpose:
questions.correctAnswer: And: Adds similar ideas together | But: Shows contrast or opposite ideas | Because: Gives a reason or cause | So: Shows a result or consequence
questions.explanation: And adds; But contrasts; Because gives reasons; So shows outcomes.
questions.socraticHint: Match each conjunction to how it connects two clauses.

questions.prompt: Amina wanted to buy an exciting new storybook at the bookshop, ____ she did not have enough shillings in her purse. Which conjunction connects her desire to the problem?
questions.explanation: 'But' introduces the contrasting obstacle that prevented her from buying the book.
questions.socraticHint: Which conjunction shows a contrast or unexpected obstacle?

questions.prompt: True or False: The sentence 'I washed my hands and they were dirty' is logically correct.
questions.explanation: The logical conjunction is 'because': 'I washed my hands because they were dirty.'
questions.socraticHint: Does being dirty give the reason why you washed your hands?

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that uses the conjunction 'so' correctly:

options.text: Kamau studied hard, so he passed his English assessment.
Kamau studied hard, because he passed his English assessment.
Kamau studied hard, so he was asleep.
Kamau studied hard, but so he passed.

questions.correctAnswer: Kamau studied hard, so he passed his English assessment.
questions.explanation: Passing the assessment was the direct result of studying hard, so 'so' is correct.
questions.socraticHint: Which sentence links hard studying to the outcome of passing?

questions.prompt: Arrange these phrases into a logical sentence using the conjunction 'because':
questions.correctAnswer: Children sleep early, because their growing bodies, need adequate rest.
questions.explanation: Action ('Children sleep early') + conjunction & subject ('because their growing bodies') + predicate ('need adequate rest.').
questions.socraticHint: Start with what children do, followed by 'because' explaining why.

questions.prompt: Which conjunction best joins these two sentences: 'Baraka loves playing football.' and 'His sister prefers netball.'?
questions.explanation: 'But' highlights the contrast between the brother's sport preference and the sister's preference.
questions.socraticHint: Which conjunction connects two contrasting preferences?

questions.prompt: Wanjiku helped her grandmother carry the basket ____ it was too heavy for an elderly woman.
questions.explanation: 'Because' gives the reason why Wanjiku assisted her grandmother.
questions.socraticHint: Why did Wanjiku carry the basket? The heavy basket is the reason.

questions.prompt: The school bell rang loudly for break time, ____ all the learners walked out to the field to play. Which conjunction fits best?
questions.explanation: The learners went out as a consequence of the bell ringing, so 'so' is correct.
questions.socraticHint: What was the result of the bell ringing?

questions.prompt: Under the Kenyan Constitution (Article 53), which of the following is a guaranteed basic right of every child?

options.text: The right to skip school whenever they choose
The right to free basic education and medical treatment
The right to work long hours in stone quarries
The right to be left alone without parental care

questions.correctAnswer: The right to free basic education and medical treatment
questions.explanation: Every child has the legal right to basic education, healthcare, nutrition, and shelter.
questions.socraticHint: Which option represents essential rights for a child's health and learning?

questions.prompt: True or False: Every child has constitutional rights, and with every right comes a corresponding responsibility.
questions.explanation: Rights and responsibilities go hand-in-hand: e.g. the right to education comes with the duty to study hard.
questions.socraticHint: Do you have responsibilities to match your rights as a student?

questions.prompt: If a pupil enjoys the right to education, they also have the responsibility to study ____ and respect teachers.
questions.explanation: Studying hard is the learner's responsibility to fulfill their right to education.
questions.socraticHint: What adverb describes working with dedication and effort?

questions.prompt: In a friendly letter, what is the opening greeting called (for example: 'Dear Grandmother,')?
questions.explanation: The salutation is the courteous greeting opening a letter.
questions.socraticHint: What is the technical term for the greeting line in a letter?

questions.prompt: Match each child's right to its corresponding personal responsibility:

matchingPairs.rightText: Duty to study diligently and obey school rules
Duty to help with household chores
Duty to listen respectfully to others

questions.correctAnswer: Right to education: Duty to study diligently and obey school rules | Right to a clean home: Duty to help with household chores | Right to nutritious food: Duty not to waste food | Right to express opinions: Duty to listen respectfully to others
questions.explanation: Every right is balanced by an active civic or personal responsibility.
questions.socraticHint: Match each entitlement to the duty that comes along with it.

questions.prompt: A shopkeeper employs a 9-year-old boy to work long hours in a quarry instead of attending school. Which fundamental child right is being violated?

options.text: The right to own a vehicle
The right to have a mobile phone
The right to education and protection from harmful child labor

questions.correctAnswer: The right to education and protection from harmful child labor
questions.explanation: Child labor is illegal under Kenyan law; children must be protected and allowed to attend school.
questions.socraticHint: What basic rights protect children from being forced to work instead of learning?

questions.prompt: True or False: Children have a legal and human right to play, sports, and recreational activities.
questions.explanation: Play and recreational activities are essential for a child's mental, physical, and social growth.
questions.socraticHint: Does a child need play and exercise to develop healthily?

questions.prompt: Choose the most appropriate closing sign-off for a friendly letter to your parent or grandparent:
questions.explanation: 'Your loving daughter' is an affectionate, warm sign-off suited for family letters.
questions.socraticHint: Which closing shows warmth and family affection?

questions.prompt: Arrange the parts of a friendly letter in order from top to bottom:
orderingItems: Sender's address and date at the top right
Body paragraph with news and questions
Closing sign-off and name (e.g. 'Your loving grandson, Kiprono')
questions.correctAnswer: Sender's address and date at the top right, Salutation (e.g. 'Dear Grandmother,'), Body paragraph with news and questions, Closing sign-off and name (e.g. 'Your loving grandson, Kiprono')
questions.explanation: Standard friendly letter layout: Address & Date -> Salutation -> Body -> Sign-off & Name.
questions.socraticHint: What comes first at the top of a letter: the address or the sign-off?

questions.prompt: Which toll-free national emergency helpline in Kenya protects children from abuse, neglect, and exploitation?
questions.explanation: Childline Kenya (116) is the national toll-free helpline dedicated to child protection 24 hours a day.
questions.socraticHint: What is the three-digit national toll-free helpline starting with 116 for children in Kenya?

questions.prompt: In a friendly letter, the writer places the ____ directly below the sender's address at the top right.
questions.explanation: The date indicates when the letter was written and appears immediately beneath the sender's address.
questions.socraticHint: What tells the recipient what day the letter was written?

questions.prompt: During a school assembly, Grade 4 pupils hold a Children's Baraza where they politely present suggestions to Mwalimu about improving safety on the school playing field. What core CBC competency are they demonstrating?

options.text: Civic participation, respectful communication, and leadership

questions.correctAnswer: Civic participation, respectful communication, and leadership
questions.explanation: Presenting constructive suggestions peacefully and politely is an example of active civic participation and positive leadership.
questions.socraticHint: What positive leadership and citizenship skills are shown when pupils discuss improvements constructively?

questions.prompt: How many 50-shilling notes make 200 shillings?
questions.explanation: 4 × 50 = 200 shillings.
questions.socraticHint: Count by fifties: 50, 100, 150...
questions.kenyanCulturalContext: Fifty shilling notes feature Kenyan wildlife.

questions.prompt: Kifaa kinachotumiwa kusafisha meno na ulimi kwa dawa ya meno asubuhi na jioni huitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Mswaki hutumiwa kusugua na kusafisha meno pamoja na dawa ya meno ili kuzuia kuoza kwa meno.
questions.socraticHint: Ni kifaa kipi unachotumia kusugua meno kila asubuhi?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Kuvaa mavazi machafu na kutooga hakusababishi magonjwa yoyote ya ngozi.
questions.explanation: Kutooga na kuvaa nguo chafu huwezesha viini na uchafu kusababisha magonjwa mbalimbali ya ngozi kama upele.
questions.socraticHint: Je, uchafu mwilini husaidia afya au huleta magonjwa?

questions.prompt: Baada ya kuoga kwa maji safi na sabuni, Amina alitumia ____ kujipangusa maji mwilini.
questions.explanation: Taulo (au kitambaa cha kujipangusia) hutumika kukausha maji baada ya kuoga.
questions.socraticHint: Je, unatumia kitambaa gani kukausha maji mwilini baada ya kuoga?

questions.prompt: Kifaa kinachotumia umeme au makaa kunyoosha nguo zilizofuliwa ili ziwe nadhifu huitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Pasi hunyoosha makunyanzi katika nguo na kuzifanya zionekane nadhifu.
questions.socraticHint: Ni kifaa gani chenye joto kinachotumiwa kuondoa makunyanzi kwenye sare ya shule?

questions.prompt: Oanisha kila kifaa cha usafi na kazi yake sahihi:
questions.correctAnswer: Mswaki: Kusafisha meno na ulimi | Sabuni: Kuondoa uchafu mwilini na mavazini | Kitana: Kuchania nywele vizuri | Pasi: Kunyooshea nguo ziwe nadhifu
questions.explanation: Mswaki husafisha meno, sabuni huondoa uchafu, kitana huchana nywele, na pasi hunyoosha mavazi.
questions.socraticHint: Oanisha kifaa kulingana na sehemu ya mwili au vazi inayohudumiwa.

questions.prompt: Kamau anajitayarisha kwenda shuleni lakini kucha zake za mikono ni ndefu na zimejaa uchafu mweusi. Je, anapaswa kuchukua hatua gani ya usafi mara moja?

options.text: Kuziacha ndefu ili atishe wenzake darasani
Kula chakula cha asubuhi kabla ya kuziosha
Kuzipaka rangi nyeusi ili uchafu usionekane
Kukata kucha fupi na kuziosha kwa maji safi na sabuni

questions.correctAnswer: Kukata kucha fupi na kuziosha kwa maji safi na sabuni
questions.explanation: Kukata kucha fupi huzuia vijidudu hatari vya magonjwa kujificha na kuingia mwilini wakati wa kula.
questions.socraticHint: Ni hatua gani sahihi ya kiafya ya kutunza kucha ndefu zenye uchafu?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Kunyoosha nguo zilizofuliwa kwa pasi ya joto husaidia kuua viini na mayai ya wadudu kama chawa.
questions.explanation: Joto la pasi huua vimelea, wadudu, na viini vidogo vinavyoweza kujificha kwenye mishono ya nguo.
questions.socraticHint: Je, joto kali la pasi linaweza kuangamiza wadudu na viini vya nguo?

questions.prompt: Ni kitendo kipi kinachosaidia kuzuia harufu mbaya ya jasho na kinywa?

options.text: Kuoga kila siku kwa sabuni na kupiga mswaki asubuhi na jioni
Kula peremende nyingi bila kupiga mswaki
Kuvaa soksi zilezile kwa wiki nzima bila kuzifua

questions.correctAnswer: Kuoga kila siku kwa sabuni na kupiga mswaki asubuhi na jioni
questions.explanation: Kusafisha mwili kwa maji na sabuni pamoja na kupiga mswaki huondoa bakteria wanaosababisha harufu mbaya.
questions.socraticHint: Chagua tabia bora ya kila siku inayotunza usafi wa mwili na kinywa.

questions.prompt: Panga hatua za kufua sare ya shule kwa mfuatano sahihi:
orderingItems: Loweka sare kwenye maji safi yenye sabuni
Sugua vizuri na suuza kwa maji safi
Anika sare juani ikauke kisha nyoosha kwa pasi
questions.correctAnswer: Loweka sare kwenye maji safi yenye sabuni, Sugua vizuri na suuza kwa maji safi, Anika sare juani ikauke kisha nyoosha kwa pasi
questions.explanation: Kwanza loweka, kisha sugua na kusuuza, hatimaye anika na kunyoosha kwa pasi.
questions.socraticHint: Je, unaloweka sare kwanza au unaianika juani kabla ya kusugua?

questions.prompt: Mtu mwenye tabia ya kuweka mwili na mavazi yake katika hali ya usafi wa kupendeza anasemekana kuwa ____.
questions.explanation: 'Nadhifu' ni sifa ya mtu safi anayevaa na kujitunza vizuri bila uchafu.
questions.socraticHint: Ni neno gani la heshima linalomaanisha kuwa safi na mwenye kupendeza?

questions.prompt: Ili nywele zako zionekane safi na nadhifu baada ya kuziosha, tumia ____ kuzichana vizuri.
questions.explanation: Kitana (chanuo) hutumika kuchana nywele ili ziwe nadhifu.
questions.socraticHint: Ni kifaa gani kinachotumiwa kuchania nywele kichwani?

questions.prompt: Wakati wa gwaride la asubuhi shuleni, Mwalimu alimsifu mwanafunzi Juma mbele ya shule nzima. Ni sababu gani iliyomfanya Juma asifiwe?

options.text: Sare yake ilikuwa na madoa ya wino na chakula
Sare yake ilikuwa safi na iliyonyooshwa, kucha fupi, na nywele nadhifu
Alivaa viatu vilivyojaa matope ya jana

questions.correctAnswer: Sare yake ilikuwa safi na iliyonyooshwa, kucha fupi, na nywele nadhifu
questions.explanation: Kudumisha usafi wa mwili na sare safi iliyonyooshwa huonyesha nidhamu na hufanya mwanafunzi asifiwe.
questions.socraticHint: Mwalimu husifu wanafunzi wanaozingatia kanuni gani za usafi?

questions.prompt: Wingi wa kiwakilishi cha nafsi ya kwanza 'Mimi' ni ____.
questions.explanation: Kiwakilishi cha nafsi ya kwanza umoja ni 'Mimi', na wingi wake ni 'Sisi'.
questions.socraticHint: Unapozungumza kuhusu nafsi yako pamoja na wenzako, unatumia neno gani?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Katika ngeli ya A-WA, nomino ya umoja huchukua kiambishi cha kitenzi 'a-' (mfano: 'Mtoto ananawa mikono').
questions.explanation: Viumbe wenye uhai katika umoja huchukua kiambishi 'a-' (a-na-nawa).
questions.socraticHint: Je, mtoto mmoja anasemekana 'ananawa' au 'wananawa'?

questions.prompt: Kamilisha sentensi: '____ tunafua sare zetu kila Ijumaa jioni.' (Nafsi ya kwanza wingi).
questions.explanation: Kiambishi 'tu-' katika 'tunafua' kinalingana na kiwakilishi cha nafsi 'Sisi'.
questions.socraticHint: Ni kiwakilishi kipi cha nafsi kinacholingana na kiambishi 'tu-'?

questions.prompt: Chagua sentensi iliyo sahihi kisarufi katika ngeli ya A-WA:
questions.explanation: 'Wanafunzi' ni wingi, kwa hivyo kitenzi lazima kichukue kiambishi cha wingi 'wa-' (wanaoga).
questions.socraticHint: Angalia upatanisho wa wingi: Wanafunzi ...-naoga vizuri.

questions.prompt: Oanisha kila kiwakilishi nafsi na kitenzi chake sahihi:
questions.correctAnswer: Mimi: ninanawa mikono | Wewe: unanawa mikono | Yeye: ananawa mikono | Sisi: tunanawa mikono
questions.explanation: Mimi -> ni-; Wewe -> u-; Yeye -> a-; Sisi -> tu-.
questions.socraticHint: Oanisha kiwakilishi kulingana na kiambishi chake cha awali katika kitenzi.

questions.prompt: Mwalimu anazungumza na darasa zima na kusema: '____ mnatakiwa kudumisha usafi wa darasa lenu kila siku.' Ni kiwakilishi kipi cha nafsi ya pili wingi kinachofaa?
questions.explanation: 'Ninyi' ni kiwakilishi cha nafsi ya pili katika wingi kinacholingana na kiambishi 'm-' katika 'mnatakiwa'.
questions.socraticHint: Unapowaambia watu wengi waliopo mbele yako, unatumia 'Wewe' au 'Ninyi'?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Wingi wa sentensi 'Yeye anapiga mswaki' ni 'Wao wanapiga mswaki'.
questions.explanation: Yeye hubadilika kuwa Wao, na anapiga hubadilika kuwa wanapiga.
questions.socraticHint: Je, wingi wa 'yeye' ni 'wao' na 'a-' inakuwa 'wa-'?

questions.prompt: Chagua sentensi sahihi katika umoja wa ngeli ya A-WA:
questions.explanation: 'Mwalimu' mmoja huchukua kiambishi 'a-' (anafundisha).
questions.socraticHint: Tafuta sentensi inayooanisha nomino ya mwalimu mmoja na kiambishi 'a-'.

questions.prompt: Panga viwakilishi nafsi vya umoja kwa mfuatano sahihi (nafsi ya kwanza, ya pili, na ya tatu):
questions.correctAnswer: Nafsi ya Kwanza: Mimi, Nafsi ya Pili: Wewe, Nafsi ya Tatu: Yeye
questions.explanation: Nafsi ya kwanza ni msemaji (Mimi), ya pili ni msemeshwa (Wewe), na ya tatu ni msemwa (Yeye).
questions.socraticHint: Nafsi ya kwanza inaanza na nani? Ya pili? Ya tatu?

questions.prompt: Katika sentensi 'Mtoto anajipangusa kwa taulo safi', kiambishi 'a-' katika 'anajipangusa' kinawakilisha nini?

options.text: Nafsi ya tatu umoja katika ngeli ya A-WA

questions.correctAnswer: Nafsi ya tatu umoja katika ngeli ya A-WA
questions.explanation: Kiambishi 'a-' huwakilisha mtenda wa nafsi ya tatu katika umoja wa ngeli ya A-WA.
questions.socraticHint: Je, 'mtoto' ni nafsi ya tatu na kiumbe mwenye uhai katika ngeli ya A-WA?

questions.prompt: Wao ____chana nywele zao kwa kitana safi kila asubuhi.
questions.explanation: Kiwakilishi 'Wao' kinalingana na kiambishi cha wingi 'wa-' (wanachana).
questions.socraticHint: Wao ...-chana: kiambishi cha nafsi ya tatu wingi ni kipi?

questions.prompt: Baraka na wenzake walisafisha bweni la shule, wakafagia sakafu na kutandika vitanda kwa unadhifu. Mwalimu mkuu aliwaambia: 'Hongereni sana kwa kazi nzuri.' Ni maadili gani ya CBC yaliyojitokeza hapa?
questions.explanation: Kufanya kazi kwa pamoja na kutunza usafi wa mazingira huonyesha maadili ya ushirikiano na uwajibikaji.
questions.socraticHint: Ni tabia gani njema inayojitokeza wanaposhirikiana kufanya usafi?

questions.prompt: How many 50-shilling notes make 200 shillings?
questions.explanation: 4 × 50 = 200 shillings.
questions.socraticHint: Count by fifties: 50, 100, 150...
questions.kenyanCulturalContext: Fifty shilling notes feature Kenyan wildlife.

questions.prompt: Kaka au ndugu wa kiume wa mama yako anaitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Mjomba ni kaka au ndugu yeyote wa kiume wa mama yako mzazi.
questions.socraticHint: Je, unamwitaje ndugu wa kiume wa mama yako?

questions.prompt: Dada wa baba yako mzazi unamwita nani?
questions.explanation: Dada wa baba anaitwa shangazi.
questions.socraticHint: Ni neno gani la heshima linalotumika kwa dada ya baba yako?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Mtoto wa mjomba wako au shangazi yako anaitwa binamu yako.
questions.explanation: Mtoto wa ndugu wa wazazi wako (mjomba, shangazi, ami, halati) ni binamu yako.
questions.socraticHint: Je, watoto wa mjomba na shangazi wanaitwaje katika Kiswahili?

questions.prompt: Mama mzazi wa baba yako au mama yako anaitwa ____ au bibi.
questions.explanation: Mama wa mzazi wako anaitwa nyanya au bibi.
questions.socraticHint: Ni jina gani la mzazi wa kike wa wazazi wako?

questions.prompt: Ndugu wa kiume wa baba yako anaitwa nani kwa Kiswahili sanifu?
questions.explanation: Ndugu wa kiume wa baba anaitwa ami, ilhali dada wa baba ni shangazi.
questions.socraticHint: Ndugu wa kiume wa mama ni mjomba, lakini wa baba ni nani?

questions.prompt: Dada wa mama yako mzazi anaitwa nani?
questions.explanation: Halati ni ndugu wa kike (dada) wa mama yako.
questions.socraticHint: Kama ndugu wa kike wa baba ni shangazi, dada wa mama anaitwaje?

questions.prompt: Oanisha neno la uhusiano wa kifamilia na maana yake sahihi:

options.text: Mjomba -> Ndugu wa kiume wa mama
Binamu -> Mtoto wa mjomba au shangazi

questions.correctAnswer: Babu -> Baba ya mzazi wako, Mjomba -> Ndugu wa kiume wa mama, Shangazi -> Dada wa baba, Binamu -> Mtoto wa mjomba au shangazi
questions.explanation: Majina haya yanaonyesha nafasi na mahusiano ya kindugu katika ukoo wa familia.
questions.socraticHint: Fikiria uhusiano wa kila mmoja na wazazi wako.

questions.prompt: Mtoto wa kaka yako au dada yako anaitwa nani kwako?
questions.explanation: Mtoto wa ndugu yako (kaka au dada) huitwa mpwa wako.
questions.socraticHint: Mtoto anayezaliwa na kaka au dada yako anaitwaje?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Mtoto wa kwanza kuzaliwa katika familia anaitwa kitinda mimba.
questions.explanation: Mtoto wa kwanza anaitwa kifungua mimba; kitinda mimba ni mtoto wa mwisho kabisa kuzaliwa.
questions.socraticHint: Je, neno 'kifungua' au 'kitinda' linamaanisha wa kwanza?

questions.prompt: Mzee Otieno ni baba yake Omondi. Omondi ameoa Achieng. Je, uhusiano wa Mzee Otieno na watoto wa Omondi na Achieng ni gani?
questions.explanation: Kwa vile Mzee Otieno ni baba ya baba yao (Omondi), yeye ni babu yao.
questions.socraticHint: Baba ya baba yako ni nani kwako?

questions.prompt: Panga vizazi hivi vya familia kuanzia kikongwe zaidi hadi kichanga zaidi:
questions.explanation: Mfuatano sahihi wa umri na vizazi huanzia babu mkuu, kufuatiwa na babu, baba, kisha mtoto.
questions.socraticHint: Ni nani aliyezaliwa kabla ya babu?

questions.prompt: Mume wa dada yako unamwita nani kwa Kiswahili?
questions.explanation: Mume wa dada huitwa shemeji. Mke wa kaka kwa upande wa mwanamke huitwa wifi.
questions.socraticHint: Ni neno gani linalotumiwa kuonyesha mume wa dada?

questions.prompt: Chagua kivumishi kiashiria sahihi cha ukaribu: 'Mtoto ____ anasaidia wazazi wake.'
questions.explanation: Nomino 'mtoto' ipo katika ngeli ya A-WA umoja, kwa hivyo kiashiria cha ukaribu ni 'huyu'.
questions.socraticHint: Je, mtoto mmoja aliye karibu huashiriwa kwa neno gani?

questions.prompt: Sentensi: 'Watoto ____ wanacheza uwanjani.' Neno lipi linajaza nafasi hii kwa usahihi?
questions.explanation: 'Watoto' ni wingi wa ngeli ya A-WA, kwa hivyo kiashiria cha ukaribu ni 'hawa'.
questions.socraticHint: Wingi wa 'huyu' ni nini?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Katika ngeli ya KI-VI, kiashiria cha ukaribu cha umoja ni 'hiki' na cha wingi ni 'hivi'.
questions.explanation: Mfano: Kiti hiki / Viti hivi; Kitabu hiki / Vitabu hivi.
questions.socraticHint: Je, unasema 'kitabu hiki' au 'kitabu hivi'?

questions.prompt: Kamilisha sentensi: 'Jina ____ limeandikwa vizuri.' (hili / haya / huu)
questions.explanation: Nomino 'jina' iko katika ngeli ya LI-YA umoja, kwa hivyo kiashiria chake ni 'hili'.
questions.socraticHint: Je, unasema 'jina hili' au 'jina haya'?

questions.prompt: Andika kiashiria cha mbali kuelekea nomino ya ngeli ya A-WA: 'Mwalimu ____ anafunza darasani.'
questions.explanation: Kiashiria cha mbali kabisa katika ngeli ya A-WA umoja ni 'yule' (wingi: wale).
questions.socraticHint: Ni neno lipi linaloashiria mtu aliye mbali nawe?

questions.prompt: Badilisha sentensi hii iwe katika wingi: 'Kiti hiki kimevunjika.'
questions.explanation: 'Kiti hiki kimevunjika' katika wingi ni 'Viti hivi vimevunjika.'
questions.socraticHint: Wingi wa 'kiti' ni 'viti', na wingi wa 'hiki' ni nini?

questions.prompt: Oanisha nomino na kiashiria chake sahihi cha ukaribu:
questions.correctAnswer: Mti -> huu, Miti -> hii, Embe -> hili, Maembe -> haya
questions.explanation: 'Mti' (U-I umoja) huchukua 'huu', 'miti' (wingi) huchukua 'hii', 'embe' (LI-YA) huchukua 'hili', na 'maembe' huchukua 'haya'.
questions.socraticHint: Angalia ngeli ya kila nomino katika umoja na wingi.

questions.prompt: Jaza kiashiria cha mbali kidogo (hapo): 'Kitabu ____ ulichonipa kimependeza sana.'
questions.explanation: Kiashiria cha mbali kidogo / kilichotajwa hivi punde katika ngeli ya KI-VI ni 'hicho'.
questions.socraticHint: Mbali kidogo na msikilizaji kwa kiti au kitabu huitwaje?

questions.prompt: Wambui anapita sokoni Gikomba na kuona ndizi zikiwa mezani mbali kidogo. Atatumia maneno gani sahihi kuwaelekeza wenzake?
questions.explanation: Nomino 'ndizi' katika ngeli ya I-ZI wingi hutumia kiashiria cha mbali 'zile'.
questions.socraticHint: Ni kiashiria gani cha mbali kinachoendana na ndizi nyingi?

questions.prompt: Ni sentensi gani iliyo sahihi kisarufi kati ya zifuatazo?
questions.explanation: Nomino 'mifuko' ipo katika ngeli ya U-I wingi, kwa hivyo kiashiria chake sahihi ni 'hii'.
questions.socraticHint: Mfuko huu, lakini katika wingi mifuko ____?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Kivumishi kiashiria cha mbali kwa nomino 'nyumba' katika umoja ni 'yule'.
questions.explanation: 'Nyumba' ipo katika ngeli ya I-ZI, kwa hivyo kiashiria cha mbali ni 'ile', siyo 'yule' (ambayo hutumika kwa binadamu/A-WA).
questions.socraticHint: Je, nyumba ni kiumbe hai katika ngeli ya A-WA?

questions.prompt: Panga vivumishi viashiria hivi kulingana na ukaribu kuanzia karibu sana, mbali kidogo, hadi mbali zaidi:
questions.explanation: Daraja za uashiriaji huanzia ukaribu (huyu/hapa), mbali kidogo (huyo/hapo), hadi mbali zaidi (yule/kule).
questions.socraticHint: Anza na kile kilicho karibu nawe kwanza kabisa.

questions.prompt: How many 50-shilling notes make 200 shillings?
questions.explanation: 4 × 50 = 200 shillings.
questions.socraticHint: Count by fifties: 50, 100, 150...
questions.kenyanCulturalContext: Fifty shilling notes feature Kenyan wildlife.

questions.prompt: Chumba maalum shuleni chenye vitabu vingi ambamo wanafunzi huenda kusoma huitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Maktaba ni chumba au jengo lenye mkusanyiko wa vitabu vya kusoma na kufanyia utafiti.
questions.socraticHint: Ni chumba gani shuleni kinachohifadhi vitabu vya masomo na hadithi?

questions.prompt: Mwanafunzi anayeongoza wanafunzi wenzake shuleni anaitwa nani?
questions.explanation: Kiranja ni kiongozi wa wanafunzi anayewakilisha na kusaidia kudumisha nidhamu shuleni.
questions.socraticHint: Kiongozi wa wanafunzi shuleni huitwaje?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Maabara ni mahali ambapo wanafunzi hufanyia majaribio ya masomo ya Sayansi.
questions.explanation: Maabara hutumika kufanyia majaribio mbalimbali ya kisayansi kwa vifaa maalum.
questions.socraticHint: Je, majaribio ya kisayansi hufanyiwa darasani au maabarani?

questions.prompt: Kifaa kinachotumiwa darasani kuchorea mistari iliyonyooka huitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Rula ni kifaa cha kupimia urefu na kuchorea mistari iliyonyooka kwenye daftari au ubaoni.
questions.socraticHint: Ni kifaa kipi cha jiometria chenye vipimo vya sentimita?

questions.prompt: Mtu anayelinda lango kuu la shule na kuhakikisha usalama wa wote huitwa nani?
questions.explanation: Bawabu au mlinzi ni mtu anayesimamia lango na usalama wa watu na mali za shule.
questions.socraticHint: Nani anayefungua na kufunga lango la shule asubuhi na jioni?

questions.prompt: Oanisha sehemu ya shule na shughuli inayofanyika hapo:

options.text: Uwanja wa michezo -> Mazoezi ya viungo na kandanda
Darasa -> Kufundishwa masomo ya kila siku

questions.correctAnswer: Maktaba -> Kusoma vitabu kwa utulivu, Uwanja wa michezo -> Mazoezi ya viungo na kandanda, Maabara -> Majaribio ya sayansi, Darasa -> Kufundishwa masomo ya kila siku
questions.explanation: Kila sehemu ya shule imetengwa kwa shughuli maalum ya kukuza elimu na afya ya mwanafunzi.
questions.socraticHint: Unganisha kila jengo na kazi yake ya msingi shuleni.

questions.prompt: Meza na kiti ambacho mwanafunzi hukalia na kuandikia darasani huitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Dawati ni kifaa chenye kiti na meza ambapo mwanafunzi hukaa akisoma au akiandika darasani.
questions.socraticHint: Wewe huketi kwenye nini darasani unapofanya kazi ya mwalimu?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Mwanafunzi anapaswa kuchora na kuandika kwenye kuta na madawati ya shule.
questions.explanation: Kuchafua madawati na kuta ni uharibifu wa mali ya shule; mwanafunzi anapaswa kuyatunza vizuri.
questions.socraticHint: Je, kutunza madawati na kuta za darasa safi ni tabia njema au mbaya?

questions.prompt: Wanafunzi wanapokusanyika pamoja asubuhi kusikiliza matangazo na kuimba wimbo wa taifa, mkusanyiko huo huitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Gwaride ni mkusanyiko wa wanafunzi na walimu uwanjani asubuhi kwa ajili ya maombi na matangazo.
questions.socraticHint: Ni mkusanyiko gani wa asubuhi ambapo wimbo wa taifa huimbwa?

questions.prompt: Baraka alipata kitabu cha Kiingereza kikiwa kimeanguka chini karibu na lango la shule. Kama mwanafunzi mwenye nidhamu, anapaswa kufanya nini?

options.text: Kukirusha nje ya uzio wa shule.
Kukiokota na kukipeleka kwa mwalimu au afisi ya kiranja mkuu.
Kukirarua kurasa na kukiacha hapo chini.
Kukificha kwenye begi lake bila kumwambia mtu.

questions.correctAnswer: Kukiokota na kukipeleka kwa mwalimu au afisi ya kiranja mkuu.
questions.explanation: Mwanafunzi mwaminifu hurejesha vitu vilivyopotea kwa mwalimu ili mwenyewe aweze kukipata.
questions.socraticHint: Nidhamu na uaminifu unakuelekeza kufanya nini unapookota kitu kisicho chako?

questions.prompt: Panga mpangilio wa ratiba ya asubuhi shuleni kuanzia mwanzo hadi somo la kwanza:
questions.correctAnswer: Kuwasili shuleni mapema, Kufanya usafi wa mazingira, Kuhudhuria gwaride la asubuhi, Kuingia darasani tayari kwa somo
questions.explanation: Ratiba bora ya asubuhi inaanza na kuwasili, usafi, gwaride, kisha kuingia darasani kuanza masomo.
questions.socraticHint: Unapoingia getini asubuhi, unaanza na nini kabla ya kuingia darasani?

questions.prompt: Kifaa cha darasani kinachotumiwa kufutia maandishi ya penseli kwenye daftari huitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Kifutio hutumika kuondoa makosa ya penseli bila kuchana ukurasa wa daftari.
questions.socraticHint: Unapokosea kuandika kwa penseli, unatumia nini kurekebisha?

questions.prompt: Wingi wa neno 'kitabu' ni ____.
questions.explanation: Katika ngeli ya KI-VI, kiambishi 'ki-' hubadilika na kuwa 'vi-' katika wingi (kitabu -> vitabu).
questions.socraticHint: Kiambishi 'ki-' cha kitabu kinabadilika kuwa nini katika wingi?

questions.prompt: Wingi wa neno 'dawati' ni nini?
questions.explanation: Katika ngeli ya LI-YA, nomino huchukua kiambishi 'ma-' katika wingi (dawati -> madawati).
questions.socraticHint: Nomino za ngeli ya LI-YA huchukua kiambishi gani katika wingi?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Wingi wa neno 'mti' ni 'miti'.
questions.explanation: Katika ngeli ya U-I, nomino huanza na 'm-' katika umoja na 'mi-' katika wingi (mti -> miti).
questions.socraticHint: Je, unapoona mti zaidi ya mmoja unaita miti?

questions.prompt: Kamilisha: Umoja ni 'ubao', lakini wingi wake ni ____.
questions.explanation: Ubao umoja unakuwa mbao katika wingi (ngeli ya U-ZI).
questions.socraticHint: Mbao nyingi hutengeneza madawati. Moja huitwaje?

questions.prompt: Badilisha sentensi hii iwe katika wingi: 'Mwalimu anafundisha vizuri.'
questions.explanation: Mwalimu (umoja) -> Walimu (wingi); anafundisha (umoja) -> wanafundisha (wingi).
questions.socraticHint: Kumbuka kubadilisha nomino pamoja na kitenzi katika wingi wa A-WA.

questions.prompt: Sentensi: 'Dirisha limefunguliwa.' Katika wingi itakuwa:
questions.explanation: 'Dirisha' linakuwa 'madirisha', na kiambishi cha kitenzi 'li-' kinabadilika kuwa 'ya-' (yamefunguliwa).
questions.socraticHint: Dirisha moja limefunguliwa, lakini mengi ____?

questions.prompt: Oanisha maneno ya umoja na wingi wake sahihi:
questions.correctAnswer: Kiti -> Viti, Jicho -> Macho, Mfereji -> Mifereji, Kalamu -> Kalamu
questions.explanation: Kiti (KI-VI) -> Viti; Jicho (LI-YA) -> Macho; Mfereji (U-I) -> Mifereji; Kalamu (I-ZI) -> Kalamu.
questions.socraticHint: Angalia jinsi kila ngeli inavyounda umbo lake la wingi.

questions.prompt: Kamilisha sentensi kwa kiambishi sahihi cha wingi: 'Vitabu hivi ____tasomwa na wanafunzi.' (vi / ya / zi)
questions.explanation: Nomino ya ngeli ya KI-VI katika wingi hutumia kiambishi 'vi-' kwenye kitenzi (vitasomwa).
questions.socraticHint: Vitabu vinachukua kiambishi kipi kwenye kitenzi: ki- au vi-?

questions.prompt: Halima aliandika: 'Kikapu kile kina matunda matamu.' Mwalimu akamwambia aandike sentensi hiyo katika wingi. Halima anapaswa kuandika nini?
questions.explanation: Kikapu -> Vikapu, kile -> vile, kina -> vina. Neno 'matunda' tayari liko katika wingi.
questions.socraticHint: Badilisha kila neno katika ngeli ya KI-VI: kikapu -> ?, kile -> ?, kina -> ?

questions.prompt: Ni sentensi ipi kati ya hizi ifuatayo iliyoandikwa kwa upatanisho sahihi wa kisarufi?

Mifereji ya maji vimefungwa ili kuzuia upotevu.
Mifereji ya maji imefungwa ili kuzuia upotevu.

questions.correctAnswer: Mifereji ya maji imefungwa ili kuzuia upotevu.
questions.explanation: 'Mifereji' ipo katika ngeli ya U-I wingi, ambayo inachukua 'ya' kwa kihusishi na 'i-' kwa kitenzi (Mifereji ya maji imefungwa).
questions.socraticHint: Kumbuka ngeli ya U-I wingi huchukua kiambishi 'i-' kwenye vitenzi.

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Katika ngeli ya I-ZI, maneno kama 'kalamu', 'saa', na 'picha' hayabadiliki umbo lake katika umoja na wingi.
questions.explanation: Katika ngeli ya I-ZI, nomino hubaki na muundo sawa (kalamu moja / kalamu tano), bali vivumishi na vitenzi ndivyo vinavyobadilika (kalamu hii imeanguka / kalamu hizi zimeanguka).
questions.socraticHint: Je, unasema 'makalamu' au unaita tu 'kalamu nyingi'?

questions.prompt: Panga maneno haya kuunda sentensi sahihi katika wingi:
questions.explanation: Sentensi sahihi ni: 'Wanafunzi wameingia darasani kusoma.'
questions.socraticHint: Anza na mtenda (nomino), kisha kitendo (kitenzi), na mahali.

questions.prompt: How many 50-shilling notes make 200 shillings?
questions.explanation: 4 × 50 = 200 shillings.
questions.socraticHint: Count by fifties: 50, 100, 150...

questions.prompt: Kitambaa cha pamba chenye michoro maridadi na maneno ya hekima au methali kinachopendwa na wanawake nchini Kenya huitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Leso au kanga ni vazi la asili lenye pindo, picha na methali iliyoandikwa kwa Kiswahili.
questions.socraticHint: Ni kitambaa kipi cha kitamaduni chenye methali kilicho maarufu Pwani na kote nchini?

questions.prompt: Vazi maarufu la kitamaduni lenye rangi nyekundu na miraba linalovaliwa na jamii ya Wamaasai na Wasamburu huitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Shuka ya Kimaasai ni vazi linalotambulika kote ulimwenguni kwa uzalendo wa Kenya.
questions.socraticHint: Jamii ya Wamaasai huvaa kitambaa kipi chekundu cha kitamaduni?

questions.prompt: Kweli au Si kweli: Mursik ni kinywaji cha asili cha maziwa yaliyoganda katika jamii ya Wakalenjin.
questions.explanation: Mursik ni maziwa ya kitamaduni yanayotayarishwa kwa kibuyu maalum na majivu ya mti maalum kwa ladha nzuri.
questions.socraticHint: Je, wanariadha wengi wa Bonde la Ufa hufurahia kunywa mursik wanaposhinda medali?

questions.prompt: Chakula cha asili cha jamii ya Wakikuyu kinachotengenezwa kwa viazi, mahindi, maharagwe na mboga za kienyeji zilizopondwa pamoja huitwa ____.
questions.explanation: Mukimo au irio ni chakula cha asili cha kitamu na chenye virutubisho tele.
questions.socraticHint: Ni chakula kipi kinachopondwa viazi na mahindi pamoja na mboga ya kahurura au kienyeji?

questions.prompt: Chakula cha asili kinachotayarishwa kwa ndizi mbichi zilizomenywa na kupikwa kwa mchuzi huitwa nani?
questions.explanation: Matoke hutayarishwa kutokana na ndizi mbichi na huliwa sana Kisii na Magharibi mwa Kenya.
questions.socraticHint: Chakula kinachotokana na ndizi zilizopikwa huitwaje?

questions.prompt: Oanisha chakula cha asili na jamii inayohusishwa nacho nchini Kenya:
questions.correctAnswer: Mursik -> Jamii ya Wakalenjin, Mukimo -> Jamii ya Wakikuyu, Matoke -> Jamii ya Wakisii, Mrenda -> Jamii ya Waluhya

questions.prompt: Mwalimu aliandika ubaoni: 'Wanafunzi wanapanda miti hamsini leo.' Aliwaomba wanafunzi waibadilishe iwe katika kauli ya kutendwa. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi?

questions.prompt: Kitenzi chenye irabu za 'o' au 'e' kama 'choma' au 'tengeneza' huchukua kiambishi gani katika kauli ya kutendwa kirefu?

questions.explanation: Sentensi sahihi ni: 'Mazingira yanatunzwa na jamii nzima.'
