It limits friendships to one's immediate relatives only

questions.correctAnswer: It instills deep humility, reverence for wisdom, gratitude for guidance, and lifelong respect for authority and civic community
questions.explanation: Respect for family and teachers builds the foundation of civil society: creating law-abiding, humble, and hardworking leaders who value mentorship and social cohesion.
questions.socraticHint: How does learning respect and gratitude at home and in school build responsible, law-abiding citizens?

questions.prompt: What does the concept of "Sewa" mean in Hindu spiritual and moral philosophy?
questions.text: What does the concept of "Sewa" mean in Hindu spiritual and moral philosophy?

options.text: Selfless service performed with love and humility without expecting praise, reward, or personal gain
Paid commercial employment in an office
Borrowing money from a bank with interest

questions.correctAnswer: Selfless service performed with love and humility without expecting praise, reward, or personal gain
questions.explanation: Sewa is pure, voluntary, compassionate service done to help others and please the Divine, without calculating personal profit or seeking social recognition.
questions.socraticHint: Which term means selfless voluntary service (Sewa) done without seeking personal reward?

questions.prompt: What are the three practical categories of Sewa through which a person can serve society?
questions.text: What are the three practical categories of Sewa through which a person can serve society?

options.text: Tan (Physical bodily service), Man (Mental/Emotional comfort and prayer), and Dhan (Material/Financial charity)

questions.correctAnswer: Tan (Physical bodily service), Man (Mental/Emotional comfort and prayer), and Dhan (Material/Financial charity)
questions.explanation: Sewa encompasses Tan (using our physical body to clean, carry, and build), Man (using our mind for kind words, prayer, and comfort), and Dhan (donating wealth and resources).
questions.socraticHint: Which three forms of service represent the body (Tan), mind/heart (Man), and wealth (Dhan)?

questions.prompt: Which of the following is an example of "Tan ki Sewa" (physical service) that a Grade 5 pupil can perform at school?
questions.text: Which of the following is an example of "Tan ki Sewa" (physical service) that a Grade 5 pupil can perform at school?

options.text: Giving a large sum of money to the headteacher
Writing an essay about oneself in the school magazine
Sitting in the shade watching others work
Sweeping the classroom, picking up plastic litter from the school playing field, or helping carry books for an injured classmate

questions.correctAnswer: Sweeping the classroom, picking up plastic litter from the school playing field, or helping carry books for an injured classmate
questions.explanation: Tan ki Sewa uses our hands and physical energy to clean, help, organize, and perform practical manual labor for the welfare of others.
questions.socraticHint: Which action involves using your physical hands and body to clean or help someone in school?

questions.prompt: What is an example of "Man ki Sewa" (mental/emotional service)?
questions.text: What is an example of "Man ki Sewa" (mental/emotional service)?

options.text: Comforting a classmate who is grieving, listening patiently to someone in distress, and silently praying for the healing of the sick
Sweeping the dirt off the pavement with a broom
Writing a check to purchase sports uniforms
Winning a computer game against a friend

questions.correctAnswer: Comforting a classmate who is grieving, listening patiently to someone in distress, and silently praying for the healing of the sick
questions.explanation: Man ki Sewa utilizes the mind and empathy: offering emotional comfort, giving uplifting counsel, and sending sincere prayers for the peace and healing of all beings.
questions.socraticHint: How does offering heartfelt comfort, listening with empathy, and praying for someone demonstrate mental service?

questions.prompt: What famous teaching of the Bhagavad Gita (2:47) forms the philosophical foundation of "Nishkama Karma" (selfless action)?
questions.text: What famous teaching of the Bhagavad Gita (2:47) forms the philosophical foundation of "Nishkama Karma" (selfless action)?

options.text: "Avoid all action and remain inactive forever"
"You have a right to perform your duty, but never to the fruits of your actions"
"Work only when you are promised a high salary"
"Do only what makes you famous in the eyes of people"

questions.correctAnswer: "You have a right to perform your duty, but never to the fruits of your actions"
questions.explanation: "Karmanye vadhikaraste ma phaleshu kadachana"—Lord Krishna teaches that we should perform righteous service selflessly without anxiety over results or craving personal reward.
questions.socraticHint: Which verse teaches that our duty is to do good work without being attached to rewards or praise?

questions.prompt: What well-known hospital in Parklands, Nairobi was founded by the Kenyan Hindu community as an enduring institution of medical Sewa?
questions.text: What well-known hospital in Parklands, Nairobi was founded by the Kenyan Hindu community as an enduring institution of medical Sewa?
questions.explanation: M.P. Shah Hospital (formerly Parklands Nursing Home) was established through philanthropic donations by the Hindu community to provide quality healthcare to all Kenyans.
questions.socraticHint: Which major charitable hospital located in Parklands, Nairobi bears the initials M.P. Shah?

questions.prompt: What nationwide medical charity initiative is regularly organized by the Lions Clubs and Hindu communities across Kenyan counties?
questions.text: What nationwide medical charity initiative is regularly organized by the Lions Clubs and Hindu communities across Kenyan counties?

options.text: Free Eye Cataract Surgical Camps and Vision Screening Camps for elderly and rural Kenyans

questions.correctAnswer: Free Eye Cataract Surgical Camps and Vision Screening Camps for elderly and rural Kenyans
questions.explanation: Free cataract eye camps restore sight to thousands of elderly Kenyans across rural counties every year, providing free surgical operations, lenses, and medications as Sewa.
questions.socraticHint: Which free medical camps restore eyesight by performing cataract surgeries for needy Kenyans?

questions.prompt: During severe droughts in Northern Kenya (such as Mandera, Wajir, and Turkana), how does the Hindu Council of Kenya practice Sewa?
questions.text: During severe droughts in Northern Kenya (such as Mandera, Wajir, and Turkana), how does the Hindu Council of Kenya practice Sewa?

options.text: By organizing emergency relief convoys delivering thousands of bags of maize meal, beans, water tanks, and animal feed to affected pastoral families
By closing offices and refusing to participate in relief efforts
By selling food to drought victims at high prices
By advising pastoralists to move out of Kenya

questions.correctAnswer: By organizing emergency relief convoys delivering thousands of bags of maize meal, beans, water tanks, and animal feed to affected pastoral families
questions.explanation: The Hindu Council of Kenya mobilizes food relief caravans and clean water tankers to remote drought zones, demonstrating solidarity with vulnerable Kenyan brothers and sisters.
questions.socraticHint: How do relief convoys distributing maize, beans, and clean water help drought-affected pastoralists?

questions.prompt: What communal dining hall (Langar) tradition practiced in Sikh and Hindu gurdwaras/temples provides free vegetarian meals to anyone who enters?
questions.text: What communal dining hall (Langar) tradition practiced in Sikh and Hindu gurdwaras/temples provides free vegetarian meals to anyone who enters?

options.text: A VIP banquet where leaders sit on elevated chairs
Langar (or Mahaprasad)—where all people sit together on the floor as equals to share food regardless of caste, creed, or wealth
A private restaurant that charges money for each plate
A kitchen open only to members of the royal family

questions.correctAnswer: Langar (or Mahaprasad)—where all people sit together on the floor as equals to share food regardless of caste, creed, or wealth
questions.explanation: Langar serves thousands of hot meals daily: all people sit on the same level, breaking social hierarchies and embodying universal hospitality and human equality.
questions.socraticHint: Which sacred community kitchen serves free food to all visitors sitting side-by-side on the floor?

questions.prompt: How does Swami Vivekananda’s motto "Daridra Narayana" view service to the poor and vulnerable?
questions.text: How does Swami Vivekananda’s motto "Daridra Narayana" view service to the poor and vulnerable?

options.text: Only rich people can experience the Divine
Spiritual seekers should avoid helping society
Serving the poor, the sick, and the suffering is the highest form of worship, for God (Narayana) dwells within the hearts of the humble
The poor should be blamed for their poverty

questions.correctAnswer: Serving the poor, the sick, and the suffering is the highest form of worship, for God (Narayana) dwells within the hearts of the humble
questions.explanation: Swami Vivekananda declared: "Where can you search for God if you cannot see Him in the poor, the sick, and the needy? Serve them as you would serve God Himself!"
questions.socraticHint: How does serving the poor equate to serving God according to Swami Vivekananda?

questions.prompt: How does volunteering in school cleanup drives or tree planting clubs teach a Grade 5 pupil the spirit of Sewa?
questions.text: How does volunteering in school cleanup drives or tree planting clubs teach a Grade 5 pupil the spirit of Sewa?

options.text: It guarantees that the pupil will never have to wash dishes at home
It is done only to get an award badge from the teacher
It teaches that manual work is only for paid cleaners
It instills pride in community service, breaks laziness and snobbery, and shows that working selflessly for others brings deep inner satisfaction

questions.correctAnswer: It instills pride in community service, breaks laziness and snobbery, and shows that working selflessly for others brings deep inner satisfaction
questions.explanation: Volunteering in communal work (Sewa) nurtures dignity of labor, fosters civic responsibility, and teaches that true happiness comes from uplifting the community.
questions.socraticHint: How does hands-on community service build humility, dignity of labor, and genuine joy in children?

questions.prompt: Why is Nishkama Sewa (selfless service without ego) described as the greatest purifier of the human heart (Chitta Shuddhi)?
questions.text: Why is Nishkama Sewa (selfless service without ego) described as the greatest purifier of the human heart (Chitta Shuddhi)?

options.text: It burns away pride, greed, and selfishness, expanding the heart with unconditional love and preparing the mind for spiritual realization
It makes a person physically exhausted so they cannot think
It forces everyone to agree with our opinions
It guarantees immediate financial wealth in business

questions.correctAnswer: It burns away pride, greed, and selfishness, expanding the heart with unconditional love and preparing the mind for spiritual realization
questions.explanation: Selfless service dissolves the narrow illusion of "I" and "Mine", purifying the subconscious mind (Chitta) of selfishness and opening the heart to divine grace.
questions.socraticHint: How does serving others without seeking credit wash away selfishness and pride from our character?

questions.prompt: What does the sacred festival of "Navratri" celebrate in Hindu tradition?
questions.text: What does the sacred festival of "Navratri" celebrate in Hindu tradition?

options.text: The coronation of ancient Greek emperors
Nine nights celebrating the divine feminine power (Shakti / Durga) and the triumph of righteousness over the demon Mahishasura
Nine days of fasting from all fruit juices
A celebration of ancient sailing ships

questions.correctAnswer: Nine nights celebrating the divine feminine power (Shakti / Durga) and the triumph of righteousness over the demon Mahishasura
questions.explanation: "Nava" means nine and "Ratri" means nights. Navratri celebrates Mother Durga's divine power conquering negativity, ignorance, and the demon of ego Mahishasura.
questions.socraticHint: Which festival lasting nine nights celebrates Mother Durga conquering evil?

questions.prompt: What traditional folk dances are performed during Navratri, where dancers move in concentric circles around a sacred lamp?
questions.text: What traditional folk dances are performed during Navratri, where dancers move in concentric circles around a sacred lamp?
questions.explanation: Garba (clapping in rhythmic circles around the Garbha deep lamp) and Dandiya Raas (using polished wooden sticks) celebrate cosmic joy, rhythm, and devotion.
questions.socraticHint: Which famous circular clapping dance and stick dance are performed during Navratri nights?

questions.prompt: What does the circular movement of the Garba dance around a central lit lamp symbolize spiritually?
questions.text: What does the circular movement of the Garba dance around a central lit lamp symbolize spiritually?

options.text: A race to see which dancer finishes first
An imitation of planets escaping from their orbits
The cyclical nature of time and cosmic life revolving around the eternal, unchanging Divine Light at the center

questions.correctAnswer: The cyclical nature of time and cosmic life revolving around the eternal, unchanging Divine Light at the center
questions.explanation: The circle symbolizes the wheel of life and time moving endlessly, while the central glowing lamp (Garbha Deep) represents the unchanging, eternal Divine within.
questions.socraticHint: How does moving in a circle around a central lamp represent our lives revolving around God?

questions.prompt: What is the tenth day following Navratri called, celebrating the final victory of Lord Rama over Ravana and Durga over Mahishasura?
questions.text: What is the tenth day following Navratri called, celebrating the final victory of Lord Rama over Ravana and Durga over Mahishasura?
questions.explanation: Vijayadashami ("the victorious tenth day") or Dussehra commemorates the ultimate victory of good over evil, celebrated by burning effigies of Ravana and starting new education.
questions.socraticHint: Which festival named after "Vijaya" (victory) and "Dashami" (tenth day) celebrates the triumph of good?

questions.prompt: What is the spiritual significance of observing Maha Shivratri ("The Great Night of Shiva")?
questions.text: What is the spiritual significance of observing Maha Shivratri ("The Great Night of Shiva")?

options.text: A day for shopping in commercial malls
A night of fasting, meditation, self-discipline, and prayer to quiet mental agitation and conquer inner negative tendencies like anger and ego
A night for loud fireworks and eating sugary snacks
A public parade of royal horses and chariots

questions.correctAnswer: A night of fasting, meditation, self-discipline, and prayer to quiet mental agitation and conquer inner negative tendencies like anger and ego
questions.explanation: Maha Shivratri is an introspective vigil: meditating in stillness through the night, chanting "Om Namah Shivaya", and seeking inner peace and mastery over base desires.
questions.socraticHint: How does staying awake in prayer and meditation on Shivratri help calm the mind and overcome anger?

questions.prompt: What three-pronged sacred leaf is traditionally offered to Lord Shiva on Maha Shivratri?
questions.text: What three-pronged sacred leaf is traditionally offered to Lord Shiva on Maha Shivratri?
questions.explanation: The trifoliate Bilva leaf symbolizes the three Gunas (Sattva, Rajas, Tamas) surrendered to Shiva, as well as Shiva's three eyes and the Trishula (trident).
questions.socraticHint: Which three-lobed sacred leaf is uniquely offered on the Shiva Lingam?

questions.prompt: What powerful five-syllable mantra (Panchakshari Mantra) is chanted during Maha Shivratri?
questions.text: What powerful five-syllable mantra (Panchakshari Mantra) is chanted during Maha Shivratri?
questions.explanation: "Om Namah Shivaya" (Na-Ma-Shi-Va-Ya) is the five-syllable mantra honoring Lord Shiva, meaning "I bow to the Auspicious One who resides in the core of existence."
questions.socraticHint: Which five-syllable chant meaning "I bow to Shiva" is repeated on Shivratri?

questions.prompt: What does the festival of "Guru Purnima" celebrate on the full moon of Ashadha?
questions.text: What does the festival of "Guru Purnima" celebrate on the full moon of Ashadha?

options.text: Expressing deep gratitude to spiritual teachers, school educators, and Sage Veda Vyasa who compiled sacred knowledge
Buying new electronic gadgets for school
Celebrating the planting of rice crops in rivers
The end of winter weather in high mountains

questions.correctAnswer: Expressing deep gratitude to spiritual teachers, school educators, and Sage Veda Vyasa who compiled sacred knowledge
questions.explanation: Guru Purnima honors the birth of Sage Vyasa (the original compiler of the Vedas) and pays profound tribute to all teachers who guide our intellect away from ignorance.
questions.socraticHint: Which full-moon festival honors Sage Vyasa and all our teachers who guide our minds to truth?

questions.prompt: What spring festival celebrates joy, forgiveness, the triumph of devotee Prahlada, and the colorful diversity of nature?
questions.text: What spring festival celebrates joy, forgiveness, the triumph of devotee Prahlada, and the colorful diversity of nature?
questions.explanation: Holi celebrates the bonfire of Holika Dahan, the salvation of Prahlada, the arrival of spring blossoms, and the joy of smearing vibrant colored powders (Gulal) in brotherhood.
questions.socraticHint: Which festival celebrated with vibrant colored powders (Gulal) marks the triumph of Prahlada over Holika?

questions.prompt: What social lesson of equality and reconciliation does the smearing of colors during Holi teach?
questions.text: What social lesson of equality and reconciliation does the smearing of colors during Holi teach?

options.text: Colors should only be shared with wealthy family friends
It shows that people should stay indoors and not speak to neighbors
When everyone is covered in joyful colors, social differences of wealth, status, and appearance vanish; past grudges are forgiven and mutual love is renewed
People should ruin clean school uniforms intentionally

questions.correctAnswer: When everyone is covered in joyful colors, social differences of wealth, status, and appearance vanish; past grudges are forgiven and mutual love is renewed
questions.explanation: Holi is the great leveler: under the colors, all human beings look identical, dissolving barriers of rank and wealth, fostering reconciliation, warm hugs, and forgiveness.
questions.socraticHint: How does sharing colors break down social rank and allow people to forgive past misunderstandings?

questions.prompt: In Kenyan towns like Mombasa, Nakuru, and Nairobi, how does the public celebration of Navratri and Diwali enrich Kenyan cultural diversity?
questions.text: In Kenyan towns like Mombasa, Nakuru, and Nairobi, how does the public celebration of Navratri and Diwali enrich Kenyan cultural diversity?

options.text: It forces everyone in Kenya to dance the same steps
It causes disruption and disputes between neighborhoods
It requires that all businesses in Kenya shut down for a month
It creates vibrant cultural exchange, welcomes non-Hindu fellow citizens to share traditional foods and music, and highlights Kenya as a harmonious multi-cultural tapestry

questions.correctAnswer: It creates vibrant cultural exchange, welcomes non-Hindu fellow citizens to share traditional foods and music, and highlights Kenya as a harmonious multi-cultural tapestry
questions.explanation: Public cultural celebrations showcase the rich diversity of our nation, fostering mutual cultural appreciation, interfaith friendship, and tourism in Kenya.
questions.socraticHint: How does sharing cultural celebrations openly with fellow Kenyans foster unity and national pride?

questions.prompt: Why are traditional sweets and treats (Prasadam) shared generously with neighbors and visitors during all Hindu festivals?
questions.text: Why are traditional sweets and treats (Prasadam) shared generously with neighbors and visitors during all Hindu festivals?

options.text: To spread sweetness, hospitality, and joy, ensuring that no neighbor or visitor feels excluded from the blessing of celebration
Because sweets spoil if kept for more than two hours
To sell sweets at high prices to earn personal profit
Because temple rules forbid eating sweets at home

questions.correctAnswer: To spread sweetness, hospitality, and joy, ensuring that no neighbor or visitor feels excluded from the blessing of celebration
questions.explanation: Sharing Prasadam (blessed food) is an expression of generous love: spreading divine blessing, sweetness of speech, and neighborly warmth across the community.
questions.socraticHint: Why is sharing sweets with neighbors a warm symbol of hospitality and shared happiness?

questions.prompt: What historic milestone occurred in July 2017 regarding the recognition of the Hindu community in Kenya?
questions.text: What historic milestone occurred in July 2017 regarding the recognition of the Hindu community in Kenya?

options.text: All holidays in Kenya were renamed
The Hindu community was formally recognized as the 44th official community/tribe of Kenya by presidential proclamation
The first Hindu temple was built in Nairobi
Hindi became an official language of the Kenyan Parliament

questions.correctAnswer: The Hindu community was formally recognized as the 44th official community/tribe of Kenya by presidential proclamation
questions.explanation: In July 2017, the Kenyan government formally gazetted the Hindu community as the 44th tribe of Kenya, celebrating over a century of peaceful, patriotic contribution to the nation.
questions.socraticHint: Which official numbered status—as the 44th community of Kenya—was gazetted in July 2017?

questions.prompt: What interfaith umbrella body in Kenya brings Hindu, Christian, and Muslim leaders together to promote national peace, civic education, and reconciliation?
questions.text: What interfaith umbrella body in Kenya brings Hindu, Christian, and Muslim leaders together to promote national peace, civic education, and reconciliation?

options.text: The Kenya National Chamber of Commerce

questions.explanation: The Inter-Religious Council of Kenya (IRCK) unites leaders from the Hindu Council of Kenya, Christian churches, and Muslim bodies to address national challenges collectively.
questions.socraticHint: Which council with the initials IRCK represents all major religious communities in Kenya?

questions.prompt: How does the ancient Vedic value of "Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam" (the world is one family) guide a Kenyan Hindu pupil's relationship with Christian and Muslim classmates?
questions.text: How does the ancient Vedic value of "Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam" (the world is one family) guide a Kenyan Hindu pupil's relationship with Christian and Muslim classmates?

options.text: It tells the pupil to avoid sitting next to students of other faiths
It suggests that people of different religions should not play sports together
It forbids talking to students who speak different languages
It inspires the pupil to treat all classmates with deep brotherly love, mutual respect, and warmth, celebrating shared citizenship and common humanity

questions.correctAnswer: It inspires the pupil to treat all classmates with deep brotherly love, mutual respect, and warmth, celebrating shared citizenship and common humanity
questions.explanation: Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam teaches that all human beings are children of the one Supreme Reality; treating classmates as brothers and sisters builds lasting national unity.
questions.socraticHint: How does viewing all Kenyans as members of one family promote friendship and mutual respect across religions?

questions.prompt: In what ways do Kenyan Hindu business owners and industrialists contribute to national economic growth and nation building in Kenya?
questions.text: In what ways do Kenyan Hindu business owners and industrialists contribute to national economic growth and nation building in Kenya?

options.text: By manufacturing goods locally, creating thousands of jobs for Kenyan citizens, paying taxes to fund public services, and investing in community projects
By refusing to hire local Kenyan workers
By transferring all wealth to foreign countries without investing in Kenya
By closing factories whenever there is an election

questions.correctAnswer: By manufacturing goods locally, creating thousands of jobs for Kenyan citizens, paying taxes to fund public services, and investing in community projects
questions.explanation: Ethical enterprise creates employment, builds infrastructure, pays taxes to support national development, and supports local community welfare.
questions.socraticHint: How does creating factories, jobs, and paying taxes help build a prosperous Kenyan nation?

questions.prompt: How does the Hindu religious value of "Asteya" (non-stealing) contribute to fighting the national problem of corruption and bribery in Kenya?
questions.text: How does the Hindu religious value of "Asteya" (non-stealing) contribute to fighting the national problem of corruption and bribery in Kenya?

options.text: It suggests that public money belongs to whoever takes it first
It instills absolute honesty in handling public funds, teaching that stealing public wealth or offering bribes is a grave moral sin that damages society
It encourages taking bribes as long as nobody is looking
It implies that corruption is normal in business

questions.correctAnswer: It instills absolute honesty in handling public funds, teaching that stealing public wealth or offering bribes is a grave moral sin that damages society
questions.explanation: Asteya demands that public assets and funds be treated as sacred trusts; stealing or accepting bribes violates Dharma and robs the nation of progress.
questions.socraticHint: How does the moral commitment not to steal (Asteya) inspire citizens to reject bribery and corruption?

questions.prompt: How does participating in national tree growing campaigns support the Hindu spiritual duty of environmental stewardship in Kenya?
questions.text: How does participating in national tree growing campaigns support the Hindu spiritual duty of environmental stewardship in Kenya?

options.text: It is done only for publicity photographs in newspapers
It replaces the need for schools and education
It puts into practice reverence for Mother Earth (Bhumi Devi), protects water catchment towers, and restores biodiversity for future generations of Kenyans
It prevents farmers from using fertile soil

questions.correctAnswer: It puts into practice reverence for Mother Earth (Bhumi Devi), protects water catchment towers, and restores biodiversity for future generations of Kenyans
questions.explanation: Planting trees aligns with Vedic environmental ethics: honoring Mother Earth, restoring ecological balance (Rta), and protecting water towers like Mount Kenya.
questions.socraticHint: How does planting trees protect soil and water while showing sacred reverence to Mother Earth (Bhumi Devi)?

questions.prompt: What does the Kenyan national motto "Harambee" (Let us pull together) share in common with the Vedic principle of collective Yajna?
questions.text: What does the Kenyan national motto "Harambee" (Let us pull together) share in common with the Vedic principle of collective Yajna?

options.text: Both suggest that individuals should work strictly alone without helping others
Both encourage people to depend only on foreign aid
Both promote tribal divisions over national unity
Both emphasize that communities achieve lasting prosperity and overcome hardship through selfless cooperation, shared sacrifice, and pulling together for the common good

questions.correctAnswer: Both emphasize that communities achieve lasting prosperity and overcome hardship through selfless cooperation, shared sacrifice, and pulling together for the common good
questions.explanation: Harambee and Yajna both embody the spirit of mutual cooperation: pooling efforts, resources, and prayers together to build schools, boreholes, and a flourishing nation.
questions.socraticHint: How do both Harambee and Yajna celebrate uniting all community efforts for the common welfare?

questions.prompt: How can a Grade 5 pupil practice active patriotism and peaceful citizenship in their local school in Kenya?
questions.text: How can a Grade 5 pupil practice active patriotism and peaceful citizenship in their local school in Kenya?

options.text: By singing the Kenya National Anthem with pride, obeying school rules, respecting classmates from all 47 counties, and studying diligently to serve the nation
By scribbling on national flags and school walls
By refusing to participate in national holiday assemblies
By insulting classmates who speak other indigenous languages

questions.correctAnswer: By singing the Kenya National Anthem with pride, obeying school rules, respecting classmates from all 47 counties, and studying diligently to serve the nation
questions.explanation: Patriotism begins at school: revering national symbols, respecting fellow citizens of all ethnicities, obeying regulations, and working hard to contribute to Kenya’s future.
questions.socraticHint: Which respectful and hardworking actions show true patriotism in school every day?

questions.prompt: What did the famous verse in the Ramayana declare about the supreme value of one’s mother and motherland?
questions.text: What did the famous verse in the Ramayana declare about the supreme value of one’s mother and motherland?

options.text: "Palaces made of gold are superior to one's birth country"
"Janani Janmabhumishcha Swargadapi Gariyasi" (Mother and motherland are superior even to the comforts of heaven)
"Only foreign kingdoms are worth living in"
"A person should leave their homeland as soon as possible"

questions.correctAnswer: "Janani Janmabhumishcha Swargadapi Gariyasi" (Mother and motherland are superior even to the comforts of heaven)
questions.explanation: Lord Rama uttered these words when declining to stay in golden Lanka, declaring that one's biological mother and one's native motherland are more precious than heaven itself.
questions.socraticHint: Which famous verse proclaims that our mother and motherland are superior even to heaven (Swarga)?

questions.prompt: How does the ancient prayer for peace and rain in the Vedas parallel the prayer in the first stanza of the Kenya National Anthem ("Bless our land and nation...")?
questions.text: How does the ancient prayer for peace and rain in the Vedas parallel the prayer in the first stanza of the Kenya National Anthem ("Bless our land and nation...")?

options.text: Both prayers are written only for military commanders
There is no shared sentiment of prayer for national welfare
Both invoke divine blessing for justice, peace, plentiful harvests, and unity, asking the Creator to protect the land and its people
Both prayers ask for continuous thunderstorms that stop farming

questions.correctAnswer: Both invoke divine blessing for justice, peace, plentiful harvests, and unity, asking the Creator to protect the land and its people
questions.explanation: Both prayers embody identical aspirations: invoking the Supreme God of all creation to bestow peace, abundance, justice, and brotherly unity upon the nation.
questions.socraticHint: How do both the Kenya National Anthem and Vedic peace prayers seek God's blessings for peace, justice, and plenty for the nation?

questions.prompt: How can Kenyan primary learners from diverse faith traditions (CRE, IRE, and HRE) celebrate their shared values together?
questions.text: How can Kenyan primary learners from diverse faith traditions (CRE, IRE, and HRE) celebrate their shared values together?

options.text: By arguing over which religion has the longest prayers
By refusing to sit in the same dining hall during lunchtime
By holding debates where students criticize each other's scriptures
By recognizing shared ethical commitments to honesty, compassion for the poor, reverence for family, protection of nature, and mutual love as proud citizens of Kenya

questions.correctAnswer: By recognizing shared ethical commitments to honesty, compassion for the poor, reverence for family, protection of nature, and mutual love as proud citizens of Kenya
questions.explanation: All three religious curricula in Kenya (CRE, IRE, HRE) share fundamental pillars: love of God, moral truthfulness, care for the vulnerable, peace, and national stewardship.
questions.socraticHint: What shared moral foundations of honesty, compassion, kindness, and love for Kenya unite CRE, IRE, and HRE learners?

questions.prompt: What ultimate vision for Kenyan society is achieved when young learners grow up practicing moral virtues (Sadachar), selfless service (Sewa), and interfaith respect?
questions.text: What ultimate vision for Kenyan society is achieved when young learners grow up practicing moral virtues (Sadachar), selfless service (Sewa), and interfaith respect?

options.text: A peaceful, prosperous, united, and corruption-free Kenya where all citizens enjoy equal dignity, justice, and prosperity under the guidance of Almighty God
A divided society where tribes compete aggressively for resources
A nation where people only care about personal wealth
A country where natural forests and wildlife are completely wiped out

questions.correctAnswer: A peaceful, prosperous, united, and corruption-free Kenya where all citizens enjoy equal dignity, justice, and prosperity under the guidance of Almighty God
questions.explanation: When moral character (Sadachar), selfless action (Sewa), and interfaith brotherhood guide our youth, Kenya fulfills its true potential as a shining beacon of peace, justice, and prosperity in Africa.
questions.socraticHint: What peaceful, prosperous, and united future unfolds for Kenya when our youth lead with moral virtue and selfless service?

questions.prompt: How many 50-shilling notes make 200 shillings?
questions.explanation: 4 × 50 = 200 shillings.
questions.socraticHint: Count by fifties: 50, 100, 150...
questions.kenyanCulturalContext: Fifty shilling notes feature Kenyan wildlife.

questions.prompt: Mwanafunzi anapomwamkua mwalimu wake asubuhi, "Sabalkheri", jibu sahihi la mwalimu ni lipi?
questions.text: Mwanafunzi anapomwamkua mwalimu wake asubuhi, "Sabalkheri", jibu sahihi la mwalimu ni lipi?
questions.explanation: Maamkizi ya asubuhi "Sabalkheri" hujibiwa kwa "Sabalkheri" au "Aheri", ikimaanisha asubuhi njema na salama.
questions.socraticHint: Je, salamu inayotolewa asubuhi inapaswa kujibiwa kwa salamu hiyo hiyo au salamu ya jioni?

questions.prompt: Kulingana na mila za heshima katika jamii za Kenya, mtoto mdogo anapomsalimu mzee au mtu mzima kwa kusema "Shikamoo", mtu mzima hujibu nini?
questions.text: Kulingana na mila za heshima katika jamii za Kenya, mtoto mdogo anapomsalimu mzee au mtu mzima kwa kusema "Shikamoo", mtu mzima hujibu nini?
questions.explanation: "Shikamoo" ni maamkizi ya heshima kutoka kwa mdogo kwenda kwa mkubwa, na jibu lake sahihi na la kipekee ni "Marahaba".
questions.socraticHint: Ni neno lipi la kipekee la Kiswahili linalotumiwa na watu wazima kuitikia salamu ya Shikamoo?

questions.prompt: Mama anapomwamkua mwanawe mdogo mchanga asubuhi kwa neno "Chei chei", mtoto yule anafunzwa kuitikia vipi?
questions.text: Mama anapomwamkua mwanawe mdogo mchanga asubuhi kwa neno "Chei chei", mtoto yule anafunzwa kuitikia vipi?
questions.explanation: Maamkizi maalum ya watoto wachanga wanaoanza kujifunza kuongea ni "Chei chei", na mtoto huitikia "Chei".
questions.socraticHint: Salamu ya mtoto mchanga inayorudiwa kama wimbo mdogo huitikiwaje?

questions.prompt: Jioni inapoingia wakati wa machweo, watu wawili wanaokutana wanapaswa kutumia maamkizi gani sahihi?
questions.text: Jioni inapoingia wakati wa machweo, watu wawili wanaokutana wanapaswa kutumia maamkizi gani sahihi?
questions.explanation: "Masalkheri" ni maamkizi ya nyakati za jioni (kuanzia alasiri hadi usiku), nayo huitikiwa kwa "Masalkheri" au "Aheri".
questions.socraticHint: Ni salamu gani ya Kiswahili inayoanza na "Masa-" inayotumiwa jioni?

questions.prompt: Ni tabia gani inayoonyesha adabu njema ya mazungumzo mwanafunzi anapokuwa kwenye meza ya chakula au mkutano wa familia?
questions.text: Ni tabia gani inayoonyesha adabu njema ya mazungumzo mwanafunzi anapokuwa kwenye meza ya chakula au mkutano wa familia?

options.text: Kukimbia kutoka mezani bila kuomba ruhusa ya wazazi
Kusikiliza wengine kwa makini na kutoingilia maongezi kabla ya msemaji kumaliza
Kuzungumza kwa sauti kubwa ukiwa na chakula mdomoni
Kutumia simu ya mkononi na kucheka wakati wazazi wanazungumza

questions.correctAnswer: Kusikiliza wengine kwa makini na kutoingilia maongezi kabla ya msemaji kumaliza
questions.explanation: Adabu njema inamtaka mtu kumsikiliza msemaji kwa staha bila kukatiza maneno, kutozungumza chakula kikiwa mdomoni, na kuheshimu wakubwa.
questions.socraticHint: Ni matendo gani yanayoonyesha staha na heshima kubwa kwa wazungumzaji wengine?

questions.prompt: Kamau alipita mbele ya mwalimu wake aliyekuwa akizungumza na mzazi. Neno gani la adabu alilopaswa kutumia kuomba njia?
questions.text: Kamau alipita mbele ya mwalimu wake aliyekuwa akizungumza na mzazi. Neno gani la adabu alilopaswa kutumia kuomba njia?
questions.explanation: Neno "Samahani" huonyesha heshima na unyenyekevu unapoingilia njia au unapotaka kupita mbele ya watu wazima.
questions.socraticHint: Ni neno lipi la adabu linalotumiwa kuomba msamaha au kuomba njia kwa staha?

questions.prompt: Mtu anapokufanyia wema au kukupa zawadi shuleni, neno lipi la Kiswahili linadhihirisha shukrani ya kweli?
questions.text: Mtu anapokufanyia wema au kukupa zawadi shuleni, neno lipi la Kiswahili linadhihirisha shukrani ya kweli?
questions.explanation: "Asante" na "Nashukuru" ni maneno ya adabu yanayotumiwa kutambua na kuthamini wema au msaada uliopewa na mtu mwingine.
questions.socraticHint: Ni neno lipi tunalotamka kueleza furaha na shukrani kwa mtu aliyetusaidia?

questions.prompt: Amina alitaka kuazima rula kutoka kwa mwenzake darasani. Ni ombi gani linalozingatia kanuni bora za mawasiliano ya heshima?
questions.text: Amina alitaka kuazima rula kutoka kwa mwenzake darasani. Ni ombi gani linalozingatia kanuni bora za mawasiliano ya heshima?

options.text: "Tafadhali niazime rula yako nitumie kwa dakika chache kisha nikurudishie."
"Nipe hiyo rula yako haraka nina kazi!"
"Weka rula hapa mezani kwangu sasa hivi."

questions.correctAnswer: "Tafadhali niazime rula yako nitumie kwa dakika chache kisha nikurudishie."
questions.explanation: Matumizi ya neno "Tafadhali", sauti ya upole, na ahadi ya kurudisha kifaa hicho yanaonyesha ukomavu na adabu ya mwanafunzi mwema.
questions.socraticHint: Mawasiliano ya heshima hutumia maneno ya upole kama "tafadhali" badala ya amri au vitisho.

questions.prompt: Mtu anapopatwa na msiba, ajali, au maumivu mwilini, ni kauli gani ya Kiswahili inayoonyesha huruma na faraja?
questions.text: Mtu anapopatwa na msiba, ajali, au maumivu mwilini, ni kauli gani ya Kiswahili inayoonyesha huruma na faraja?
questions.explanation: Kauli ya "Pole" hutolewa kumfariji na kumpa moyo mtu aliyepatwa na shida, msiba, maumivu, au changamoto yoyote maishani.
questions.socraticHint: Ni neno gani fupi linalotumiwa kueleza hisia za huruma na kumpa mtu faraja?

questions.prompt: Watu wawili wanapoagana usiku kabla ya kwenda kulala, maamkizi gani ya kidesturi yanayotumiwa kutakiana usiku mwema?
questions.text: Watu wawili wanapoagana usiku kabla ya kwenda kulala, maamkizi gani ya kidesturi yanayotumiwa kutakiana usiku mwema?
questions.explanation: "Alamsiki" ni salamu ya kuagana usiku (ikimaanisha uwe na usiku mwema na salama), na jibu lake sahihi ni "Binuru" (ikimaanisha uwe wenye nuru na amani).
questions.socraticHint: Ni neno lipi la kipekee la kuagana usiku linalojibiwa kwa "Binuru"?

questions.prompt: Mgeni anapogonga hodi langoni mwa nyumba, mwenye nyumba anapaswa kumkaribisha kwa kusema nini?
questions.text: Mgeni anapogonga hodi langoni mwa nyumba, mwenye nyumba anapaswa kumkaribisha kwa kusema nini?
questions.explanation: Utamaduni wa ukarimu wa Kiafrika na lugha ya Kiswahili unamtaka mwenyeji kumkaribisha mgeni anayegonga hodi kwa bashasha akisema "Karibu ndani".
questions.socraticHint: Mtu anaposema "Hodi", jibu la kawaida la kumruhusu kuingia ni lipi?

questions.prompt: Kwanini ni muhimu kwa watoto wa Kenya kujifunza na kutumia maamkizi na lugha ya heshima kila siku?
questions.text: Kwanini ni muhimu kwa watoto wa Kenya kujifunza na kutumia maamkizi na lugha ya heshima kila siku?

options.text: Inajenga mahusiano mema, nidhamu ya kijamii, na mshikamano wa amani kati ya vizazi
Ili kuwasaidia watoto kuwaamuru na kuwatisha wenzao shuleni
Inawafanya watoto wapate zawadi za pesa kila asubuhi bila kufanya kazi
Ili kuonyesha kuwa watoto wanajua maneno magumu kuliko watu wazima

questions.correctAnswer: Inajenga mahusiano mema, nidhamu ya kijamii, na mshikamano wa amani kati ya vizazi
questions.explanation: Lugha ya heshima huimarisha maadili ya CBC, hupunguza migogoro, na huunganisha jamii katika upendo na staha.
questions.socraticHint: Lugha ya adabu na maamkizi huchangia vipi kujenga amani na maelewano katika taifa letu?

questions.prompt: Nomino "Mkate" na wingi wake "Mikate" huwekwa katika ngeli gani ya Kiswahili?
questions.text: Nomino "Mkate" na wingi wake "Mikate" huwekwa katika ngeli gani ya Kiswahili?
questions.explanation: Nomino za vitu visivyo na uhai zinazoanza na "M-" katika umoja na "Mi-" katika wingi (kama mkate/mikate, mti/miti) huingia katika ngeli ya U-I.
questions.socraticHint: Angalia viambishi vya upatanisho: Mkate u-liokwa vizuri, Mikate i-liokwa vizuri. Hii ni ngeli gani?

questions.prompt: Chagua wingi sahihi wa sentensi hii ya ngeli ya U-I: "Mti mrefu umeanguka kando ya barabara."
questions.text: Chagua wingi sahihi wa sentensi hii ya ngeli ya U-I: "Mti mrefu umeanguka kando ya barabara."

options.text: Miti mirefu wameanguka kando ya barabara.
Miti mrefu zimeanguka kando ya barabara.
Miti mirefu imeanguka kando ya barabara.
Miti refu yameanguka kando ya barabara.

questions.correctAnswer: Miti mirefu imeanguka kando ya barabara.

questions.explanation: Bomas of Kenya ilianzishwa ili kuhifadhi na kuonyesha tamaduni, makazi asilia, na sanaa za maonyesho za makabila yote ya Kenya.
questions.socraticHint: Jina "Bomas" linatokana na neno "boma" kumaanisha kijiji au makazi ya kitamaduni.

questions.prompt: Chombo cha kiasili cha mti kilichochongwa chenye shimo katikati kinachotumiwa pamoja na mchi kutwanga nafaka kama mahindi huitwaje?
questions.text: Chombo cha kiasili cha mti kilichochongwa chenye shimo katikati kinachotumiwa pamoja na mchi kutwanga nafaka kama mahindi huitwaje?
questions.explanation: Kinu hutumika pamoja na mchi (mti mzito wa kutwangia) kuponda na kutwanga nafaka, mihogo, au viungo jikoni.
questions.socraticHint: Chombo cha mti kinachotumiwa kutwanga kande au unga kwa mchi kinaitwaje?

questions.prompt: Chombo bapa kilichosukwa kwa mianzi au nyasi kinachotumiwa kupepeta na kupekecha nafaka ili kuondoa makapi huitwaje?
questions.text: Chombo bapa kilichosukwa kwa mianzi au nyasi kinachotumiwa kupepeta na kupekecha nafaka ili kuondoa makapi huitwaje?
questions.explanation: Uteo au ungo hutumiwa na wazazi kupepeta mahindi, mtama, au mchele ili upepo upeperushe makapi na kuacha nafaka safi.
questions.socraticHint: Chombo cha duara kinachotumiwa kupepeta nafaka juani kikitikiswa hewani.

questions.prompt: Shuka nzito yenye miraba myekundu na ya buluu inayovaliwa na jamii ya Wamaasai na Wasamburu huitwaje?
questions.text: Shuka nzito yenye miraba myekundu na ya buluu inayovaliwa na jamii ya Wamaasai na Wasamburu huitwaje?
questions.explanation: Shuka ya Kimasai ni vazi maarufu la utambulisho wa kitaifa linalovutia watalii wengi na huvaliwa kwa fahari na jamii za wafugaji.
questions.socraticHint: Vazi la kitamaduni la rangi nyekundu linalovaliwa na mashujaa wa Kimasai (Moran).

questions.prompt: Kwanini ni muhimu kwa watoto wa Kenya kujivunia na kudumisha sanaa na vyombo vya kiasili vya nchi yetu?
questions.text: Kwanini ni muhimu kwa watoto wa Kenya kujivunia na kudumisha sanaa na vyombo vya kiasili vya nchi yetu?

options.text: Huhifadhi hekima na utambulisho wa taifa, huleta mshikamano, na kuwapa mafundi riziki ya kiuchumi
Ili kuwalazimisha watu wasitumie vifaa vya kisasa hata kidogo
Ili kuwafanya wazazi wasinunue nguo madukani

questions.correctAnswer: Huhifadhi hekima na utambulisho wa taifa, huleta mshikamano, na kuwapa mafundi riziki ya kiuchumi
questions.explanation: Sanaa za asili ni sehemu ya utajiri wetu wa kihistoria; zinatutofautisha na mataifa mengine na kukuza ajira za ufundi.
questions.socraticHint: Kuthamini asili yetu kunaimarisha vipi heshima na utambulisho wetu kama Wakenya?

questions.prompt: Kifaa cha kienyeji cha kupimia nafaka sokoni au shambani chenye asili ya Pwani ya Kenya kiliitwaje?
questions.text: Kifaa cha kienyeji cha kupimia nafaka sokoni au shambani chenye asili ya Pwani ya Kenya kiliitwaje?
questions.explanation: Kibaba na pishi yalikuwa vipimo vya kitamaduni vya kupimia nafaka kama mchele, mtama, au kunde kabla ya kuanzishwa kwa kilo.
questions.socraticHint: Methali inasema: "Haba na haba hujaza..." Kibaba!

questions.prompt: Kamilisha methali ya Kiswahili: "Haba na haba, hujaza ________."
questions.text: Kamilisha methali ya Kiswahili: "Haba na haba, hujaza ________."
questions.explanation: Methali hii inafundisha kuwa kidogo kidogo kinachokusanywa au kuhifadhiwa kwa uvumilivu hatimaye kitajaza chombo kikubwa na kuleta mafanikio makubwa.
questions.socraticHint: Ni chombo gani cha kiasili cha kupimia kinachotajwa kwenye methali hii maarufu ya akiba?

questions.prompt: Vyombo vya kupikia vya kiasili vilivyotengenezwa kwa nazi iliyokaushwa na kukatwa katikati (vibuyu vidogo vya kuchotea maji au uji) huitwaje?
questions.text: Vyombo vya kupikia vya kiasili vilivyotengenezwa kwa nazi iliyokaushwa na kukatwa katikati (vibuyu vidogo vya kuchotea maji au uji) huitwaje?
questions.explanation: Kifuu cha nazi na kata hutumika vijijini kama vyombo vya asili vya kunywea maji, uji, au maziwa ya mgando.
questions.socraticHint: Gamba gumu la nazi lililokaushwa linatumiwa kama bakuli ya asili.

questions.prompt: Mapambo ya shanga yenye maumbo mbalimbali ya kuvutia yanayovaliwa shingoni na mikononi yanasifika sana katika jamii gani ya Kenya?
questions.text: Mapambo ya shanga yenye maumbo mbalimbali ya kuvutia yanayovaliwa shingoni na mikononi yanasifika sana katika jamii gani ya Kenya?

options.text: Hakuna jamii nchini Kenya inayovaa shanga

questions.explanation: Ushanga ni sehemu kuu ya utamaduni, ndoa, na hadhi ya kijamii miongoni mwa wanawake wa kimaasai na kisamburu nchini Kenya.
questions.socraticHint: Jamii za kaskazini na bonde la ufa za wafugaji zinazosifika kwa shanga zenye rangi za bendera ya Kenya.

questions.prompt: Kitenzi "Pika" kinaponyumbuliwa katika KAULI YA KUTENDEA (kufanya kitendo kwa ajili ya mtu mwingine) kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.text: Kitenzi "Pika" kinaponyumbuliwa katika KAULI YA KUTENDEA (kufanya kitendo kwa ajili ya mtu mwingine) kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.explanation: Mzizi "pik-" una irabu "i", kwa hivyo huchukua kiambishi "-ia" katika kauli ya kutendea: "Mama anampikia mtoto uji."
questions.socraticHint: Unapompikia mtu chakula, kitenzi kinamalizika na "-ia".

questions.prompt: Kitenzi "Soma" kinaponyumbuliwa katika KAULI YA KUTENDEA kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.text: Kitenzi "Soma" kinaponyumbuliwa katika KAULI YA KUTENDEA kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.explanation: Mzizi "som-" una irabu ya wastani "o", kwa hivyo huchukua kiambishi "-ea" badala ya "-ia": "Mwalimu anawasomea wanafunzi hadithi."
questions.socraticHint: Kwa sababu neno "soma" lina herufi "o", linafuata kanuni ya kuchukua "-ea".

questions.prompt: Kitenzi "Andika" kinaponyumbuliwa katika KAULI YA KUTENDEWA (kupokea kitendo) kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.text: Kitenzi "Andika" kinaponyumbuliwa katika KAULI YA KUTENDEWA (kupokea kitendo) kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.explanation: Katika kauli ya kutendewa inayotokana na kutendea, mzizi "andik-" (irabu a/i) huchukua "-iwa": "Mwanafunzi aliandikiwa barua ya pongezi na mwalimu wake."
questions.socraticHint: Mtu anapopokea barua kutoka kwa mwingine tunasema "ameandikiwa barua".

questions.prompt: Sentensi hii ipo katika kauli gani ya kitenzi: "Wagonjwa walitibiwa hospitalini na daktari mtaalamu"?
questions.text: Sentensi hii ipo katika kauli gani ya kitenzi: "Wagonjwa walitibiwa hospitalini na daktari mtaalamu"?
questions.explanation: Kitenzi "walitibiwa" kina kiambishi cha kutendewa "-wa", kikionyesha wagonjwa walipokea kitendo cha matibabu kutoka kwa daktari.
questions.socraticHint: Wagonjwa ndio waliopokea kitendo cha kutibiwa. Hii ni kauli ya mtendwa au mtendewa.

questions.prompt: Kitenzi "Chora" kinaponyumbuliwa katika KAULI YA KUTENDEWA kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.text: Kitenzi "Chora" kinaponyumbuliwa katika KAULI YA KUTENDEWA kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.explanation: Mzizi "chor-" una irabu "o", kwa hivyo katika kutendewa huchukua "-ewa" na kuwa "chorewa": "Mtoto alichorewa picha nzuri ya simba."
questions.socraticHint: Irabu "o" inazaa "-ewa" katika kauli ya kutendewa.

questions.prompt: Ni sentensi ipi kati ya zifuatazo iliyo katika KAULI YA KUTENDEA?
questions.text: Ni sentensi ipi kati ya zifuatazo iliyo katika KAULI YA KUTENDEA?

options.text: Bustani ya mboga ililimwa na Kiprono.
Kiprono alimlimia nyanya yake bustani ya mboga.

questions.correctAnswer: Kiprono alimlimia nyanya yake bustani ya mboga.
questions.explanation: "Alimlimia" kiko katika kauli ya kutendea (-ia), kikionyesha kitendo kilifanyika kwa ajili na manufaa ya nyanya.
questions.socraticHint: Tafuta sentensi inayoonyesha kitendo kilifanywa kwa ajili ya mtu mwingine (alimlimia).

questions.prompt: Kanuni ya kuchagua kati ya kiambishi "-ia" na "-ea" katika kauli ya kutendea inategemea nini?
questions.text: Kanuni ya kuchagua kati ya kiambishi "-ia" na "-ea" katika kauli ya kutendea inategemea nini?

options.text: Idadi ya herufi za nomino inayofuata
Ikiwa mtu anayezungumza ni mwanafunzi au mwalimu
Irabu zilizomo katika mzizi wa kitenzi (a, i, u huchukua -ia; e, o huchukua -ea)

questions.correctAnswer: Irabu zilizomo katika mzizi wa kitenzi (a, i, u huchukua -ia; e, o huchukua -ea)
questions.explanation: Katika sarufi ya Kiswahili, upatanisho wa irabu (vowel harmony) unaeleza kuwa e na o huzaa -ea, na a, i, u huzaa -ia.
questions.socraticHint: Sheria hii inategemea sauti za irabu zilizopo kwenye shina la neno.

questions.prompt: Kitenzi "Shona" kinaponyumbuliwa katika kauli ya KUTENDEA kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.text: Kitenzi "Shona" kinaponyumbuliwa katika kauli ya KUTENDEA kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.explanation: Kwa sababu mzizi "shon-" una irabu "o", huchukua "-ea": "Fundi anawashonea watoto sare za shule."
questions.socraticHint: Shona ina irabu "o", kwa hivyo inachukua -ea na kuwa shonea.

questions.prompt: Sentensi hii ifanyiwe mabadiliko ya kuingia katika kauli ya KUTENDEWA: "Fundi alitengeneza kiti." Sentensi sahihi ni ipi?
questions.text: Sentensi hii ifanyiwe mabadiliko ya kuingia katika kauli ya KUTENDEWA: "Fundi alitengeneza kiti." Sentensi sahihi ni ipi?
questions.explanation: Katika kauli ya kutendwa/kutendewa, kitu kilichopokea tendo (kiti) kinakuwa kiima cha sentensi: "Kiti kilitengenezwa na fundi."
questions.socraticHint: Kiti ndicho kilichopokea tendo, kwa hivyo sentensi inaanza na "Kiti kili-..."

questions.prompt: Kitenzi "Fagia" kinaponyumbuliwa katika kauli ya KUTENDEA kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.text: Kitenzi "Fagia" kinaponyumbuliwa katika kauli ya KUTENDEA kinakuwa neno gani?
questions.explanation: Kitenzi "fagia" huingiza konsonanti ya "l" na kiambishi "-ia" na kuwa "fagilia": "Amina alimfagilia mama chumba cha wageni."
questions.socraticHint: Fagia inabadilika kuwa fagilia (kuweka herufi "l" katikati).

questions.prompt: Ni sentensi ipi ifuatayo ambapo kitenzi kipo katika KAULI YA KUTENDA (hali yake ya asili bila kunyumbuliwa)?
questions.text: Ni sentensi ipi ifuatayo ambapo kitenzi kipo katika KAULI YA KUTENDA (hali yake ya asili bila kunyumbuliwa)?

options.text: Mwanafunzi anasomewa kitabu cha Kiswahili na mwalimu.
Mwanafunzi anamsomea rafiki yake kitabu cha Kiswahili.
Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu cha Kiswahili darasani.

questions.correctAnswer: Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu cha Kiswahili darasani.
questions.explanation: "Anasoma" ni kitenzi cha asili katika kauli ya kutenda mtendaji akifanya kazi yake mwenyewe.
questions.socraticHint: Tafuta kitenzi cha kawaida: anasoma (bila -ea, -ewa, au -wa).

questions.prompt: Kamilisha sentensi ifuatayo kwa kauli sahihi ya kutendea: "Mwanariadha wa Kenya _______ nchi yake medali ya dhahabu."
questions.text: Kamilisha sentensi ifuatayo kwa kauli sahihi ya kutendea: "Mwanariadha wa Kenya _______ nchi yake medali ya dhahabu."
questions.explanation: Kitenzi "leta" kina irabu "e", hivyo katika kauli ya kutendea kinakuwa "letea" (aliiletea nchi yake = alifanya kitendo cha kuleta kwa faida ya nchi yake).
questions.socraticHint: Leta inabadilika kuwa letea kwa sababu ya irabu "e".

questions.prompt: Kifungu cha mistari katika shairi la Kiswahili (kinacholingana na aya katika insha) huitwaje?
questions.text: Kifungu cha mistari katika shairi la Kiswahili (kinacholingana na aya katika insha) huitwaje?
questions.explanation: Ubeti ni kifungu cha mistari (mishororo) kinachounda sehemu moja ya shairi; shairi linaweza kuwa na beti kadhaa.
questions.socraticHint: Aya ya shairi inaitwa ubeti.

questions.prompt: Mstari mmoja katika ubeti wa shairi la Kiswahili huitwaje kwa neno maalum la kitaalamu?
questions.text: Mstari mmoja katika ubeti wa shairi la Kiswahili huitwaje kwa neno maalum la kitaalamu?
questions.explanation: Kila mstari mmoja unaoandikwa kwenye ubeti wa shairi unaitwa "mshororo" (wingi: mishororo).
questions.socraticHint: Mstari mmoja wa shairi huitwa mshororo.

questions.prompt: Silabi zinazofanana kimatamshi na herufi mwishoni mwa nusu mstari au mwishoni mwa mshororo katika shairi huitwaje?
questions.text: Silabi zinazofanana kimatamshi na herufi mwishoni mwa nusu mstari au mwishoni mwa mshororo katika shairi huitwaje?
questions.explanation: Vina ni mapigo na sauti za silabi zinazolingana mwanzoni au mwishoni mwa mistari ya shairi ili kuleta mahadhi ya muziki.
questions.socraticHint: Silabi zinazolingana kimatamshi mwishoni mwa mistari kama rhyming sounds.

questions.prompt: Idadi ya silabi zinazotamkwa katika kila mshororo wa shairi la kimapokeo huitwaje?
questions.text: Idadi ya silabi zinazotamkwa katika kila mshororo wa shairi la kimapokeo huitwaje?
questions.explanation: Mizani ni kipimo cha idadi ya silabi katika mshororo wa shairi (mfano: mishororo mingi ya taratibu huwa na mizani 16 au 8).
questions.socraticHint: Kipimo cha idadi ya silabi katika mstari kinaitwa mizani.

questions.prompt: Tegua kitendawili hiki cha Kiswahili: "Kila niendapo ananifuata lakini siwezi kumshika?"
questions.text: Tegua kitendawili hiki cha Kiswahili: "Kila niendapo ananifuata lakini siwezi kumshika?"
questions.explanation: Kivuli hutembea na kufuata mtu kila aendapo juani au kwenye taa lakini hakiwezi kushikika mkononi.
questions.socraticHint: Kitu hiki kiko chini ardhini kikiiga matendo yako yote mchana juani.

questions.prompt: Tegua kitendawili hiki maarufu: "Nyumba yangu haina mlango wala dirisha?"
questions.text: Tegua kitendawili hiki maarufu: "Nyumba yangu haina mlango wala dirisha?"
questions.explanation: Yai la kuku au ndege limefungwa pande zote kwa gamba gumu lisilo na mlango hadi mtoto atakapoanguliwa.
questions.socraticHint: Kitu cha mviringo chenye kifaranga ndani kisicho na tundu.

questions.prompt: Methali ya Kiswahili "Umoja ni nguvu, utengano ni ________" inafundisha nini?
questions.text: Methali ya Kiswahili "Umoja ni nguvu, utengano ni ________" inafundisha nini?
questions.explanation: Methali inafundisha kwamba watu wakishirikiana wanakuwa na nguvu na ushindi, lakini wakigawanyika wanakuwa dhaifu na kushindwa.
questions.socraticHint: Kinyume cha nguvu kwenye methali hii ni udhaifu.

questions.prompt: Tegua kitendawili: "Popoo mbili zavuka mto?"
questions.text: Tegua kitendawili: "Popoo mbili zavuka mto?"
questions.explanation: Macho mawili yana uwezo wa kutazama na kuona ng'ambo ya mto bila mwili kuvuka mto huo halisi.
questions.socraticHint: Viungo viwili vya usoni vinavyoweza kutazama mbali mara moja.

questions.prompt: Mstari wa mwisho kabisa katika ubeti wa shairi unaorudiwarudiwa katika kila ubeti huitwaje?
questions.text: Mstari wa mwisho kabisa katika ubeti wa shairi unaorudiwarudiwa katika kila ubeti huitwaje?
questions.explanation: Kituo au kibwagizo ni mstari wa mwisho wa ubeti unaorudiwa katika kila ubeti kusisitiza wazo kuu la shairi.
questions.socraticHint: Mstari unaojirudia mwishoni mwa kila ubeti kama chorus.

questions.prompt: Methali "Mvumilivu hula mbivu" inatoa funzo gani muhimu kwa wanafunzi wa shule?
questions.text: Methali "Mvumilivu hula mbivu" inatoa funzo gani muhimu kwa wanafunzi wa shule?

Kula haraka humsaidia mtu kufaulu mitihani
Subira na bidii thabiti maishani huzaa matunda mazuri na mafanikio makubwa
Mwanafunzi anapaswa kula matunda mabichi mara moja

questions.correctAnswer: Subira na bidii thabiti maishani huzaa matunda mazuri na mafanikio makubwa
questions.explanation: Mtu anayevumilia hadi matunda yaive ndiye anayefurahia utamu; subira katika masomo huleta matokeo mema.
questions.socraticHint: Subira huvuta heri na huleta matokeo mema yenye baraka.

questions.prompt: Tegua kitendawili: "Huku ng'o na kule ng'o?"
questions.text: Tegua kitendawili: "Huku ng'o na kule ng'o?"
questions.explanation: Giza totoro la usiku linapotanda, hakuna kitu kinachoonekana pande zote mbili (huku huoni na kule huoni).
questions.socraticHint: Hali ya kutoweza kuona chochote kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa mwanga.

questions.prompt: Kamilisha methali ya Kiswahili: "Asiyesikia la mkuu huvunjika ________."
questions.text: Kamilisha methali ya Kiswahili: "Asiyesikia la mkuu huvunjika ________."
questions.explanation: Methali hii inafundisha watoto kutii mawaidha ya watu wazima na walimu ili kuepuka majanga na maumivu maishani.
questions.socraticHint: Neno la kale la Kiswahili linalomaanisha mguu.

questions.prompt: Ni kipi kinyume sahihi cha kitenzi "Inuka"?
questions.text: Ni kipi kinyume sahihi cha kitenzi "Inuka"?
questions.explanation: Kinyume cha kuinuka ni kuketi chini au kulala.
questions.socraticHint: Mwalimu anaposema msiinuke, mnapaswa kufanya nini kwenye viti?

questions.prompt: Kinyume cha kitendo "Funga" mlango ni kipi?
questions.text: Kinyume cha kitendo "Funga" mlango ni kipi?
questions.explanation: Kinyume cha kufunga mlango au kufuli ni kufungua.
questions.socraticHint: Kitendo cha kufungua kinyume na kufunga.

questions.prompt: Kinyume cha nomino "Rafiki" katika mahusiano ya kibinadamu ni kipi?
questions.text: Kinyume cha nomino "Rafiki" katika mahusiano ya kibinadamu ni kipi?
questions.explanation: Kinyume cha rafiki (mtu anayekupenda na kukutakia mema) ni adui (mtu anayekuchukia na kutaka kukudhuru).
questions.socraticHint: Mtu anayekupiga vita kinyume cha yule anayekupenda.

questions.prompt: Ni jozi ipi ya maneno ambapo maneno hayo ni VINYUME sahihi?
questions.text: Ni jozi ipi ya maneno ambapo maneno hayo ni VINYUME sahihi?
questions.explanation: "Nunua" (kutoa pesa kupata bidhaa) ni kinyume kabisa cha "Uza" (kutoa bidhaa kupata pesa).
questions.socraticHint: Mnunuzi sokoni anafanya kitendo kinyume cha muuzaji.

questions.prompt: Kinyume cha neno "Mwangaza" (Nuru) ni kipi?
questions.text: Kinyume cha neno "Mwangaza" (Nuru) ni kipi?
questions.explanation: Kinyume cha nuru au mwangaza ni giza.
questions.socraticHint: Wakati hakuna nuru wala mwangaza, kunakuwa na nini?

questions.prompt: Sentensi: "Mlima Kenya ni mrefu sana lakini kilima hiki ni _______." Neno lipi linalokamilisha kinyume cha "mrefu"?
questions.text: Sentensi: "Mlima Kenya ni mrefu sana lakini kilima hiki ni _______." Neno lipi linalokamilisha kinyume cha "mrefu"?
questions.explanation: Kinyume cha mrefu ni mfupi/kifupi kulingana na upatanisho wa ngeli ya KI-VI kwa neno "kilima".
questions.socraticHint: Kinyume cha urefu ni ufupi.

questions.prompt: Kinyume cha kitendo "Cheka" kwa furaha ni kipi?
questions.text: Kinyume cha kitendo "Cheka" kwa furaha ni kipi?
questions.explanation: Kicheko huonyesha furaha, na kinyume chake ni kilio (kulia) kinachoonyesha huzuni au uchungu.
questions.socraticHint: Mtu asipocheka kwa furaha analia kwa huzuni.

questions.prompt: Kinyume cha nomino "Amani" nchini ni kipi?
questions.text: Kinyume cha nomino "Amani" nchini ni kipi?
questions.explanation: Kinyume cha amani na utulivu ni vita, mifarakano, au ghasia.
questions.socraticHint: Wakati hakuna amani nchini kunatokea mapigano au vita.

questions.prompt: Kinyume cha kitendo "Panda mti" (kupanda mlimani au kupanda mti) unaposhuka chini ni kipi?
questions.text: Kinyume cha kitendo "Panda mti" (kupanda mlimani au kupanda mti) unaposhuka chini ni kipi?
questions.explanation: Kupanda kuelekea juu kuna kinyume chake cha kuteremka au kushuka kuelekea chini.
questions.socraticHint: Unapopanda ngazi kuelekea juu, kinyume chake unashuka chini.

questions.prompt: Kinyume cha neno "Nadhifu" (mtu aliye safi na mwenye mavazi yaliyonyooshwa vizuri) ni kipi?
questions.text: Kinyume cha neno "Nadhifu" (mtu aliye safi na mwenye mavazi yaliyonyooshwa vizuri) ni kipi?
questions.explanation: Nadhifu inamaanisha usafi na uzuri wa mavazi au mazingira, na kinyume chake ni uchafu.
questions.socraticHint: Kinyume cha unadhifu na usafi ni uchafu.

questions.prompt: Katika biashara, mfanyabiashara asipopata "Faida" kwenye mauzo yake anapata nini kwa kinyume chake?
questions.text: Katika biashara, mfanyabiashara asipopata "Faida" kwenye mauzo yake anapata nini kwa kinyume chake?
questions.explanation: Kinyume cha faida (kupata zaidi ya ulichowekeza) ni hasara (kupoteza fedha au mali).
questions.socraticHint: Kupoteza pesa kwenye biashara kunaitwa kupata nini kinyume cha faida?

questions.prompt: Bainisha sentensi ambamo maneno mawili yaliyopigiwa mstari ni VINYUME sahihi:
questions.text: Bainisha sentensi ambamo maneno mawili yaliyopigiwa mstari ni VINYUME sahihi:

options.text: Mchana jua huangaza lakini usiku kiza hutanda.
Mchana watu hufanya kazi na asubuhi wanakula.
Shuleni watoto huandika na kusoma kwa pamoja.

questions.explanation: By BODMAS: Division first: 24 / 6 = 4. Multiplication: 2 x 3 = 6. Expression becomes: 36 + 4 - 6 = 40 - 6 = 34.
questions.socraticHint: Perform division (24/6) and multiplication (2x3) before adding and subtracting.

questions.explanation: Brackets first: 15 + 9 = 24. Division: 24 / 4 = 6. Expression: 48 - 6 + 7 = 42 + 7 = 49.
questions.socraticHint: First solve (15 + 9), then divide the result by 4, then evaluate 48 - 6 + 7 from left to right.

questions.prompt: Evaluate: 50 + 2/5 of 100 - 15 x 2.
questions.text: Evaluate: 50 + 2/5 of 100 - 15 x 2.
questions.explanation: Evaluate "Of": 2/5 of 100 = (2 x 100) / 5 = 40. Multiplication: 15 x 2 = 30. Expression: 50 + 40 - 30 = 90 - 30 = 60.
questions.socraticHint: Calculate "2/5 of 100" first, then "15 x 2", then complete addition and subtraction.

questions.explanation: Inside the bracket: multiplication first, 2 x 4 = 8; then addition, 4 + 8 = 12. Bracket = 12. Then division: 120 / 12 = 10. Finally addition: 10 + 15 = 25.
questions.socraticHint: Inside the bracket (4 + 2 x 4), do multiplication first (2 x 4 = 8), then add 4.

questions.prompt: Which pair of brackets placed in the expression 8 + 12 / 4 - 2 makes the value equal to 3?
questions.text: Which pair of brackets placed in the expression 8 + 12 / 4 - 2 makes the value equal to 3?
questions.socraticHint: Test each bracket option: (8 + 12) = 20; 20 / 4 = 5; 5 - 2 = ?

questions.prompt: Evaluate: 75 - 3 x 4 + 18 / 2.
questions.text: Evaluate: 75 - 3 x 4 + 18 / 2.
questions.explanation: Multiplication: 3 x 4 = 12. Division: 18 / 2 = 9. Expression: 75 - 12 + 9 = 63 + 9 = 72.
questions.socraticHint: Calculate 3 x 4 = 12 and 18 / 2 = 9 first, then evaluate 75 - 12 + 9.

questions.explanation: Brackets first: 32 + 16 = 48. "Of": 1/4 of 48 = 12. Division: 15 / 5 = 3. Subtraction: 12 - 3 = 9.
questions.socraticHint: First solve the bracket (32 + 16 = 48), then find 1/4 of 48, then subtract 15/5.

questions.prompt: A farmer had 240 cows. He sold 1/3 of the cows and then bought 45 more cows. How many cows does he have now?
questions.text: A farmer had 240 cows. He sold 1/3 of the cows and then bought 45 more cows. How many cows does he have now?
questions.explanation: Cows sold = 1/3 of 240 = 80. Remaining cows = 240 - 80 = 160. Bought 45 more: 160 + 45 = 205 cows. (Expression: 240 - (1/3 of 240) + 45 = 205).
questions.socraticHint: Find 1/3 of 240 (80), subtract it from 240, then add 45.

questions.explanation: Innermost bracket: 6 - 2 = 4. Multiplication: 5 x 4 = 20. Outer bracket: 40 + 20 = 60. Final subtraction: 100 - 60 = 40.
questions.socraticHint: Solve from the innermost brackets outward: (6 - 2 = 4), then 5 x 4 = 20, then 40 + 20 = 60.

questions.prompt: Evaluate: 64 / 8 x 2 + 10 - 4.
questions.text: Evaluate: 64 / 8 x 2 + 10 - 4.
questions.explanation: Division and multiplication from left to right: 64 / 8 = 8; 8 x 2 = 16. Addition and subtraction from left to right: 16 + 10 = 26; 26 - 4 = 22.
questions.socraticHint: Work from left to right for equal priority operations: 64 / 8 = 8, then 8 x 2 = 16.

questions.prompt: A trader bought 12 bags of potatoes at KES 2,500 each and 8 bags of onions at KES 1,800 each. He paid with KES 50,000. How much change did he receive? Expression: 50,000 - (12 x 2,500 + 8 x 1,800).
questions.text: A trader bought 12 bags of potatoes at KES 2,500 each and 8 bags of onions at KES 1,800 each. He paid with KES 50,000. How much change did he receive? Expression: 50,000 - (12 x 2,500 + 8 x 1,800).
questions.socraticHint: Calculate the total cost of potatoes and onions inside the brackets first, then subtract from 50,000.

questions.prompt: How many 50-shilling notes make 200 shillings?
questions.explanation: 4 × 50 = 200 shillings.
questions.socraticHint: Count by fifties: 50, 100, 150...
questions.kenyanCulturalContext: Fifty shilling notes feature Kenyan wildlife.

questions.prompt: Which of the following numbers is divisible by both 3 and 4?
questions.text: Which of the following numbers is divisible by both 3 and 4?
questions.explanation: For 7,524: sum of digits = 7+5+2+4 = 18 (divisible by 3). Last two digits are 24 (24 / 4 = 6, divisible by 4). Therefore, 7,524 is divisible by both 3 and 4 (and by 12).
questions.socraticHint: Check which number has a digit sum divisible by 3 AND its last two digits divisible by 4.

questions.prompt: What digit must be placed in the box of the number 48,[]72 so that the number is divisible by 9?
questions.text: What digit must be placed in the box of the number 48,[]72 so that the number is divisible by 9?
questions.explanation: Sum of known digits = 4 + 8 + 7 + 2 = 21. The next multiple of 9 after 21 is 27. Therefore, the missing digit is 27 - 21 = 6.
questions.socraticHint: A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of all its digits is a multiple of 9. What number added to 21 makes a multiple of 9?

questions.prompt: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 11?
questions.text: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 11?
questions.explanation: For 82,918: odd place digits (from right): 8 + 9 + 8 = 25. Even place digits: 1 + 2 = 3. Difference = 25 - 3 = 22. Since 22 is a multiple of 11 (2 x 11), 82,918 is divisible by 11.
questions.socraticHint: Calculate the difference between the sum of digits in odd places and even places: does it equal 0, 11, or 22?

questions.prompt: Express 720 as a product of its prime factors in index notation.
questions.text: Express 720 as a product of its prime factors in index notation.
questions.socraticHint: Count how many 2s, 3s, and 5s multiply together to make 720.

questions.prompt: Find the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) of 48, 72, and 120.
questions.text: Find the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) of 48, 72, and 120.
questions.explanation: Prime factorisations: 48 = 2^4 x 3; 72 = 2^3 x 3^2; 120 = 2^3 x 3 x 5. Common prime factors: 2^3 x 3 = 8 x 3 = 24.
questions.socraticHint: Find the lowest power of the common prime factors (2^3 and 3^1).

questions.prompt: Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 15, 20, and 30.
questions.text: Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 15, 20, and 30.
questions.explanation: 15 = 3 x 5; 20 = 2^2 x 5; 30 = 2 x 3 x 5. LCM takes highest powers: 2^2 x 3 x 5 = 4 x 3 x 5 = 60.
questions.socraticHint: What is the smallest number that 15, 20, and 30 all divide into without a remainder?

questions.prompt: Three timber planks of lengths 84 cm, 126 cm, and 168 cm are to be cut into equal shorter pieces without any wood left over. What is the greatest possible length of each piece?
questions.text: Three timber planks of lengths 84 cm, 126 cm, and 168 cm are to be cut into equal shorter pieces without any wood left over. What is the greatest possible length of each piece?
questions.socraticHint: Cutting into equal maximum lengths without remainder requires finding the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD).

questions.prompt: Two public service buses leave a Nairobi terminus at 6:00 a.m. Bus A departs every 25 minutes and Bus B departs every 40 minutes. At what time will both buses leave the terminus together again?
questions.text: Two public service buses leave a Nairobi terminus at 6:00 a.m. Bus A departs every 25 minutes and Bus B departs every 40 minutes. At what time will both buses leave the terminus together again?
questions.explanation: LCM of 25 and 40: 25 = 5^2; 40 = 2^3 x 5. LCM = 2^3 x 5^2 = 8 x 25 = 200 minutes. 200 minutes = 3 hours and 20 minutes. 6:00 a.m. + 3 hrs 20 min = 9:20 a.m.
questions.socraticHint: Find the LCM of 25 and 40 (200 minutes), convert it to hours and minutes, and add to 6:00 a.m.

questions.prompt: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 6?
questions.text: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 6?
questions.explanation: A number is divisible by 6 if it is even and its digit sum is a multiple of 3. 54,822 ends in 2 (even). Digit sum = 5+4+8+2+2 = 21 (multiple of 3). Therefore, 54,822 is divisible by 6.
questions.socraticHint: Check which number is both even AND has a digit sum divisible by 3.

questions.prompt: The product of two numbers is 1,200. If their GCD is 10, what is their LCM?
questions.text: The product of two numbers is 1,200. If their GCD is 10, what is their LCM?
questions.explanation: Formula: Product of two numbers = GCD x LCM. Therefore, LCM = Product / GCD = 1,200 / 10 = 120.
questions.socraticHint: Use the rule: Number 1 x Number 2 = GCD x LCM.

questions.prompt: Which test determines if a number is divisible by 8?
questions.text: Which test determines if a number is divisible by 8?

options.text: The sum of its digits is divisible by 8
Its last two digits are divisible by 8
The number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8 (or ends in 000)

questions.correctAnswer: The number formed by its last three digits is divisible by 8 (or ends in 000)
questions.explanation: Since 1,000 is divisible by 8 (1,000 / 8 = 125), any whole number is divisible by 8 if and only if its last three digits form a multiple of 8.
questions.socraticHint: Look at the last three digits of the number: do they form a multiple of 8?

questions.prompt: What is the smallest number of sweets that can be shared equally among 6, 8, or 9 children without any sweets left over?
questions.text: What is the smallest number of sweets that can be shared equally among 6, 8, or 9 children without any sweets left over?
questions.explanation: We need the LCM of 6, 8, and 9: 6 = 2 x 3; 8 = 2^3; 9 = 3^2. LCM = 2^3 x 3^2 = 8 x 9 = 72 sweets.
questions.socraticHint: Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 6, 8, and 9.

questions.prompt: Calculate the square of 28 (28^2).
questions.text: Calculate the square of 28 (28^2).
questions.socraticHint: Multiply 28 by 28: 28 x 20 = 560, 28 x 8 = 224. Add them together.

questions.prompt: What is the square root of 1,764?
questions.text: What is the square root of 1,764?
questions.explanation: Prime factorisation of 1,764: 1,764 = 2^2 x 3^2 x 7^2. Taking one factor from each pair: 2 x 3 x 7 = 42. Check: 42 x 42 = 1,764.
questions.socraticHint: Factorise 1,764 into primes: (2 x 2) x (3 x 3) x (7 x 7). Pick one from each pair and multiply.

questions.prompt: A square playground has an area of 3,136 square metres. What is the length of one side of the playground?
questions.text: A square playground has an area of 3,136 square metres. What is the length of one side of the playground?
questions.explanation: Side length = sqrt(Area) = sqrt(3,136). Prime factors of 3,136 = 2^6 x 7^2. Taking square root: 2^3 x 7 = 8 x 7 = 56 metres.
questions.socraticHint: Find the square root of 3,136 to get the side length of the square.

questions.prompt: What is the square of 65?
questions.text: What is the square of 65?
questions.explanation: 65 x 65 = 4,225. (Shortcut for numbers ending in 5: 6 x (6+1) = 42, followed by 25 = 4,225).
questions.socraticHint: Multiply 65 by 65.

questions.prompt: Find the square root of 5,184 using prime factorisation.
questions.text: Find the square root of 5,184 using prime factorisation.
questions.socraticHint: Halve the powers in 2^6 x 3^4: 2^3 x 3^2 = 8 x 9 = ?

questions.prompt: Evaluate: sqrt(225) + sqrt(400) - sqrt(169).
questions.text: Evaluate: sqrt(225) + sqrt(400) - sqrt(169).
questions.socraticHint: Evaluate each square root: sqrt(225) is 15, sqrt(400) is 20, and sqrt(169) is 13.

questions.prompt: What is the square root of 9,801?
questions.text: What is the square root of 9,801?
questions.socraticHint: Notice that 100^2 is 10,000. Which number just below 100 has a square ending in 1?

questions.prompt: A square flower bed has a perimeter of 144 metres. What is the area of the flower bed?
questions.text: A square flower bed has a perimeter of 144 metres. What is the area of the flower bed?
questions.explanation: Side length = Perimeter / 4 = 144 / 4 = 36 metres. Area = side^2 = 36 x 36 = 1,296 square metres.
questions.socraticHint: First divide perimeter by 4 to get side length (36 m), then square 36.

questions.prompt: What is the smallest whole number by which 180 must be multiplied so that the product becomes a perfect square?
questions.text: What is the smallest whole number by which 180 must be multiplied so that the product becomes a perfect square?
questions.explanation: Prime factorisation of 180 = 2^2 x 3^2 x 5. The factor 5 is unpaired. To make all exponents even, we must multiply by 5. (180 x 5 = 900 = 30^2).
questions.socraticHint: Write 180 in prime factors: 2^2 x 3^2 x 5. Which prime factor has an odd power and needs a partner?

questions.prompt: Which of the following numbers CANNOT be a perfect square?
questions.text: Which of the following numbers CANNOT be a perfect square?
questions.explanation: The last digit of any perfect square can only be 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9. No perfect square can ever end in 2, 3, 7, or 8. Therefore, 2,357 cannot be a perfect square.
questions.socraticHint: Look at the last digit: can a square number end with 7?

questions.prompt: Evaluate: sqrt(64 x 81).
questions.text: Evaluate: sqrt(64 x 81).
questions.explanation: Property of square roots: sqrt(a x b) = sqrt(a) x sqrt(b). sqrt(64) = 8, sqrt(81) = 9. 8 x 9 = 72.
questions.socraticHint: Find sqrt(64) and sqrt(81) separately, then multiply them.

questions.prompt: The area of a square shamba is 7,225 m^2. How much fencing wire is needed to fence the shamba with 3 strands of wire?
questions.text: The area of a square shamba is 7,225 m^2. How much fencing wire is needed to fence the shamba with 3 strands of wire?
questions.explanation: Side length = sqrt(7,225) = 85 m. Perimeter of 1 strand = 4 x 85 = 340 m. For 3 strands of wire: 3 x 340 = 1,020 metres.
questions.socraticHint: Find the side length by taking sqrt(7,225) = 85 m. Perimeter = 4 x 85 = 340 m. Multiply by 3 for 3 strands.

questions.prompt: Evaluate: 4 2/3 + 3 3/4. Express the answer in simplest mixed number form.
questions.text: Evaluate: 4 2/3 + 3 3/4. Express the answer in simplest mixed number form.
questions.socraticHint: Find the common denominator of 3 and 4 (which is 12) and add whole numbers and fractions.

questions.prompt: Evaluate: 6 1/5 - 2 3/4.
questions.text: Evaluate: 6 1/5 - 2 3/4.
questions.explanation: Convert to improper fractions: 31/5 - 11/4 = (124 - 55) / 20 = 69 / 20 = 3 9/20.
questions.socraticHint: Express as improper fractions with common denominator 20: 124/20 - 55/20.

questions.prompt: What is the reciprocal of 3 4/7?
questions.text: What is the reciprocal of 3 4/7?
questions.explanation: Convert 3 4/7 to an improper fraction: (3 x 7 + 4) / 7 = 25/7. The reciprocal of 25/7 is 7/25.
questions.socraticHint: First convert 3 4/7 to an improper fraction, then invert the numerator and denominator.

questions.prompt: Multiply: 2 1/7 x 1 2/5.
questions.text: Multiply: 2 1/7 x 1 2/5.
questions.socraticHint: Convert both to improper fractions: 15/7 x 7/5. Notice that 7 cancels out.
21/4 divided by 3/2 becomes 21/4 multiplied by 2/3.

questions.prompt: A chef used 3/8 of a bag of rice on Friday and 1/3 of the remainder on Saturday. What fraction of the original bag of rice remained for Sunday?
questions.text: A chef used 3/8 of a bag of rice on Friday and 1/3 of the remainder on Saturday. What fraction of the original bag of rice remained for Sunday?
questions.explanation: Used Friday: 3/8. Remainder after Friday = 1 - 3/8 = 5/8. Used Saturday = 1/3 of 5/8 = 5/24. Remaining for Sunday = 5/8 - 5/24 = (15 - 5) / 24 = 10/24 = 5/12.
questions.socraticHint: After using 3/8, 5/8 remains. If 1/3 of the remainder is used, then 2/3 of 5/8 remains.
Notice that the denominator is 3/4 x 4/3 = 1! What is 2 1/2 + 1 1/3 divided by 1?

questions.prompt: A dairy farmer produced 48 litres of milk. He poured the milk into bottles each holding 3/4 of a litre. How many bottles were filled completely?
questions.text: A dairy farmer produced 48 litres of milk. He poured the milk into bottles each holding 3/4 of a litre. How many bottles were filled completely?
questions.explanation: Number of bottles = 48 / (3/4) = 48 x 4/3 = 16 x 4 = 64 bottles.
questions.socraticHint: Divide 48 by 3/4: multiply 48 by the reciprocal 4/3.
First multiply 3/5 x 15/18 to get 1/2, then divide 1/2 by 1/2.

questions.prompt: Kipchoge ran 3 1/2 km in the morning and 4 3/5 km in the evening. How many kilometres did he run in total that day?
questions.text: Kipchoge ran 3 1/2 km in the morning and 4 3/5 km in the evening. How many kilometres did he run in total that day?
questions.socraticHint: Add whole numbers (3+4=7) and fractions (5/10 + 6/10 = 11/10 = 1 1/10).

questions.prompt: What fraction must be added to 5/12 to get 7/8?
questions.text: What fraction must be added to 5/12 to get 7/8?
